body:
create trigger POSINS_UDL
on r5userdefinedfieldlovvals
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser        nvarchar(38)
  declare @sUEntity     nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX           nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(4)
  declare @sREntity     nvarchar(4)
  declare @sField       nvarchar(20)
  declare @sCode        nvarchar(80)
  declare @sDesc        nvarchar(80)
  declare @sDescPK      nvarchar(100)
  declare @nReturn      int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_inserted cursor local for
        select i.udl_rentity, i.udl_field, i.udl_code, i.udl_desc
        from   inserted i

      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_inserted
          fetch next from c_inserted into @sREntity, @sField, @sCode, @sDesc
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              set @sCheckresult = N'0'
              execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sUEntity OUTPUT, @sREntity, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_inserted
                  deallocate c_inserted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              set @sCheckresult = N'0'
              set @sDescPK = @sField + @sCode
              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'UDLV', @sUEntity, @sREntity, @sDescPK, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_inserted
                  deallocate c_inserted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                begin
                  close c_inserted
                  deallocate c_inserted
                  execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              fetch next from c_inserted into @sREntity, @sField, @sCode, @sDesc
            end
          close c_inserted
        end
      deallocate c_inserted
    end

create trigger POSINS_UGF
on R5UNAVAILABLEGRIDFIELDS
for insert
as
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0

                begin
                   update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount = pgc_updatecount
                     from inserted i
                      where pgc_usergroup   = i.ugf_usergroup 
                      and pgc_function      = i.UGF_GRIDNAME
                      and pgc_tabname       = N'LST'
                end
        end

create trigger POSINS_USR
on R5USERS
for insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode             	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sDesc             	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass            	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sMrc              	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sSysman           	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sPassword         	nvarchar(50)        
	declare @sLastfunc         	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sFirstfunc        	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sGroup            	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sLang             	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sPrinter          	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dExppass          	datetime            
	declare @dExpuser          	datetime            
	declare @sFacility         	nvarchar(10)        
	declare @nReqappvlimit     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nReqauthappvlimit 	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sBuyer            	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nPordappvlimit    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nPordauthappvlimit	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sRouter           	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dDatelocked       	datetime            
	declare @nViolations       	integer             
	declare @sClass_org        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sApprover         	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nPicappvlimit     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sEmailaddress     	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sNotificationpref 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sBrowser          	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nInvappvlimit     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nInvappvlimitnonpo	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nUpdatecount      	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sLogin            	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sRequestor        	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sActive           	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sLocale           	nvarchar(10)        
	declare @nSuccessmsgtimeout	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sEwsfirstfunc     	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @dCreated          	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated          	datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity      	integer             
	declare @sInboxtab         	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sMobile           	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sConnector        	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sBarcode          	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sNotused          	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sUserPreference    nvarchar(30)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)          
	declare @sMos					nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(3)
	declare @sCmorgall			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sEAMUser           nvarchar(255)    
	declare @dCreatedDate       datetime                    
	declare @sForgetme          nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			execute O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	USR_CODE,	USR_DESC,	USR_CLASS,	USR_MRC,	USR_SYSMAN,
													  	USR_PASSWORD,	USR_LASTFUNC,	USR_FIRSTFUNC,	USR_GROUP,	USR_LANG,
													  	USR_PRINTER,	USR_EXPPASS,	USR_EXPUSER,	USR_FACILITY,	USR_REQAPPVLIMIT,
													  	USR_REQAUTHAPPVLIMIT,	USR_BUYER,	USR_PORDAPPVLIMIT,	USR_PORDAUTHAPPVLIMIT,	USR_ROUTER,
													  	USR_DATELOCKED,	USR_VIOLATIONS,	USR_CLASS_ORG,	USR_APPROVER,	USR_PICAPPVLIMIT,
													  	USR_EMAILADDRESS,	USR_NOTIFICATIONPREF,	USR_BROWSER,	USR_INVAPPVLIMIT,	USR_INVAPPVLIMITNONPO,
													  	USR_UPDATECOUNT,	USR_LOGIN,	USR_REQUESTOR,	USR_ACTIVE,	USR_LOCALE,
													  	USR_SUCCESSMSGTIMEOUT,	USR_EWSFIRSTFUNC,	USR_CREATED,	USR_UPDATED,	USR_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	USR_INBOXTAB,	USR_MOBILE,	USR_CONNECTOR,	USR_BARCODE,	USR_NOTUSED
													  
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sMrc,	@sSysman,
														@sPassword,	@sLastfunc,	@sFirstfunc,	@sGroup,	@sLang,
														@sPrinter,	@dExppass,	@dExpuser,	@sFacility,	@nReqappvlimit,
														@nReqauthappvlimit,	@sBuyer,	@nPordappvlimit,	@nPordauthappvlimit,	@sRouter,
														@dDatelocked,	@nViolations,	@sClass_org,	@sApprover,	@nPicappvlimit,
														@sEmailaddress,	@sNotificationpref,	@sBrowser,	@nInvappvlimit,	@nInvappvlimitnonpo,
														@nUpdatecount,	@sLogin,	@sRequestor,	@sActive,	@sLocale,
														@nSuccessmsgtimeout,	@sEwsfirstfunc,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,
														@sInboxtab,	@sMobile,	@sConnector,	@sBarcode,	@sNotused
													
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* Code added in 0514 Schema. */
							set @sMos = dbo.o7getmos(N'EVNT')

							if @sForgetme <> N'TRUE'
								begin
									/*--fetching CMORGALL install parameter value--*/
									execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sCmorgall OUTPUT, N'CMORGALL', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								
									if @sCmorgall = N'YES'
										begin
											INSERT INTO r5userorganization (
											uog_user, uog_org, uog_common, uog_default, uog_group,
											uog_reqappvlimit, uog_pordappvlimit, uog_reqauthappvlimit,
											uog_pordauthappvlimit, uog_picappvlimit, uog_invappvlimit,
											uog_invappvlimitnonpo )
											SELECT @sCode,
											org_code,
											N'+',
											N'-',
											@sGroup,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nReqappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nPordappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nReqauthappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nPordauthappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nPicappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nInvappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nInvappvlimitnonpo end
											FROM   r5organization
											WHERE  org_common = '+';
										end
									else if @sCmorgall = N'*'
										begin
											INSERT INTO r5userorganization (
											uog_user, uog_org, uog_common, uog_default, uog_group,
											uog_reqappvlimit, uog_pordappvlimit, uog_reqauthappvlimit,
											uog_pordauthappvlimit, uog_picappvlimit, uog_invappvlimit,
											uog_invappvlimitnonpo )
											SELECT @sCode,
											org_code,
											N'+',
											N'-',
											@sGroup,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nReqappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nPordappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nReqauthappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nPordauthappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nPicappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nInvappvlimit end,
											CASE @sMos when N'+' Then null else @nInvappvlimitnonpo end
											FROM   r5organization
											WHERE  org_common = '+' and org_code = @sCmorgall;
										end

									execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sUserPreference OUTPUT, N'ULP', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return
							
									INSERT INTO r5userlinearpreferences
									(ulp_code, ulp_desc, ulp_usercode, ulp_lodefaultfilter, ulp_default, ulp_groupsegments, ulp_created, ulp_createdby)
									VALUES 
									(@sUserPreference,N'(default)',@sCode, N'WO', N'+', N'+', @dCreatedDate, @sEAMUser)

								end

							/* get eam user */
							execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sEAMUser OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return

							set @sEAMUser = coalesce(@sEAMUser, N'*')

							/* get system date */
							execute @n

create trigger POSINS_WKS
on R5WORKSPACES
for insert
as
  declare @sUser         nvarchar(38)
  declare @sCheckresult  nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX            nvarchar(1)
  declare @sNumber       nvarchar(30)
  declare @sOrg          nvarchar(15)
  declare @sDesc         nvarchar(80)
  declare @nReturn       int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_inserted cursor local for select wks_pk, wks_org, wks_desc from inserted
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
      open c_inserted 
      fetch next from c_inserted into @sNumber, @sOrg, @sDesc
      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'
        set @sX = null
        
        /* Insert description */
        execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'WKSP', @sX, N'*', @sNumber, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_inserted
          deallocate c_inserted
          rollback transaction
          return
        end

        if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
        begin
          close c_inserted
          deallocate c_inserted
          execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
          rollback transaction
        return
        end

        fetch next from c_inserted into @sNumber, @sOrg, @sDesc
      end
      close c_inserted
    end
    deallocate c_inserted
  end

create trigger POSINS_XTS
on R5XMLTRANSTATUS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @nSeqnum		int
	declare @sTrantype		nvarchar(16)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(64)
	declare @nEntries		int
	declare @nTotrows		int
	declare @nI				int
	declare @nErrors		int
	declare @nRows			int
	declare @sTableName		nvarchar(32)
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(500)

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_errorentries', @sTemp OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			rollback transaction
			return
		end

	set @nEntries = cast( @sTemp as int )

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_totentries', @sTemp OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			rollback transaction
			return
		end

	set @nTotrows = cast( @sTemp as int )

	--just in case this table wasn't already created
	execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7XMLVAL_DBE_TMP_TABLE
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			rollback transaction
			return
		end

	set @sTableName = dbo.GET_O7XMLVAL_DBE_TEMP_TBLNAME()

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_trantype', @sTrantype OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			rollback transaction
			return
		end
	
	if @sTrantype = N'POSTJOURNAL'
	begin
		if @nEntries > 0
		begin
			set @sSQL = N'declare c_cursor cursor for select dbe_xtsseqnum from ' + @sTableName
			
			execute sp_executesql @sSQL
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			open c_cursor
			fetch next from c_cursor into @nSeqnum
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					select @nErrors = count(*) from r5databridgeerrors where dbe_xtsseqnum = @nSeqnum
					
					--set @nRows = @nErrors / 2
					
					UPDATE r5xmltranstatus
					SET xts_message = N'ERROR ROWS FOUND WHEN PROCESSING. = ' + cast( @nErrors as nvarchar(64) ) + 
										N' NO OF ROWS IN ERROR = ' + cast( @nErrors as nvarchar(64) ) + 
										N' AGAINST TOTAL ROWS PROCESSED = ' + cast( @nTotrows as nvarchar(64) )
					WHERE xts_seqnum = @nSeqnum

					fetch next from c_cursor into @nSeqnum
				end
			close c_cursor
			deallocate c_cursor
			
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_errorentries', N'0'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			--setting v_errorentries = 0 effectively deletes from the temp table as well.
			set @sSQL = N'delete from ' + @sTableName
			execute sp_executesql @sSQL
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					rollback transaction
					return
				end			
		end
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_trantype', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				rollback transaction
				return
			end
	end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD3_AAT
ON R5AUDATTRIBS
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
declare @sUser  nvarchar(38)
declare @sKey  nvarchar(400)
declare @sValue  nvarchar(400)
declare @AAT_CODE int

if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_updated cursor local for select AAT_CODE from inserted
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
        open c_updated
        fetch next from c_updated into @AAT_CODE
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            select @sKey = 'AAT_CODE'
            select @sValue = str(@AAT_CODE)
            execute o7mobile_sync_event N'R5AUDATTRIBS', N'UPDATE', @sKey, @sValue, NULL

            fetch next from c_updated into @AAT_CODE
        End
        Close c_updated
    End
    deallocate c_updated
End

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD3_ACK
ON R5ACTCHECKLISTS
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
declare @sUser  nvarchar(38)
declare @sKey  nvarchar(400)
declare @sValue  nvarchar(400)
declare @ACK_CODE nvarchar(30)

if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_updated cursor local for select ACK_CODE from inserted
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
        open c_updated
        fetch next from c_updated into @ACK_CODE
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD3_ADD
ON R5ADDETAILS
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
declare @sUser  nvarchar(38)
declare @sKey  nvarchar(400)
declare @sValue  nvarchar(400)
declare @ADD_CODE nvarchar(100)
declare @ADD_LANG nvarchar(2)
declare @ADD_LANG_OLD nvarchar(2)
declare @ADD_LINE numeric
declare @ADD_RENTITY nvarchar(4)
declare @ADD_TYPE nvarchar(4)

if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_updated cursor local for select i.ADD_CODE,i.ADD_LANG,i.ADD_LINE,i.ADD_RENTITY,i.ADD_TYPE, d.ADD_LANG from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ADD_SQLIDENTITY	= d.ADD_SQLIDENTITY
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
        open c_updated
        fetch next from c_updated into @ADD_CODE,@ADD_LANG,@ADD_LINE,@ADD_RENTITY,@ADD_TYPE,@ADD_LANG_OLD
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            select @sKey = 'ADD_CODE' + CHAR(13) + 'ADD_LANG' + CHAR(13) + 'ADD_LINE' + CHAR(13) + 'ADD_RENTITY' + CHAR(13) + 'ADD_TYPE'
			
			if @ADD_LANG <> @ADD_LANG_OLD
			begin
               select @sValue = @ADD_CODE + CHAR(13) + @ADD_LANG_OLD + CHAR(13) + str(@ADD_LINE) + CHAR(13) + @ADD_RENTITY + CHAR(13) + @ADD_TYPE
               execute o7mobile_sync_event N'R5ADDETAILS', N'DELETE', @sKey, @sValue, @ADD_RENTITY

               select @sValue = @ADD_CODE + CHAR(13) + @ADD_LANG + CHAR(13) + str(@ADD_LINE) + CHAR(13) + @ADD_RENTITY + CHAR(13) + @ADD_TYPE
               execute o7mobile_sync_event N'R5ADDETAILS', N'INSERT', @sKey, @sValue, @ADD_RENTITY
			end 
			else
			begin
               select @sValue = @ADD_CODE + CHAR(13) + @ADD_LANG + CHAR(13) + str(@ADD_LINE) + CHAR(13) + @ADD_RENTITY + CHAR(13) + @ADD_TYPE
               execute o7mobile_sync_event N'R5ADDETAILS', N'UPDATE', @sKey, @sValue, @ADD_RENTITY
			end

            fetch next from c_updated into @ADD_CODE,@ADD_LANG,@ADD_LINE,@ADD_RENTITY,@ADD_TYPE,@ADD_LANG_OLD
        End
        Close c_updated
    End
    deallocate c_updated
End

create trigger POSUPDDEL_PMR
on R5PMRESOURCES
for update, delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
   declare @sPpm              nvarchar(20)
   declare @nPpmRev           numeric(4)
   declare @sObject           nvarchar(30)
   declare @sObjectOrg        nvarchar(15)
   declare @sResource         nvarchar(80)
   declare @sActive           nvarchar(1)
   declare @nOperationSeq     numeric(8)
   declare @nCoolDownTime     numeric(7,2)
   declare @nWarmupTime       numeric(7,2)
   declare @nDownTime         numeric(7,2)
   declare @sOffset           nvarchar(1)
   declare @nOffsetValue      numeric(7,2)
   declare @sEAMUser          nvarchar(255)  
   declare @dDate             datetime
   declare @nReturn           int
   declare @nCnt              int
   declare @sInobjectupdate   nvarchar(10)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
              /* get eam user */
         execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sEAMUser OUTPUT
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return
      
         set @sEAMUser = coalesce(@sEAMUser, N'*')
         
              /* get system date */
         execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
           return
           
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
         declare c_deleted cursor local for select pmr_ppm, pmr_ppmrevision, pmr_object, pmr_object_org, pmr_resource, pmr_operationseq, pmr_cooldowntime, pmr_warmuptime, pmr_downtime, pmr_offset, pmr_offsetvalue, pmr_active from deleted
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
            begin
               select @nCnt = count(*) from inserted
               open c_deleted 
               fetch next from c_deleted into @sPpm, @nPpmRev, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource, @nOperationSeq, @nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime, @nDownTime, @sOffset, @nOffsetValue, @sActive
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                        
                        /* Create audit records */
                     INSERT INTO r5pmresourcesaudit(
                         pra_ppm,
                         pra_ppmrevision,
                         pra_object,
                         pra_object_org,
                         pra_resource,
                         pra_operationseq,
                         pra_cooldowntime,
                         pra_warmuptime,
                         pra_downtime,
                         pra_active,
                         pra_offset,
                         pra_offsetvalue,
                         pra_action,
                         pra_modifiedby,
                         pra_datemodified)
                     VALUES (
                         @sPpm,
                         @nPpmRev,
                         @sObject,
                         @sObjectOrg,
                         @sResource,
                         @nOperationSeq,
                         @nCoolDownTime,
                         @nWarmupTime,
                         @nDownTime,
                         @sActive,
                         @sOffset,
                         @nOffsetValue,
                         CASE @nCnt WHEN 0 THEN N'DEL' ELSE N'UPD' END,
                         @sEAMUser,
                         @dDate )   
                     fetch next from c_deleted into @sPpm, @nPpmRev, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource, @nOperationSeq, @nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime, @nDownTime, @sOffset, @nOffsetValue, @sActive
                  end
               close c_deleted
            end
         deallocate c_deleted
      end

create trigger POSUPDEL1_ACS
on R5ACTSCHEDULES
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nActivity   	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sComment    	nvarchar(60)        
	declare @sMrc        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sTrade      	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sObject     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dSched      	datetime            
	declare @nStarttime  	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nEndtime    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nHours      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sResponsible	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sShift      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sScheduler  	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sFrozen     	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sObject_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sMpproj     	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer   

	declare @sEventTemp			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nActTemp			numeric(8,0)
	declare @sPerresp			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)	          

	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	ACS_EVENT,	ACS_ACTIVITY,	ACS_COMMENT,	ACS_MRC,	ACS_TRADE,
													  	ACS_OBJECT,	ACS_SCHED,	ACS_STARTTIME,	ACS_ENDTIME,	ACS_HOURS,
													  	ACS_RESPONSIBLE,	ACS_SHIFT,	ACS_SCHEDULER,	ACS_FROZEN,	ACS_OBJECT_ORG,
													  	ACS_MPPROJ,	ACS_UPDATECOUNT,	ACS_CODE,	ACS_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					create table #tProperties_acs ( event			nvarchar(30), 
							activity		numeric(8,0))

					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sEvent,	@nActivity,	@sComment,	@sMrc,	@sTrade,
												   	@sObject,	@dSched,	@nStarttime,	@nEndtime,	@nHours,
												   	@sResponsible,	@sShift,	@sScheduler,	@sFrozen,	@sObject_org,
												   	@sMpproj,	@nUpdatecount,	@sCode,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							insert into #tProperties_acs values (@sEvent, @nActivity) 

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sEvent,	@nActivity,	@sComment,	@sMrc,	@sTrade,
														   	@sObject,	@dSched,	@nStarttime,	@nEndtime,	@nHours,
														   	@sResponsible,	@sShift,	@sScheduler,	@sFrozen,	@sObject_org,
														   	@sMpproj,	@nUpdatecount,	@sCode,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted

					--AFTER statement portion
					declare c_properties cursor local for select event, activity from #tProperties_acs
					open c_properties
					fetch next from c_properties into @sEventTemp, @nActTemp
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sPerresp = null

							SELECT @sPerresp = a.acs_responsible
							FROM  r5actschedules a
							WHERE a.acs_code in (SELECT min(b.acs_code)
										FROM r5actschedules b
										WHERE  b.acs_event   = @sEventTemp
										AND    b.acs_activity = @nActTemp
										AND    b.acs_responsible IS NOT NULL)
							if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
								set @sPerresp = null

							UPDATE r5activities
							SET    act_perresp = @sPerresp
							WHERE  act_event   = @sEventTemp
							AND    act_act     = @nActTemp
							AND    coalesce(act_perresp,N'-') <> coalesce(@sPerresp,N'-')
							if @@ERROR <> 0 
								set @sX = null

							fetch next from c_properties into @sEventTemp, @nActTemp
						end
					close c_properties
					deallocate c_properties

					drop table #tProperties_acs
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger POSUPD_ACK
on r5actchecklists
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser                 nvarchar(38)
    declare @sEvent                  nvarchar(30)
	declare @sAct                  numeric(8)
    declare @nReturn               int
    declare @sInobjectupdate       nvarchar(10)
    declare @sLoto                 nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCasetask             nvarchar(30)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ack_event, i.ack_act, i.ack_loto, i.ack_casetask
                                               from inserted i, deleted d
                                               where i.ack_sqlidentity = d.ack_sqlidentity
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del 
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent, @sAct, @sLoto, @sCasetask
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
							if @sAct = 0
								begin
									/* Reset Permit To Work esignature information. */
									UPDATE r5permittowork SET ptw_reviewed = null, ptw_reviewedby = null, ptw_reviewedtype = null WHERE ptw_code = @sEvent AND @sLoto IS NOT NULL;
									/* Reset Case Management esignature information. */
                                    UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sEvent AND @sCasetask IS NOT NULL;                            
								end
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent, @sAct, @sLoto, @sCasetask
                        end
                    close c_ins_del
                end
            deallocate c_ins_del
        end

create trigger POSUPD_ADD
on R5ADDETAILS
for update
as
   declare @sSysUser          nvarchar(38)
   declare @sEntity           nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sRentity          nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sType             nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sRtype            nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sCode             nvarchar(100)       
   declare @sLang             nvarchar(2)         
   declare @nLine             numeric(12,0)        
   declare @sPrint            nvarchar(1)         
   declare @dCreated          datetime            
   declare @sUser             nvarchar(255)       
   declare @dUpdated          datetime            
   declare @sUpduser          nvarchar(255)       
   declare @nUpdatecount      numeric(38,0)       
   declare @nSqlidentity      integer             

   declare @sOldEntity        nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldRentity       nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldType          nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldRtype         nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldCode          nvarchar(100)       
   declare @sOldLang          nvarchar(2)         
   declare @nOldLine          numeric(12,0)        
   declare @sOldPrint         nvarchar(1)         
   declare @dOldCreated       datetime            
   declare @sOldUser          nvarchar(255)       
   declare @dOldUpdated       datetime            
   declare @sOldUpduser       nvarchar(255)       
   declare @nOldUpdatecount   numeric(38,0)   

   declare @nCount            int
   declare  @sFlag            nvarchar(2)
   declare @nReturn           int
   declare @dGetdate          datetime
   declare @sSQL              nvarchar(2000)
   declare @sPevEvent         nvarchar(30)
   declare @sSessuser         nvarchar(255)        
   declare @sTempMsgid        nvarchar(256)  
   
   declare @sOrg              nvarchar(15)
   declare @sPartOrg          nvarchar(2000)
   declare @sInobjectupdate   nvarchar(10)

   declare @sEvtCode		nvarchar(30)
   declare @sEventRstatus	nvarchar(4)
   declare @sEventRtype		nvarchar(4)
   declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
   declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)
   declare @sParentEvent	nvarchar(30)
   declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
   declare @dEventInterface	datetime
   declare @sExportwo           nvarchar(30)
   
   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
         declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ADD_ENTITY,  i.ADD_RENTITY, i.ADD_TYPE, i.ADD_RTYPE,   i.ADD_CODE,
                                          i.ADD_LANG, i.ADD_LINE, i.ADD_PRINT,   i.ADD_CREATED,
                                          i.ADD_USER, i.ADD_UPDATED, i.ADD_UPDUSER, i.ADD_UPDATECOUNT,   i.ADD_SQLIDENTITY
                                        ,
                                          d.ADD_ENTITY,  d.ADD_RENTITY, d.ADD_TYPE, d.ADD_RTYPE,   d.ADD_CODE,
                                          d.ADD_LANG, d.ADD_LINE, d.ADD_PRINT,   d.ADD_CREATED,
                                          d.ADD_USER, d.ADD_UPDATED, d.ADD_UPDUSER, d.ADD_UPDATECOUNT
                                       from inserted i, deleted d
                                       where i.ADD_SQLIDENTITY = d.ADD_SQLIDENTITY
         set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
            begin
               open c_ins_del
               fetch next from c_ins_del into   @sEntity,   @sRentity,  @sType,  @sRtype, @sCode,
                                          @sLang,  @nLine,  @sPrint, @dCreated,
                                          @sUser,  @dUpdated,  @sUpduser,  @nUpdatecount, @nSqlidentity
                                       ,
                                       @sOldEntity,   @sOldRentity,  @sOldType,  @sOldRtype, @sOldCode,
                                       @sOldLang,  @nOldLine,  @sOldPrint, @dOldCreated,
                                       @sOldUser,  @dOldUpdated,  @sOldUpduser,  @nOldUpdatecount
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     if @sRentity = N'EVNT' and @nUpdatecount <> -1 and charindex( N'#', @sCode ) = 0
                        begin
                           set @dGetdate = GetDate()

                           /*****************************************************************************
                           This trigger code is absorbing the following package calls:
                              O7EVENTTEMP_ADDEVENT_ADD
                              O7EVENTTEMP_CLEARTEMPTABLE_ADD
                           *****************************************************************************/
                           
                           UPDATE r5events
                           SET    evt_updated = @dGetdate
                           WHERE  evt_code    = @sCode
                           AND    evt_rstatus <> N'C'
                                    AND    ISNULL( evt_updated, evt_created ) NOT BETWEEN @dGetdate - .00005 AND @dGetdate + .00005
                        end

                     if @sRentity = N'OBJ'
                        begin
                           --TNT 04-03-03: This check is necessary to avoid errors when '#' is not 
                           --          in @sCode.  In Oracle this does not throw an error because
                           --          substr() handles situations where instr() returns 0
                           if CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) > 0
                              UPDATE   r5objects
                                 SET  obj_updated = GetDate()
                               WHERE  obj_code = SUBSTRING(@sCode, 1, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) - 1)
                               AND    obj_org  = SUBSTRING(@sCode, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) + 1, 2000)
                        end

                     if @sRentity = N'PRME'
                        begin
                                    -- first, get Permit Org, permit workorder
                                    SELECT @sOrg = pev_permit_org, @sPevEvent = pev_event FROM r5permevents WHERE pev_code = @sCode
                           set @dGetdate = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
                           UPDATE r5permevents 
                              SET pev_reviewed = null, pev_reviewedby = null, pev_reviewedname = null, pev_reviewedtype = null, pev_updated = @dGetdate, pev_updatedby = @sUser
                            WHERE pev_code = @sCode;
                           UPDATE r5events 
                              SET evt_permitreviewed = null, evt_permitreviewedby = null, evt_permitreviewedname = null, evt_permitreviewedtype = null
                            WHERE evt_code = @sPevEvent
                        end

                     if    @sRentity = N'PERM'  
                        begin
                           /*****************************************************************************
                           *  This trigger code is absorbing the following package calls:       
                           *     O7EVENTTEMP_addpermevent_add
                           *     O7EVENTTEMP_CLEARTEMPTABLE_ADD
                           *****************************************************************************/
                           
                           declare c_eventcursor cursor local for select pev_event from r5permevents where pev_permit = @sCode
                                    open c_eventcursor
                           fetch next from c_eventcursor into @sPevEvent
                           while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                              begin
                                 set @dGetdate = GetDate()

                                 UPDATE r5events
                                 SET    evt_updated = @dGetdate
                                 WHERE  evt_code    = @sPevEvent

create trigger POSUPD_ADI
on R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     		bigint
	declare @nTransorgid  		bigint
	declare @nTransgroup  		integer
	declare @sTrans       		nvarchar(4)         

	declare @nReturn			integer       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.ADI_TRANSID,	i.ADI_TRANSORGID,	
														i.ADI_TRANSGROUP,	i.ADI_TRANS
													from inserted i
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTrans
					
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							
							--The Oracle version for some reason puts rows in a temporary table and then 
							--	cursors through those rows and calls o7interface.arcupd for each row in there.
							--  I am going to just make the o7interface call as I go through the rows here.

							execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ARCUPD @nTransid, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, @sTrans, N'C', N'R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE', N'ADI'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTrans
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

          set @sX = NULL
          set @sCheckresult = N'0'    
          set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
          if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
              begin
                  declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.alt_code, i.alt_gridid, d.alt_gridid, i.alt_desc, d.alt_desc
                                                       from inserted i, deleted d
                                                      where i.alt_sqlidentity = d.alt_sqlidentity
                  open c_ins_del
                  fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @nGridid, @nOldGridid, @sDesc, @sOldDesc
                  while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                      begin
  
                         /* Update r5descriptions */
                        execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ALRT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, null, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            begin
                                close c_ins_del
                                deallocate c_ins_del
                                rollback transaction
                                return
                            end
          
                        if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                            begin
                                close c_ins_del
                                deallocate c_ins_del
                                execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                rollback transaction
                                return
                            end

                          if @nGridid <> @nOldGridid
                              begin
                                  execute @nReturn = o7alert_syncgridparameters @sCode, @nGridid
                                  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                      begin
                                          close c_ins_del
                                          deallocate c_ins_del
                                          rollback transaction
                                          return
                                      end
                              end
                          fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @nGridid, @nOldGridid, @sDesc, @sOldDesc
                      end
                  close c_ins_del
                  deallocate c_ins_del
              end
      end

create trigger POSUPD_AQU
on R5ACTQUALIFICATIONS
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAct         		numeric(8,0)
	declare @sQualification   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sSource        	nvarchar(1)        
	declare @sRemoved   	    nvarchar(1)
	declare @nUpdatecount 		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer
	declare @sOldEvent       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOLdAct         		numeric(8,0) 
	declare @sOldQualification   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldSource        	nvarchar(1)        
	declare @sOldRemoved   	    nvarchar(1)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nReturn		integer

	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype			nvarchar(4)
	
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent	nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dInterface		datetime

	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.AQU_EVENT,	i.AQU_ACTIVITY,	i.AQU_QUALIFICATION,	i.AQU_SOURCE,	i.AQU_REMOVED,
													  	i.AQU_UPDATECOUNT,	i.AQU_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.AQU_EVENT,	d.AQU_ACTIVITY,	d.AQU_QUALIFICATION,	d.AQU_SOURCE,	d.AQU_REMOVED,
													  	d.AQU_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.AQU_SQLIDENTITY = d.AQU_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@sQualification,	@sSource,	@sRemoved,
													@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldEvent,	@nOldAct,	@sOldQualification,	@sOldSource,	@sOldRemoved,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/**************************************************************************
							
							The following code is for Databridge work order outbound event
							
							**************************************************************************/
							select	@sRstatus = evt_rstatus,
								@sRtype = evt_rtype,
								@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
								@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
								@sEventOrg = evt_org,
								@dInterface = evt_interface
							from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

							if (@sRtype = N'JOB' or @sRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sRstatus = N'C' or @sRstatus = N'R') 
							begin

								select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
								from r5install
								where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

								if @sFlag = N'A'
								begin
								    select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
								    from r5ucodes
								    where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
								    if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin

										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sFlag = N'A' and @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@sQualification,	@sSource,	@sRemoved,
													@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldEvent,	@nOldAct,	@sOldQualification,	@sOldSource,	@sOldRemoved,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

                        END

on R5BOOKEDHOURS
for update

as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)

	declare @sForgetme			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sPersonorgupdate		nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			execute O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
			execute O7SESS_CUR_INPERSONORGUPDATE @sPersonorgupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.BOO_EVENT 
												from inserted i
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sForgetme = N'FALSE' and @sPersonorgupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							--posupd_boo
							IF @sEvent IS NOT NULL
								/* Flag WO as to recalculate costs. */
								UPDATE r5eventcost
								SET    evo_recalccost = N'+', evo_costcalculated = N'-'
								WHERE  evo_event = @sEvent
								AND    ISNULL( evo_recalccost, N'-' ) <> N'+'

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

						 i.cam_UDFCHAR18, i.cam_UDFCHAR19, i.cam_UDFCHAR20, i.cam_UDFCHAR21,
						 i.cam_UDFCHAR22, i.cam_UDFCHAR23, i.cam_UDFCHAR24, i.cam_UDFCHAR25,
						 i.cam_UDFCHAR26, i.cam_UDFCHAR27, i.cam_UDFCHAR28, i.cam_UDFCHAR29,
						 i.cam_UDFCHAR30, i.cam_UDFNUM01,  i.cam_UDFNUM02,  i.cam_UDFNUM03,
						 i.cam_UDFNUM04,  i.cam_UDFNUM05,  i.cam_UDFDATE01, i.cam_UDFDATE02, 
						 i.cam_UDFDATE03, i.cam_UDFDATE04, i.cam_UDFDATE05, i.cam_UDFCHKBOX01,
						 i.cam_UDFCHKBOX02, i.cam_UDFCHKBOX03, i.cam_UDFCHKBOX04, i.cam_UDFCHKBOX05,
						 d.cam_status, d.cam_desc, i.cam_lastsaved
        FROM   inserted i, deleted d
        WHERE  i.cam_sqlidentity = d.cam_sqlidentity
      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
          RETURN
        END
      SET @sX = NULL
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'

          OPEN c_ins_del

          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @sCheckresult = N'0'
              IF @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
                BEGIN
                  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CAMP', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                  IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                    BEGIN
                      CLOSE c_ins_del
                      DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                      ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                      RETURN
                    END
                END
              IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                BEGIN
                  CLOSE c_ins_del
                  DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                  EXECUTE O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                  RETURN
                END
              IF COALESCE( @sOldClass , N'*' ) <> N'*' AND
                ( @sOldClass <> COALESCE( @sClass , N'*' ) OR @sOldClassOrg <> COALESCE( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
                BEGIN
                  DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
                  WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CAMP'
                  AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
                  AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
                  AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sOldOrg
                END
                
              				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno1 OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	      				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	      				begin
	      					close c_inserted
	      					deallocate c_inserted
	      					rollback transaction
	      					return
	      				end
	      
	      				execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
	      				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	      				begin
	      					close c_inserted
	      					deallocate c_inserted
	      					rollback transaction
	      					return
	      				end
	      
	      				execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
	      				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	      				begin
	      					close c_inserted
	      					deallocate c_inserted
	      					rollback transaction
	      					return
	      				end
	      
	      				execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
	      				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	      				begin
	      					close c_inserted

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_CAT
ON R5CATALOGUE
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
DECLARE 
  @old_ref          NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @new_ref          NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @new_part         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @new_part_org     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @new_supplier     NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @new_supplier_org NVARCHAR( 15 )
IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON    
  DECLARE cur_cat CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT d.cat_ref, i.cat_ref, i.cat_part, i.cat_part_org, i.cat_supplier, i.cat_supplier_org
  FROM INSERTED i, DELETED d
  WHERE i.cat_sqlidentity = d.cat_sqlidentity
  OPEN cur_cat
  FETCH NEXT FROM cur_cat INTO @old_ref, @new_ref, @new_part, @new_part_org, @new_supplier, @new_supplier_org
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    IF dbo.O7GTSUSR() <> N'SYS' AND COALESCE( @new_ref, '###' ) <> COALESCE( @old_ref, '###' )
    BEGIN
      UPDATE r5blanketordlines 
      SET    bll_ref                    = @new_ref
      WHERE  bll_part                   = @new_part
      AND    bll_part_org               = @new_part_org
      AND    COALESCE( bll_ref, '###' ) = COALESCE( @old_ref, '###' )
      AND    bll_blanketorder IN (
        SELECT blo_blanketorder 
        FROM   r5blanketorders
        WHERE  blo_supplier     = @new_supplier
        AND    blo_supplier_org = @new_supplier_org
        AND    blo_rstatus      <> 'C'
        AND    ( blo_end IS NULL OR ( blo_end >= CAST( GETDATE() AS DATE ) ) )
        AND    ( blo_maxamount IS NULL OR blo_curamountrel IS NULL OR blo_maxamount > blo_curamountrel )
      )    
    END
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_cat INTO @old_ref, @new_ref, @new_part, @new_part_org, @new_supplier, @new_supplier_org
  END
  CLOSE cur_cat
  DEALLOCATE cur_cat
END

create trigger POSUPD_CPR
on R5CAPITALPLANNINGREQUESTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sSysUser           nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCode              nvarchar(30)        
    declare @sOrg               nvarchar(15)        
    declare @sStatus            nvarchar(4) 
    declare @sRStatus            nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldCode           nvarchar(30)        
    declare @sOldOrg            nvarchar(15)        
    declare @sOldStatus         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldRStatus         nvarchar(4)
        
    declare @nReturn            int   
    declare @sTempMsgid         nvarchar(256)
    declare @sCapreq		nvarchar(80)
             

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
        SET NOCOUNT ON
        declare c_ins_del cursor local for select    i.CPR_CODE,    
                                                     i.CPR_ORG,    
                                                     i.CPR_STATUS,   
                                                     i.CPR_RSTATUS,
                                                     d.CPR_CODE,    
                                                     d.CPR_ORG,    
                                                     d.CPR_STATUS,
                                                     d.CPR_RSTATUS
                                            from inserted i, deleted d
                                            where i.CPR_SQLIDENTITY = d.CPR_SQLIDENTITY
        set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
        if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
          begin
            open c_ins_del
            fetch next from c_ins_del into     @sCode,    @sOrg,    @sStatus,	@sRStatus,	@sOldCode,    @sOldOrg,    @sOldStatus,	@sOldRStatus
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
			 --Databridge Outbound Events
            set @sCapreq = N'N'
            select @sCapreq = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N' ) FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CAPREQ'

            if upper(@sCapreq) = N'Y'
              begin        
                if @sRstatus <> N'U'
                  begin
                    EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      begin
                        close c_ins_del
                        deallocate c_ins_del
                        rollback transaction
                        return
                      end
                                            
                    INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
                    (    XTS_TRANTYPE,
                        XTS_TABLE,
                        XTS_KEYFLD1,
                        XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID, 
                        XTS_ORG)
                    SELECT    N'CAPREQ',
                        N'R5CAPITALPLANNINGREQUESTS', 
                        @sCode,
                        @sTempMsgid,
                        @sOrg 
                    from DUAL
                    where not exists(select 1 from R5XMLTRANSTATUS where XTS_TRANTYPE=N'CAPREQ' and XTS_TABLE=N'R5CAPITALPLANNINGREQUESTS' 
                    and XTS_KEYFLD1=@sCode and XTS_ORG=@sOrg)
                  end
			   end   

            if upper(@sCapreq) = N'S'
				begin
						if @sStatus <> @sOldStatus
						begin
							EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
								close c_ins_del
								deallocate c_ins_del
								rollback transaction
								return
							end
                                            
							INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
							(    XTS_TRANTYPE,
								XTS_TABLE,
								XTS_KEYFLD1,
								XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID, 
								XTS_ORG)
							SELECT    N'CAPREQ',
								N'R5CAPITALPLANNINGREQUESTS', 
								@sCode,
								@sTempMsgid,
								@sOrg 
							from DUAL
							where not exists (select 1
									  from R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									  where XTS_TRANTYPE=N'CAPREQ'
									  	and XTS_TABLE=N'R5CAPITALPLANNINGREQUESTS'
									  	and XTS_KEYFLD1=@sCode
									  	and XTS_ORG=@sOrg)
						end
				end
			  fetch next from c_ins_del into     @sCode,    @sOrg,    @sStatus,	@sRStatus,  @sOldCode,    @sOldOrg,    @sOldStatus,	@sOldRStatus
            end
            close c_ins_del
          end
        deallocate c_ins_del
      end

    declare @sUser                nvarchar(38)

    declare @sReviewed            datetime
    declare @sOldReviewed         datetime
    declare @sReviewedBy          nvarchar(255)
    declare @sUpdated             datetime
    declare @sUpdatedBy           nvarchar(255)
    declare @sStatus              nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldStatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRStatus             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldRStatus          nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn              int
    declare @nWOReturn            int
    declare @nErecord             int
    declare @vtemp                nvarchar(4)
    declare @sInobjectupdate      nvarchar(10)
    declare @sLogEventType        nvarchar(8)
    declare @sLogReviewedBy       nvarchar(255)
    declare @sSeqno               bigint
	declare @sCsmgmt			  nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid           nvarchar(256)

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
            declare c_updated cursor local for select i.csm_code, i.csm_org, i.csm_desc, d.csm_desc, i.csm_wo_desc, d.csm_wo_desc,
                    i.csm_reviewed, i.csm_reviewedtype, i.csm_status, i.csm_rstatus, 
                    i.csm_updated, i.csm_updatedby, i.csm_reviewedby, 
                    d.csm_reviewed, d.csm_reviewedtype, d.csm_status, d.csm_rstatus
                    from inserted i, deleted d
                    where i.csm_sqlidentity = d.csm_sqlidentity
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                begin
                    open c_updated 
                    fetch next from c_updated into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldDesc, @sWODesc, @sOldWODesc, 
                        @sReviewed, @sReviewedType, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sUpdated, @sUpdatedBy, @sReviewedBy, 
                        @sOldReviewed, @sOldReviewedType, @sOldStatus, @sOldRStatus 
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sKeyCode = @sCode
                            if @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
                                begin
                                    execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CASE', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode , @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                                end    
                            /* WO Description updates */
							IF @sWODesc IS NOT NULL AND @sOldWODesc IS NULL
								BEGIN
									execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CASW', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
								END
							ELSE IF @sWODesc IS NULL AND @sOldWODesc IS NOT NULL
								BEGIN
									execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CASW', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
								END
							ELSE IF @sWODesc <> @sOldWODesc 
								BEGIN
									execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CASW', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
								END
                                    
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_updated
                                    deallocate c_updated
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                                

                            execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                    begin
                                        close c_inserted
                                        deallocate c_inserted
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                                    end

							set @sLogEventType = null
                            set @sLogReviewedBy = @sReviewedBy
                            set @sLogReviewedType = @sReviewedType
                            if @sOldStatus <> @sStatus
                              begin
                                set @sLogEventType = 'ST'
                                set @sLogReviewedBy = @sUpdatedBy
                                end
                            else if ISNULL( @sOldReviewed, getDate() + 1 ) <> @sReviewed
                              begin
                                set @sLogEventType = 'ESIG'
                                set @sUpdatedBy = @sReviewedBy
                                execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @vtemp OUTPUT, @sReviewedType, N'ESTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                              end
                              
                            if @sLogEventType IS NOT NULL
                             begin
                               execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'CML', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                               INSERT INTO r5casemanagementeventlog( cml_code, cml_casecode, cml_eventtype, cml_eventlog_date, cml_fromstatus, cml_tostatus, cml_esigntype, cml_user,
           								cml_created, cml_createdby )
                               VALUES( @sSeqno, @sCode, @sLogEventType, dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), @sOldStatus, @sStatus, @sLogReviewedType, @sLogReviewedBy,
                                        dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), @sUserid)
                             end

                            execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'UPD', N'CASE', @sOldStatus, @sStatus
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                              begin
                                close c_updated
                                deallocate c_updated
                                rollback transaction
                                return
                              end

                            if @nErecord > 0 
                              begin
                                /* Elec archive. */

                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                  begin
                                    close c_updated
                                    deallocate c_updated
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                  end
                              end
							  
							--Databridge Outbound Events for EAM-32443 Start
							set @sCsmgmt = N'N'
							select @sCsmgmt = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N' ) FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CSMGMT'

							if upper(@sCsmgmt) = N'Y'
							  begin        
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									  begin

create trigger POSUPD_CTA
on R5CASETASKS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)
  declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCode             nvarchar(30)
  declare @sOrg              nvarchar(15)
  declare @sDesc             nvarchar(80)
  declare @sOldDesc          nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWODesc		     nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWOOldDesc		 nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWOCheckresult    nvarchar(4)
  declare @nWOReturn	     int
  declare @nReturn           int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.cta_code, i.cta_servicecode_org, i.cta_desc, i.cta_standwork_desc, 
    d.cta_desc, d.cta_standwork_desc  
    from   inserted i, deleted d 
    where i.cta_sqlidentity = d.cta_sqlidentity

    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
      open c_ins_del
      fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sWODesc, @sOldDesc, @sWOOldDesc 
      

      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        
        --POSUPD_CTA portion

        set @sX = NULL
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'
        set @sWOCheckresult = N'0'

        /* Update descriptions */
        IF @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
			BEGIN
				execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CSTK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, 
                  @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
            END

        /* WO Description updates */
		IF @sWODesc IS NOT NULL AND @sWOOldDesc IS NULL
			BEGIN
		    	execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CSTW', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
			 END
		ELSE IF @sWODesc IS NULL AND @sWOOldDesc IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
		    	execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CSTW', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
			END
		ELSE IF @sWODesc <> @sWOOldDesc 
			BEGIN
		    	execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CSTW', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
			END
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_ins_del
          deallocate c_ins_del
          rollback transaction
          return
        end  
        
        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sWODesc, @sOldDesc, @sWOOldDesc
      end
      close c_ins_del
    end
    deallocate c_ins_del
  end

create trigger POSUPD_CTR
on R5CONTACTRECORDS
for update
as
    declare @sSysUser           nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCode              nvarchar(30)        
    declare @sOrg               nvarchar(15)        
    declare @sDesc              nvarchar(80)        
    declare @sStatus            nvarchar(4) 
    declare @dUpdated           datetime
    declare @sUpdatedBy         nvarchar(255)     

    declare @sOldCode           nvarchar(30)        
    declare @sOldOrg            nvarchar(15)        
    declare @sOldDesc           nvarchar(80) 
    declare @sOldStatus         nvarchar(4)
    declare @dOldUpdated        datetime
    declare @sOldUpdatedBy      nvarchar(255)  
        
    declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn            int   
    declare @sSeqno             nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCallctr           nvarchar(80)
    declare @sTempMsgid         nvarchar(256)
    declare @dReqDate           datetime
             

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
        SET NOCOUNT ON
        declare c_ins_del cursor local for select    i.CTR_CODE,    
                                                     i.CTR_ORG,    
                                                     i.CTR_DESC,    
                                                     i.CTR_STATUS,    
                                                     i.CTR_UPDATED,
                                                     i.CTR_UPDATEDBY,
                                                     d.CTR_CODE,    
                                                     d.CTR_ORG,    
                                                     d.CTR_DESC,    
                                                     d.CTR_STATUS,    
                                                     d.CTR_UPDATED,
                                                     d.CTR_UPDATEDBY
                                            from inserted i, deleted d
                                            where i.CTR_SQLIDENTITY = d.CTR_SQLIDENTITY
        set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
        if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
          begin
            open c_ins_del
            fetch next from c_ins_del into     @sCode,    @sOrg,    @sDesc,    @sStatus,    @dUpdated,@sUpdatedBy,
                                               @sOldCode,    @sOldOrg,    @sOldDesc,    @sOldStatus,    @dOldUpdated,@sOldUpdatedBy
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
              begin
                set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                     
                if coalesce(@sStatus,'#') <> coalesce(@sOldStatus,'#')
                  begin
                    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'CRH', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                      begin
                        close c_ins_del
                        deallocate c_ins_del
                        rollback transaction
                        return
                      end
                    execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dReqDate OUTPUT, null 
                                 INSERT INTO R5CustomerRequestHistory(
                                   CRH_PK,
                                   CRH_CALLCENTERCODE,
                                   CRH_CALLCENTER_ORG,
                                   CRH_REQDATE, 
                                   CRH_EVENTTYPE, 
                                   CRH_USERCODE,
                                   CRH_FIELD, 
                                   CRH_OLDVALUE, 
                                   CRH_NEWVALUE,
                                   CRH_RENTITY)
                                   VALUES( @sSeqno,
                                           @sCode,
                                           @sOrg,
                                           @dReqDate, 
                                           N'SU', 
                                           @sUpdatedby,
                                           null, 
                                           @sOldStatus,
                                           @sStatus,
                                           N'COCT')    
                  end                                     

                --Databridge Outbound Events
                set @sCallctr = N'N'
                select @sCallctr = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N' ) FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@CALLCTR'
        
                if upper(@sCallctr) = N'Y'
                  begin
                    EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                      begin
                        close c_ins_del
                        deallocate c_ins_del
                        rollback transaction
                        return
                      end
                                            
                    INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
                    (    XTS_TRANTYPE,
                        XTS_TABLE,
                        XTS_KEYFLD1,
                        XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID, 
                        XTS_ORG)
                    SELECT    N'CALLCENTER',
                        N'R5CONTACTRECORDS', 
                        @sCode,
                        @sTempMsgid,
                        @sOrg 
                    from DUAL
                    where not exists(select 1 from R5XMLTRANSTATUS where XTS_TRANTYPE=N'CALLCENTER' and XTS_TABLE=N'R5CONTACTRECORDS' 
                    and XTS_KEYFLD1=@sCode and XTS_ORG=@sOrg)
                  end

                if @sStatus <> @sOldStatus
                  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7createsurveyevents N'COCT', @sCode, @sOrg, @sStatus
                
                fetch next from c_ins_del into     @sCode,    @sOrg,    @sDesc,    @sStatus,    @dUpdated,@sUpdatedBy,
                                                   @sOldCode,    @sOldOrg,    @sOldDesc,    @sOldStatus,    @dOldUpdated,@sOldUpdatedBy
              end
            close c_ins_del
          end
        deallocate c_ins_del
      end

create trigger POSUPD_DAE
on R5DOCENTITIES
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sREntity			nvarchar(30)
	declare @dGetdate			datetime
	declare @sUserid			nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select DAE_RENTITY,DAE_CODE from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sREntity,@sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if @sREntity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sCode and ets_updatecount <> -999
							end
							if @sRentity = N'PRME'
								begin
							        execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
							        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								        begin
									        close c_inserted
									        deallocate c_inserted
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
									set @dGetdate = GetDate()
									UPDATE r5permevents 
									   SET pev_reviewed = null, pev_reviewedby = null, pev_reviewedname = null, pev_reviewedtype = null, pev_updated = @dGetdate, pev_updatedby = @sUserid
									 WHERE pev_code = @sCode;
									UPDATE r5events 
									   SET evt_permitreviewed = null, evt_permitreviewedby = null, evt_permitreviewedname = null, evt_permitreviewedtype = null
									 WHERE evt_code = (select pev_event from r5permevents where pev_code = @sCode);
								end
							/* Reset Permit To Work esignature information. */
							if @sRentity IN (N'PTW', N'SFWO', N'LTPW')
							begin
								UPDATE r5permittowork SET ptw_reviewed = null, ptw_reviewedby = null, ptw_reviewedtype = null WHERE ptw_code = @sCode
							end
							/* Reset Case Management esignature information. */
							if @sRentity = N'CASE'
							begin
								UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sCode
							end
							
							if @sRentity = N'CMTK'
							begin
								UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null 
								WHERE csm_code = (SELECT tcm_casemanagement FROM r5casemanagementtasks 
								WHERE csm_code = tcm_casemanagement AND tcm_code = @sCode)
							end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sREntity,@sCode
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

   DECLARE @nReturn           int

         DECLARE c_ins_del CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT i.dcr_code, i.dcr_org, i.dcr_desc 
         FROM inserted i

         SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
               OPEN c_ins_del
               FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc
               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                     SET @sX = NULL
                     SET @sCheckresult = N'0'
                     /* Update descriptions */
                     EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'DCUR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        BEGIN

                           DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                           ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                           RETURN
                        END
                     FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc
                  END
               CLOSE c_ins_del
            END
         DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
      END

	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)

													  	d.DEB_ORG,	d.DEB_CLASS_ORG,	d.DEB_TYPE,	d.DEB_RTYPE,	d.DEB_UPDATECOUNT
													  
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.DEB_SQLIDENTITY = d.DEB_SQLIDENTITY

create trigger POSUPD_DEP
on r5depots
for update
as
	declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn        int
	declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode       nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldOrg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sClass         nvarchar(8)
    declare @sOldClass      nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClass_org     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOldClass_org  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDeforg        nvarchar(200)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.dep_code, i.dep_org, i.dep_desc, i.dep_class, i.dep_class_org, d.dep_class, d.dep_class_org, d.dep_code, d.dep_org
                                                 from inserted i, deleted d
                                                where i.dep_sqlidentity = d.dep_sqlidentity

			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					deallocate c_ins_del
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClass_org, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
                			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'DEPO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass , N'*' ) <> N'*' and 
							 (@sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass , N'*' ) or @sOldClass_org <> coalesce( @sClass_org, @sDeforg ) )
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'DEPO'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sOldOrg
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClass_org, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_DOC
ON r5documents
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @sUser			NVARCHAR(38)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sX			NVARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @nReturn		INT
	DECLARE @sDeforg		NVARCHAR(200)

	-- Cursor Variables
	DECLARE @sOldCode		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sOldOrg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @sOldDesc		NVARCHAR(80)
	DECLARE @sOldType		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sOldRType		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sOldClass		NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @sOldClassOrg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @nOldUpdCount		int

	DECLARE @sNewCode		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sNewOrg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @sNewDesc		NVARCHAR(80)
	DECLARE @sNewType		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sNewRType		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sNewClass		NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @sNewClassOrg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @nNewUpdCount		int
	DECLARE @iSQLIdent		BIGINT

	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
				BEGIN
					DECLARE c_Upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
						SELECT 	i.doc_code, 		d.doc_code,
								i.doc_org, 			d.doc_org,
								i.doc_desc,			d.doc_desc,
								i.doc_type, 		d.doc_type,
								i.doc_rtype, 		d.doc_rtype,
								i.doc_class,		d.doc_class,
								i.doc_class_org,	d.doc_class_org,
								i.doc_updatecount,	d.doc_updatecount,
								i.doc_sqlidentity
						FROM 	inserted i, deleted d
						WHERE	i.doc_sqlidentity = d.doc_sqlidentity

					OPEN c_Upd

					FETCH NEXT 
					FROM	c_Upd 
					INTO	@sNewCode,		@sOldCode,
							@sNewOrg,		@sOldOrg,
							@sNewDesc,		@sOldDesc,
							@sNewType,		@sOldType,
							@sNewRType,		@sOldRType,
							@sNewClass,		@sOldClass,
							@sNewClassOrg,	@sOldClassOrg,
							@nOldUpdCount,	@nNewUpdCount,
							@iSQLIdent
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							-- After Each Row Trigger Action
							SET @sCheckresult = N'0'
							SET @sX = NULL
							EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_Upd
									DEALLOCATE c_Upd
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END

							IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_Upd
									DEALLOCATE c_Upd
									EXECUTE O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END

							EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'DOCU', @sX, N'*', @sNewCode, @sNewOrg, @sNewDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_Upd
									DEALLOCATE c_Upd
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END

							IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_Upd
									DEALLOCATE c_Upd
									EXECUTE O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END

							IF COALESCE(@sOldClass, '*') <> '*' AND
								(@sOldClass <> COALESCE(@sNewClass, '*') OR
								 @sOldClass <> COALESCE(@sNewClass, @sDeforg))
								BEGIN
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE	r5propertyvalues.prv_rentity = 'DOCU'
										AND	r5propertyvalues.prv_class = @sOldClass
										AND	r5propertyvalues.prv_class_org = @sOldClassOrg
										AND	r5propertyvalues.prv_code = @sOldCode + '#' + @sOldOrg
								END

							FETCH NEXT 
							FROM 	c_Upd 
							INTO 	@sNewCode,		@sOldCode,
									@sNewOrg,		@sOldOrg,
									@sNewDesc,		@sOldDesc,
									@sNewType,		@sOldType,
									@sNewRType,		@sOldRType,
									@sNewClass,		@sOldClass,
									@sNewClassOrg,	@sOldClassOrg,
									@nOldUpdCount,	@nNewUpdCount,
									@iSQLIdent
						END
					CLOSE c_Upd
        			DEALLOCATE c_Upd
				END
		END
END
