create trigger POSUPD_DRV
on R5DRIVERCTRL
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(10)        
	declare @sQueue      		nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sAction     		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             
	
	declare @nReturn		integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	DRV_CODE,	DRV_QUEUE,	DRV_ACTION,	DRV_SQLIDENTITY
													from r5driverctrl

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sQueue,	@sAction,	@nSqlidentity

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sAction = N'+' 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = o7drvctl_driver_on @sCode OUTPUT, @sQueue OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end
								end
							ELSE
								begin
									execute @nReturn = o7drvctl_driver_off @sCode OUTPUT, @sQueue OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								end
							UPDATE r5driverctrl
							SET    drv_lastsaved = getdate()
							WHERE  drv_sqlidentity = @nSqlidentity
							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sQueue,	@sAction,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

on R5EQUIPFUNCTIONLEVELS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)
  declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCode             nvarchar(30)
  declare @sDesc             nvarchar(80)
  declare @sFunctionFailure  nvarchar(30)
  declare @nReturn           int
  declare @sInobjectupdate   nvarchar(10)


  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
    
    declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.efl_code, i.efl_desc,i.efl_functionfailure  
    from   inserted i

    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    
    if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
    begin
      open c_ins_del
      fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sFunctionFailure 
      

      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        
        --POSUPD_EFL portion

        set @sX = NULL
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'

        /* Update descriptions */
        if @sFunctionFailure is null
        begin
            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'EQFL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, 
                      @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            begin
              close c_ins_del
              deallocate c_ins_del
              rollback transaction
              return
            end 
        end
        
        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sFunctionFailure
      end
      close c_ins_del
    end
    deallocate c_ins_del
  end

on R5EVENTSINTERFACE

	declare @sSysUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid        		bigint
	declare @nTransorgid     		bigint
	declare @nTransgroup     		integer
	declare @sTrans          		nvarchar(4)         

	declare @nReturn				integer
	declare @sInobjectupdate		nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.EVI_TRANSID,	i.EVI_TRANSORGID,	i.EVI_TRANSGROUP,	i.EVI_TRANS
												from inserted i
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTrans

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--The Oracle version for some reason puts rows in a temporary table and then 
							--	cursors through those rows and calls o7interface.arcupd for each row in there.
							--  I am going to just make the o7interface call as I go through the rows here.

							execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ARCUPD @nTransid, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, @sTrans, N'E', N'R5EVENTSINTERFACE', N'EVI'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTrans
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_GFD
ON R5GRIDFIELD
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
declare @sUser  nvarchar(38)
declare @GRD_GRIDNAME nvarchar(40)
declare @GFD_TAGNAME  nvarchar(60)
declare @GFD_OLDTAGNAME  nvarchar(60)
declare @GFD_GRIDID numeric(14,0)

if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare c_updated cursor local for select i.GFD_TAGNAME, d.GFD_TAGNAME GFD_OLDTAGNAME, i.GFD_GRIDID from inserted i inner join deleted d on
			i.gfd_gridid = d.gfd_gridid and  i.gfd_fieldid=d.gfd_fieldid and i.gfd_occurrence= d.gfd_occurrence			
    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
        open c_updated
        fetch next from c_updated into @GFD_TAGNAME, @GFD_OLDTAGNAME, @GFD_GRIDID
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
				SELECT @GRD_GRIDNAME = GRD_GRIDNAME				 
				FROM r5grid
				WHERE GRD_GRIDID= @GFD_GRIDID;
					
				if	@GFD_TAGNAME COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS <> @GFD_OLDTAGNAME COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS AND 
					(CHARINDEX('U', @GRD_GRIDNAME) = 2 OR CHARINDEX('_X', @GRD_GRIDNAME)>0)
				begin						
					if CHARINDEX('U', @GRD_GRIDNAME) = 2 
					begin
						SET @GRD_GRIDNAME = @GRD_GRIDNAME + '_LST'
					end
					UPDATE r5hyperlink
					SET hyp_sourceelementid = @GFD_TAGNAME
					WHERE hyp_sourcepagename = @GRD_GRIDNAME AND
					hyp_sourceelementid = @GFD_OLDTAGNAME;
										 
				end
		
            fetch next from c_updated into @GFD_TAGNAME, @GFD_OLDTAGNAME, @GFD_GRIDID
        End
        Close c_updated
    End
    deallocate c_updated
End

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_GPR
ON r5genproductrequest
AFTER UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sUser            NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @nSession         NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sBundle          NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @nReturn          INT
  DECLARE @sInobjectupdate  NVARCHAR(10)

 IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
   BEGIN
     SET NOCOUNT ON
     EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
     DECLARE c_ins_del CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
       SELECT d.gpr_sessionid, d.gpr_bundle 
       FROM   inserted i, deleted d
       WHERE  i.gpr_sqlidentity = d.gpr_sqlidentity
       AND    d.gpr_bundle IS NOT NULL
       AND    i.gpr_bundle IS NULL

     SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
     IF @sUser <> N'SYS' AND @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
       BEGIN
         OPEN c_ins_del 
         FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nSession, @sBundle
         WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
           BEGIN
             -- Delete bundle, if no/one work order associated.
             DELETE FROM r5genproductrequest
             WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSession
             AND    gpr_bundle  = @sBundle
             AND    gpr_event IS NULL
             AND    1 >= ( SELECT count(*)
                           FROM   r5genproductrequest
                           WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSession
                           AND    gpr_bundle    = @sBundle
                           AND    gpr_event IS NOT NULL )

             -- If there is one WO in a bundle left, detach it. 
             UPDATE r5genproductrequest
             SET    gpr_bundle = NULL
             WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSession
             AND    gpr_bundle  = @sBundle
             AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                FROM   r5genproductrequest 
                                WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSession
                                AND    gpr_bundle = @sBundle
                                AND    gpr_event IS NULL )

             FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nSession, @sBundle
           END
         CLOSE c_ins_del
         DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
       END
   END

create trigger POSUPD_INS
on R5INSTALL
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
   declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
   declare @nCount            int
   declare @nOldUpdateCount   int
   declare @nUpdatecount      int
   declare @nReturn         int
   declare @nSqlIdentity      int
   declare @sCode            nvarchar(8)
   declare @sDesc            nvarchar(200)
   declare @sOldCode         nvarchar(8)
   declare @sOldDesc         nvarchar(200)
   declare @sCurrUser         nvarchar(255)
   declare @sFuncode         nvarchar(6)
   declare @sUgrcode         nvarchar(12)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
         if @nCount = 0
            --INSERTING
            begin

               declare c_inserted cursor local for select   INS_CODE, INS_DESC, INS_SQLIDENTITY
                                             from inserted
               set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
               if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                  begin
                     open c_inserted
                     fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @nSqlIdentity
                     while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                           --After EACH ROW portion

                           IF @sCode = 'MULTIORG' AND UPPER( @sDesc ) IN ( N'ON', N'+', N'Y', N'YES' )
                              UPDATE r5entitytables
                              SET    ett_mos = N'+'
                              WHERE  ett_rentity IN ( N'PROJ', N'EVNT', N'STOR', N'REQ',  N'QUOT',
                                                      N'BORD', N'PORD', N'TRAN', N'INV',  N'AGR',
                                                      N'BSTR', N'CONT', N'DISP', N'RMA',  N'EIV',
                                                      N'WKPK', N'DOCK', N'SERQ', N'CLAI', N'AVAR',
                                                      N'FCUS', N'FTIC', N'FBIL', N'DEFM', N'RFQ',
                                                      N'RFQR', N'CPRQ', N'DEPO', N'REGN', N'EEVL',
                                                      N'PEVL', N'PREQ', N'CAMP', N'EQGN', N'PTW',  
                                                      N'PTWS', N'OPCK', N'CASE', N'NOCF', N'ASTL',
                                                      N'MNBK', N'PCKG' )
                              AND    ett_mos = N'-'

                           if @sCode = N'STYLECD'
                              update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount

                           fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @nSqlIdentity
                        end
                     close c_inserted
                  end
               deallocate c_inserted
            end
         else
            --UPDATING
            begin
               declare c_ins_del cursor local for select   i.INS_CODE, i.INS_DESC, i.INS_SQLIDENTITY, i.INS_UPDATECOUNT, d.INS_UPDATECOUNT, d.INS_DESC
                                          from inserted i, deleted d
                                 where   i.INS_SQLIDENTITY      = d.INS_SQLIDENTITY

               set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
               if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                  begin
                     open c_ins_del
                     fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @nSqlIdentity, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @sOldDesc

                     while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin

                           --BEFORE EACH ROW portion

                           if @sCode = N'OPT_TAGS'
                              begin
                                 if @sOldDesc <> N'+' and @sDesc = N'+'
                                    begin
                                       /* Check whether there is a position with multiple asset children. */
                                       SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*)
                                       FROM   r5structures
                                       WHERE  stc_parentrtype = N'P'
                                       AND    stc_childrtype  = N'A'
                                       GROUP BY stc_parent, stc_parent_org
                                       HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
                                       if isnull( @nCount, 0 ) > 1
                                          begin
                                             close c_ins_del
                                             deallocate c_ins_del
                                             execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_INS', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
                                             rollback transaction
                                             return
                                          end
                                       /* Check whether there is a equipment configuration position with multiple asset children. */
                                       SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*)
                                       FROM   r5ucodes u1, r5ucodes u2, r5objects o1, r5objects o2, r5equipconfigstructures
                                       WHERE  o1.obj_code    = ecs_parent
                                       AND    o1.obj_org     = ecs_parent_org
                                       AND    o2.obj_code    = ecs_child
                                       AND    o2.obj_org     = ecs_child_org
                                       AND    u1.uco_rentity = N'OBTP'
                                       AND    u1.uco_code    = o1.obj_configtype 
                                       AND    u1.uco_rcode   = N'P'
                                       AND    u2.uco_rentity = N'OBTP'
                                       AND    u2.uco_code    = o2.obj_configtype 
                                       AND    u2.uco_rcode   = N'A'
                                       GROUP BY ecs_parent, ecs_parent_org
                                       HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
                                       if isnull( @nCount, 0 ) > 1
                                          begin
                                             close c_ins_del
                                             deallocate c_ins_del
                                             execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_INS', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
                                             rollback transaction
                                             return
                                          end
                                    end
                              end

                           --After EACH ROW portion
                           if
                           @sCode = 'MULTIORG' AND UPPER( @sDesc ) IN ( N'ON', N'+', N'Y', N'YES' )
                              UPDATE r5entitytables
                              SET    ett_mos = N'+'
                              WHERE  ett_rentity IN ( N'PROJ', N'EVNT', N'STOR', N'REQ',  N'QUOT',

	declare @nTransorgid   		bigint
	declare @nTransgroup   		integer
	declare @sTrans        		nvarchar(4)         
	
	declare @nReturn			integer           
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.IRI_TRANSID,	i.IRI_TRANSORGID, 	i.IRI_TRANSGROUP,	i.IRI_TRANS
												from inserted i

				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTrans
												
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--The Oracle version for some reason puts rows in a temporary table and then 
							--	cursors through those rows and calls o7interface.arcupd for each row in there.
							--  I am going to just make the o7interface call as I go through the rows here.

							execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ARCUPD @nTransid, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, @sTrans, N'IRI', N'R5INSPECTIONSINTERFACE', N'IRI'

									rollback transaction
									return

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end

create trigger POSUPD_KBA
on R5KBARTICLES
for update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode               		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg                		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDesc               		nvarchar(80)

	declare @sRstatus            		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sServiceproblem     		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sServiceproblem_org 		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sMrc                		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sSupplier           		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sSupplier_org       		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sServicecategory    		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sServicecategory_org		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDocument           		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dCreated            		datetime            
	declare @dUpdated            		datetime            
	declare @sUpdatedby          		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sCreatedby          		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount        		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity        		integer             

	declare @sOldCode               	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldOrg                	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldDesc               	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldStatus             	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRstatus            	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldServiceproblem     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldServiceproblem_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldMrc                	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldSupplier           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldSupplier_org       	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldServicecategory    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldServicecategory_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldDocument           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dOldCreated            	datetime            
	declare @dOldUpdated            	datetime            
	declare @sOldUpdatedby          	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldCreatedby          	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount        	numeric(38,0)  
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int    	      
         

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.KBA_CODE,	i.KBA_ORG,	i.KBA_DESC,	i.KBA_STATUS,	i.KBA_RSTATUS,
													  	i.KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM,	i.KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG,	i.KBA_MRC,	i.KBA_SUPPLIER,	i.KBA_SUPPLIER_ORG,
													  	i.KBA_SERVICECATEGORY,	i.KBA_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,	i.KBA_DOCUMENT,	i.KBA_CREATED,	i.KBA_UPDATED,
													 	i.KBA_UPDATEDBY,	i.KBA_CREATEDBY,	i.KBA_UPDATECOUNT,	i.KBA_SQLIDENTITY,

													  	d.KBA_CODE,	d.KBA_ORG,	d.KBA_DESC,	d.KBA_STATUS,	d.KBA_RSTATUS,
													  	d.KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM,	d.KBA_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG,	d.KBA_MRC,	d.KBA_SUPPLIER,	d.KBA_SUPPLIER_ORG,
													  	d.KBA_SERVICECATEGORY,	d.KBA_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,	d.KBA_DOCUMENT,	d.KBA_CREATED,	d.KBA_UPDATED,
													  	d.KBA_UPDATEDBY,	d.KBA_CREATEDBY,	d.KBA_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.KBA_SQLIDENTITY = d.KBA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
												   	@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@sMrc,	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,
												   	@sServicecategory,	@sServicecategory_org,	@sDocument,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
												   	@sUpdatedby,	@sCreatedby,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,
													@sOldServiceproblem,	@sOldServiceproblem_org,	@sOldMrc,	@sOldSupplier,	@sOldSupplier_org,
													@sOldServicecategory,	@sOldServicecategory_org,	@sOldDocument,	@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated,
													@sOldUpdatedby,	@sOldCreatedby,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							DELETE FROM R5KBACROSSREFERENCE where KRF_KBARTICLE = @sOldCode AND KRF_KBARTICLE_ORG = @sOldOrg

                            if @sRstatus <> N'0'
                                begin
							        execute @nReturn = dbo.O7INSKRF1 @sCode, @sOrg, @sMrc,
											        @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sServiceCategory,
											        @sServicecategory_org, @sServiceProblem, @sServiceproblem_org,
											        @sStatus
							        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								        begin
									        close c_ins_del
									        deallocate c_ins_del
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
                                end

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sX	 = NULL
							/* Delete dependant data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'KWBS', N'*', N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5KBARTICLES set KBA_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where KBA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
														   	@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@sMrc,	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,
														   	@sServicecategory,	@sServicecategory_org,	@sDocument,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
														   	@sUpdatedby,	@sCreatedby,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldCode,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,
															@sOldServiceproblem,	@sOldServiceproblem_org,	@sOldMrc,	@sOldSupplier,	@sOldSupplier_org,
															@sOldServicecategory,	@sOldServicecategory_org,	@sOldDocument,	@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated,
															@sOldUpdatedby,	@sOldCreatedby,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_MAE
ON r5mailevents
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @code           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @template       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @send           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @rstatus        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @notebookemails NVARCHAR( 1 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_ins_del CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT i.mae_code, i.mae_template, i.mae_send, i.mae_rstatus
        FROM   inserted i, deleted d
        WHERE  i.mae_sqlidentity = d.mae_sqlidentity
      OPEN c_ins_del 
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @code, @template, @send, @rstatus
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @send = N'+' AND @rstatus <> N'E'
            BEGIN
              SELECT @notebookemails = mat_notebookemails
              FROM   r5mailtemplate
              WHERE  mat_code = @template
              IF @notebookemails = N'+'
                BEGIN
                  UPDATE r5mobilenotebookemails
                  SET    mne_sent = getdate()
                  WHERE  mne_mailevent = @code
                  AND    mne_sent IS NULL
                END
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @code, @template, @send, @rstatus
        END
      CLOSE c_ins_del
      DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
    END
END

create trigger POSUPD_MST
on R5MATERIALSTANDARDS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @sRevstatus  		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sDesign     		nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sMaterial   		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sStandard   		nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sTempuom    		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sStressuom  		nvarchar(30)

	declare @sSmysuom    		nvarchar(30)

	declare @sSmutsuom   		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sNotused    		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dCreated    		datetime            
	declare @sUser       		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime            
	declare @sUpduser    		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldRevision   	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOldRevrstatus 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRevstatus  	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldDesign     	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sOldMaterial   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldStandard   	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sOldTempuom    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldStressuom  	nvarchar(30)

	declare @sOldSmysuom    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldSmuts      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sOldSmutsuom   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldNotused    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(3)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.MST_CODE,	i.MST_DESC,	i.MST_CLASS,	i.MST_CLASS_ORG,	i.MST_REVISION,
													  	i.MST_REVRSTATUS,	i.MST_REVSTATUS,	i.MST_DESIGN,	i.MST_MATERIAL,	i.MST_STANDARD,
													  	i.MST_TEMPUOM,	i.MST_STRESSUOM,	i.MST_SMYS,	i.MST_SMYSUOM,	i.MST_SMUTS,
													  	i.MST_SMUTSUOM,	i.MST_NOTUSED,	i.MST_CREATED,	i.MST_USER,	i.MST_UPDATED,
													 	i.MST_UPDUSER,	i.MST_UPDATECOUNT,	i.MST_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.MST_CODE,	d.MST_DESC,	d.MST_CLASS,	d.MST_CLASS_ORG,	d.MST_REVISION,
													  	d.MST_REVRSTATUS,	d.MST_REVSTATUS,	d.MST_DESIGN,	d.MST_MATERIAL,	d.MST_STANDARD,
													  	d.MST_TEMPUOM,	d.MST_STRESSUOM,	d.MST_SMYS,	d.MST_SMYSUOM,	d.MST_SMUTS,
													  	d.MST_SMUTSUOM,	d.MST_NOTUSED,	d.MST_CREATED,	d.MST_USER,	d.MST_UPDATED,
													  	d.MST_UPDUSER,	d.MST_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.MST_SQLIDENTITY = d.MST_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nRevision,
												   	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sDesign,	@sMaterial,	@sStandard,
												   	@sTempuom,	@sStressuom,	@nSmys,	@sSmysuom,	@nSmuts,
												   	@sSmutsuom,	@sNotused,	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,
												   	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldRevision,
													@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldDesign,	@sOldMaterial,	@sOldStandard,
													@sOldTempuom,	@sOldStressuom,	@nOldSmys,	@sOldSmysuom,	@nOldSmuts,
													@sOldSmutsuom,	@sOldNotused,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,
													@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MSTD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' and ( @sOldClass <> isnull( @sClass, N'*' ) or @sOldClass_org <> isnull( @sClass_org, @sDeforg) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MSTD'
								AND   prv_class       = @sClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sCode

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nRevision,
														   	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sDesign,	@sMaterial,	@sStandard,
														   	@sTempuom,	@sStressuom,	@nSmys,	@sSmysuom,	@nSmuts,
														   	@sSmutsuom,	@sNotused,	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,
														   	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldRevision,
															@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldDesign,	@sOldMaterial,	@sOldStandard,
															@sOldTempuom,	@sOldStressuom,	@nOldSmys,	@sOldSmysuom,	@nOldSmuts,
															@sOldSmutsuom,	@sOldNotused,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,
															@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger POSUPD_MTK
on r5mptasks
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount   numeric(38,0)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPred			nvarchar(800)
	declare @sName			nvarchar(608)
	declare @nDur			numeric(8)
	declare @dStart			datetime
	declare @dEnd			datetime
	declare @sPriority		nvarchar(32)
	declare @sMpproj		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(120)
	declare @nComplete		numeric(38,0)
	declare @sResintials	nvarchar(2000)
	declare @nWork			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nPersons		numeric(38,0)
	declare @nAct			numeric(38,0)
	declare @sActNote       nvarchar(80)



	declare @nReturn		integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	MTK_PRED, MTK_NAME, MTK_DUR, MTK_START, MTK_END, MTK_PRIORITY, MTK_MPPROJ,
														MTK_EVENT, MTK_COMPLETE, MTK_RESINITIALS, MTK_WORK, MTK_PERSONS, MTK_ACT, MTK_ACTNOTE
														from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sPred, @sName, @nDur, @dStart, @dEnd, @sPriority, @sMpproj,
												@sEvent, @nComplete, @sResintials, @nWork, @nPersons, @nAct, @sActNote
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							IF @nAct = 0
								UPDATE r5mpevents
								SET mpe_pred		= @sPred,
									mpe_mpevtdesc = SUBSTRING(@sName, 1, 80),
									mpe_mpduration = CEILING(@nDur),
									mpe_mptarget = @dStart,
									mpe_schedend = @dEnd,
									mpe_mppriority= @sPriority
								WHERE  mpe_mpproj  = @sMpproj and
										mpe_event = @sEvent




							UPDATE r5mpactivities
							SET mpa_pred = @sPred,
								mpa_mppercrealized	= @nComplete,
								mpa_mpactdesc		= SUBSTRING(@sName,1,80),
								mpa_mpduration		= CEILING(@nDur),
								mpa_mptarget		= @dStart,
								mpa_resinitials		= @sResintials,
								mpa_mpest			= ROUND( @nWork/216000, 2 ),
								mpa_mppersons		= @nPersons,
								mpa_note         = @sActNote
							WHERE	mpa_mpproj  = @sMpproj and
									mpa_event   = @sEvent and
									mpa_act     = @nAct

						end
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sPred, @sName, @nDur, @dStart, @dEnd, @sPriority, @sMpproj,
														@sEvent, @nComplete, @sResintials, @nWork, @nPersons, @nAct, @sActNote
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSUPD_MTP
on r5maintenancepatterns
for update
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nRevision   		numeric(4,0)        

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldOrg            nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldRevision   	numeric(4,0)        

	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)

	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.MTP_CODE, i.MTP_DESC, i.MTP_ORG, i.MTP_REVISION, i.MTP_CLASS, i.MTP_CLASS_ORG,
                                                      d.MTP_CODE, d.MTP_DESC, d.MTP_ORG, d.MTP_REVISION, d.MTP_CLASS, d.MTP_CLASS_ORG
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.MTP_SQLIDENTITY = d.MTP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @nRevision, @sClass, @sClass_org,
                                                   @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @nOldRevision, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MPAT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' and ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) or @sOldClass_org <> coalesce( @sClass_org, @sDeforg) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MSTD'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sOldOrg + N'#' + cast(@nOldRevision as nvarchar(32))

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @nRevision, @sClass, @sClass_org,
                                                           @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @nOldRevision, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger POSUPD_NCF
on r5nonconformities
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser                nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX                   nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode                nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg                 nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc                nvarchar(80)
    declare @sOldDesc             nvarchar(80)
    declare @nReturn              int
    declare @nCount               integer
    declare @sFlag                nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTempMsgid           nvarchar(256)
    declare @sOldClass            nvarchar(8)
    declare @sOldClassOrg         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sClass               nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg            nvarchar(15)
    declare @sChk                 nvarchar(3)
    declare @sDeforg              nvarchar(200)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.NCF_CODE, i.NCF_ORG, i.NCF_DESC, i.NCF_CLASS, i.NCF_CLASS_ORG, d.NCF_DESC, d.NCF_CLASS, d.NCF_CLASS_ORG
                                               from inserted i, deleted d
                                               where i.NCF_SQLIDENTITY = d.NCF_SQLIDENTITY
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del 
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            if @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
                                begin
                                    execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'NOCF', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        begin
                                            close c_ins_del
                                            deallocate c_ins_del
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end
                                end

                            --If class is updated then remove property values of old class
                            execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
                            if Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce ( @sClass, N'*' ) OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce( @sClassOrg,@sDeforg ) ) 
                                DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
                                WHERE  prv_rentity     = N'NOCF'
                                AND    prv_class       = @sOldClass
                                AND    prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
                                AND    prv_code        = @sCode

                -- databridge event
                select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@NOCF'
                            if @nCount > 0
                                select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@NOCF'
                            else
                                set @sFlag = N'N'
                                
                            if @sFlag = N'Y'
                    begin
                        EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT                                                                            
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            begin
                                close c_inserted
                                deallocate c_inserted
                                rollback transaction
                                return
                            end                          
                                                    
                        INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS (
                            XTS_TRANTYPE,
                            XTS_TABLE,
                            XTS_KEYFLD1,
                            XTS_ORG,
                            XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
                        SELECT N'NONCONFORMITY',
                               N'R5NONCONFORMITIES',
                               @sCode,
                               @sOrg,
                               @sTempMsgid
                        WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM R5XMLTRANSTATUS WHERE XTS_TRANTYPE = N'NONCONFORMITY' 
                                                                           AND XTS_KEYFLD1 = @sCode AND XTS_ORG = @sOrg )
                                end
                                
                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg
                        end
                    close c_ins_del
                end
            deallocate c_ins_del
        end

on r5nonconformitytypes
for update

as

    declare @sX                   nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode                nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg                 nvarchar(15)
    declare @sUserid              nvarchar(255)
    declare @sDesc                nvarchar(80)
    declare @sOldDesc             nvarchar(80)
    declare @nReturn              int
    declare @sInobjectupdate      nvarchar(10)

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            
            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
            
            declare c_updated cursor local for select i.nct_code, i.nct_org, i.nct_desc, d.nct_desc
                    from inserted i, deleted d
                    where i.nct_sqlidentity = d.nct_sqlidentity
            
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            
            if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                begin
                    open c_updated 
                    fetch next from c_updated into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldDesc 
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'

                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                    begin

                                        deallocate c_inserted
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                                    end

ON r5objectsurvey
FOR UPDATE
AS

   DECLARE @sObjectOrg       nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sType            nvarchar(1)
   DECLARE @sInobjectupdate  nvarchar(10)
   DECLARE @nReturn          int
   DECLARE @sLevelpk         nvarchar(30)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
         declare c_ins_del cursor local for select obs_object, obs_object_org, obs_type, obs_levelpk from inserted 
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
            begin
               open c_ins_del
               fetch next from c_ins_del into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sType, @sLevelpk
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     IF @sType = 'O'
                        -- Update column obj_rrsurveylastupdated
                        UPDATE r5objects
                        SET    obj_rrsurveylastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( @sObjectOrg )
                        WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
                        AND    obj_org  = @sObjectOrg
                        AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'

                                       WHERE  rrl_pk                 = @sLevelpk

                                       AND    rrl_revision           = obj_reliabilityrankingrev

                     ELSE
                        -- Update column rrv_surveylastupdated
                        UPDATE r5reliabilityrankingvalues
                        SET    rrv_surveylastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( rrv_org ),
                               rrv_reliabilityrankingscore = NULL,

                        WHERE  rrv_pk = @sObject

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ojv_code, i.ojv_org, i.ojv_desc  
    from   inserted i

    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
      open c_ins_del
      fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc 
      

      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        
        --POSUPD_OJV portion

        set @sX = NULL
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'

        /* Update descriptions */
        execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'OBTV', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, 
                  @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_ins_del
          deallocate c_ins_del
          rollback transaction
          return
        end  
        
        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc
      end
      close c_ins_del
    end
    deallocate c_ins_del
  end

create trigger POSUPD_ORG
on R5ORGANIZATION
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sAccountingentity	nvarchar(22)
	declare @sOldAccountingentity	nvarchar(22)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ORG_CODE, i.ORG_DESC, i.ORG_ACCOUNTINGENTITY, d.ORG_ACCOUNTINGENTITY 
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ORG_SQLIDENTITY = d.ORG_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sAccountingentity, @sOldAccountingentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ORG', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							-- add Databridge event to r5xmltranstatus table
							SELECT @sFlag = isnull(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'
							if upper(@sFlag) = N'A' and @sAccountingentity is not null and (@sOldAccountingentity is null or @sAccountingentity<>@sOldAccountingentity)
							begin
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
								(XTS_TRANTYPE,XTS_TABLE,XTS_KEYFLD1,XTS_KEYFLD2,XTS_KEYFLD3,XTS_ORG,XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
								VALUES
								(N'CODEDEF',N'ACCOUNTINGENTITY',@sAccountingentity,@sAccountingentity,N'+',@sCode,@sTempMsgid)
							end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sAccountingentity, @sOldAccountingentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger POSUPD_ORS
on R5OBJRESOURCES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
        declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)
        declare @sObject           nvarchar(30)
        declare @sObjectOrg        nvarchar(15)
        declare @sResource         nvarchar(80)
        declare @sActive           nvarchar(1)
        declare @nCoolDownTime     numeric(7,2)
        declare @nWarmupTime       numeric(7,2)
        declare @nUpdateCount      int
        declare @sOldObject        nvarchar(30)
        declare @sOldObjectOrg     nvarchar(15)
        declare @sOldResource      nvarchar(80)
        declare @sOldActive        nvarchar(1)
        declare @nOldCoolDownTime  numeric(7,2)
        declare @nOldWarmupTime    numeric(7,2)
        declare @nOldUpdateCount   int        
        declare @sEAMUser          nvarchar(255) 
        declare @dDate             datetime
        declare @nReturn           int
        declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
        declare @sInobjectupdate   nvarchar(10)

        if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                begin
                        EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
                        /* get eam user */
                        execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sEAMUser OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                           return
                
                        set @sEAMUser = coalesce(@sEAMUser, N'*')
                        
                        /* get system date */
                        execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                          return
                          
                        SET NOCOUNT ON
                        declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ORS_OBJECT, i.ORS_OBJECT_ORG, i.ORS_RESOURCE,i.ORS_COOLDOWNTIME, i.ORS_WARMUPTIME,i.ORS_ACTIVE,i.ORS_UPDATECOUNT,
                                                                  d.ORS_OBJECT, d.ORS_OBJECT_ORG, d.ORS_RESOURCE,d.ORS_COOLDOWNTIME, d.ORS_WARMUPTIME,d.ORS_ACTIVE,d.ORS_UPDATECOUNT
                                                           from inserted i, deleted d
                                                           where i.ORS_SQLIDENTITY = d.ORS_SQLIDENTITY
                        set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
                        if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                                begin
                                        open c_ins_del 
                                        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource,@nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime,@sActive, @nUpdateCount,@sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg, @sOldResource,@nOldCoolDownTime, @nOldWarmupTime,@sOldActive, @nOldUpdateCount
                                        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                                                begin
                                                        
                                                        /* Create audit records */
                                                        INSERT INTO r5objresourcesaudit(
                                                            era_object,
                                                            era_object_org,
                                                            era_resource,
                                                            era_cooldowntime,
                                                            era_warmuptime,
                                                            era_active,
                                                            era_action,
                                                            era_modifiedby,
                                                            era_datemodified)
                                                        VALUES (
                                                            @sOldObject,
                                                            @sOldObjectOrg,
                                                            @sOldResource,
                                                            @nOldCoolDownTime,
                                                            @nOldWarmupTime,
                                                            @sOldActive,                                            
                                                            N'UPD',
                                                            @sEAMUser,
                                                            @dDate )   

                                                        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sResource,@nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime,@sActive, @nUpdateCount,@sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg, @sOldResource,@nOldCoolDownTime, @nOldWarmupTime,@sOldActive, @nOldUpdateCount
                                                end
                                        close c_ins_del
                                end
                        deallocate c_ins_del
                end

on R5PARTSINTERFACE

as

	declare @sTrans            		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nTransgroup       		integer
	declare @nTransorgid       		bigint

for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)

	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)

	declare @nRevision   		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sRevrstatus 		nvarchar(4)

	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)

	declare @sOldRevrstatus 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRevstatus  	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldMaterial   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @nOldMaterialrev	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOldDesign     	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @nOldCorrosion  	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOldDtempmin   	numeric(6,2)       
	declare @nOldDtempmax   	numeric(6,2)       
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(3)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PCS_CODE,	i.PCS_DESC,	i.PCS_CLASS,	i.PCS_CLASS_ORG,	i.PCS_REVISION,
													  	i.PCS_REVRSTATUS,	i.PCS_REVSTATUS,	i.PCS_MATERIAL,	i.PCS_MATERIALREV,	i.PCS_DESIGN,
													  	i.PCS_CORROSION,	i.PCS_DTEMPMIN,	i.PCS_DTEMPMAX,	i.PCS_CREATED,	i.PCS_USER,
													 	i.PCS_UPDATED,	i.PCS_UPDUSER,	i.PCS_UPDATECOUNT,	i.PCS_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.PCS_CODE,	d.PCS_DESC,	d.PCS_CLASS,	d.PCS_CLASS_ORG,	d.PCS_REVISION,
													  	d.PCS_REVRSTATUS,	d.PCS_REVSTATUS,	d.PCS_MATERIAL,	d.PCS_MATERIALREV,	d.PCS_DESIGN,
													  	d.PCS_CORROSION,	d.PCS_DTEMPMIN,	d.PCS_DTEMPMAX,	d.PCS_CREATED,	d.PCS_USER,
													  	d.PCS_UPDATED,	d.PCS_UPDUSER,	d.PCS_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.PCS_SQLIDENTITY = d.PCS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nRevision,
												   	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sMaterial,	@nMaterialrev,	@sDesign,
												   	@nCorrosion,	@nDtempmin,	@nDtempmax,	@dCreated,	@sUser,
												   	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldRevision,
													@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldMaterial,	@nOldMaterialrev,	@sOldDesign,
													@nOldCorrosion,	@nOldDtempmin,	@nOldDtempmax,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,
													@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PPCL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' and ( @sOldClass <> isnull( @sClass, N'*' ) or @sOldClass_org <> isnull( @sClass_org, @sDeforg) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'PPCL'
								AND   prv_class       = @sClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sCode

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nRevision,
														   	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sMaterial,	@nMaterialrev,	@sDesign,
														   	@nCorrosion,	@nDtempmin,	@nDtempmax,	@dCreated,	@sUser,
														   	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldRevision,
															@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldMaterial,	@nOldMaterialrev,	@sOldDesign,
															@nOldCorrosion,	@nOldDtempmin,	@nOldDtempmax,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,
															@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

    declare @dPpoDue               datetime
    declare @nPpoFreq              numeric(8)
    declare @sPpoPerioduom         nvarchar(10)
    declare @sPerformonweek        nvarchar(1)
    declare @nPerformonday         numeric(1)
    declare @dDeactive             datetime
    declare @sPpoIssType           nvarchar(1)
    declare @sRstat                nvarchar(4)
    declare @sChk                  nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn               int
    declare @nCountit              int
    declare @nPpometerdue          numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPpometerdue2         numeric(24,6)
    declare @dOldPpoDue            datetime
    declare @nOldPpoFreq           numeric(8)
    declare @sOldPpoPerioduom      nvarchar(10)
    declare @sOldPerformonweek     nvarchar(1)
    declare @nOldPerformonday      numeric(1)
    declare @dOldDeactive          datetime
    declare @sOldPpoIssType        nvarchar(1)

    declare @sevtcode              nvarchar(30)
    declare @devttarget            datetime
    declare @nevtduration          numeric(8)
    declare @sevtppm               nvarchar(20)
    declare @nevtppmrev            numeric(4)
    declare @sevtobject            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sevtobjectorg         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sInobjectupdate       nvarchar(10)
    declare @nUpdatecount          int
    declare @nOldUpdateCount       int
    declare @nSqlIdentity          int
    declare @nFdays                numeric

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON

            /* Get number of days in which future duplicates should be created. */
            SELECT @nFdays = ins_desc
            FROM   r5install
            WHERE  ins_code = N'FUTUREPM'

            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
            declare c_inserted cursor local for SELECT i.ppo_ppm, i.ppo_revision, i.ppo_object, i.ppo_object_org, i.ppo_pk, i.ppo_due, 
                    i.ppo_freq, i.ppo_perioduom, i.ppo_performonweek, i.ppo_performonday, i.ppo_deactive, i.ppo_isstype,
                    i.ppo_updatecount, d.ppo_updatecount, i.ppo_sqlidentity, i.ppo_meterdue, i.ppo_meterdue2,
                    d.ppo_due, d.ppo_freq, d.ppo_perioduom, d.ppo_performonweek, d.ppo_performonday, d.ppo_deactive, d.ppo_isstype  
                    FROM inserted i, deleted d
                    where i.PPO_SQLIDENTITY = d.PPO_SQLIDENTITY
            set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                begin
                    open c_inserted
                    fetch next from c_inserted into @sPpm, @nRev, @sObject, @sObjorg, @nPpopk, @dPpoDue, @nPpoFreq, @sPpoPerioduom,
                                   @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday, @dDeactive, @sPpoIssType, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @nPpometerdue, @nPpometerdue2,
                                   @dOldPpoDue, @nOldPpoFreq, @sOldPpoPerioduom, @sOldPerformonweek, @nOldPerformonday, @dOldDeactive, @sOldPpoIssType
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5PPMOBJECTS 
								set    ppo_updatecount  = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, 
								       ppo_lastsaved = getdate(),
								       ppo_due          = CASE WHEN @dPpoDue is not null and @sPpoIssType = N'D' THEN dbo.o7gtdate( @dPpoDue, @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday ) ELSE ppo_due END,
                                       ppo_fixed        = @sPpoIssType
								where  PPO_SQLIDENTITY	= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

                            IF @sPpoIssType = N'D' AND ISNULL( @nFdays, 0 ) <> -1
                            BEGIN
                              SELECT @sRstat = ppm_revrstatus
                              FROM   r5ppms
                              WHERE  ppm_code = @sPpm
                              AND    ppm_revision = @nRev
                              IF @sRstat = N'A' 
                                BEGIN
                                  SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
                                  FROM   r5events
                                  WHERE  evt_ppopk   = @nPpoPk
                                  AND    evt_rstatus IN ( N'A', N'R' )
                                  /* If duplicate, insert into future duplicates. */
                                  IF @nCountit = 0
                                    execute @nReturn = O7CRFDP1 @nPpoPk, @dPpoDue, @nPpoFreq, @sPpoPerioduom, @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday,
                                                                @sObject, @sObjorg, @dDeactive, @sChk OUTPUT 
                                  ELSE
                                    BEGIN
                                      IF (     coalesce(@dOldDeactive, GetDate()-1000) <> coalesce(@dDeactive, GetDate()-1000) 
                                               OR    coalesce(@dOldPpoDue, GetDate()-1000) <> coalesce(@dPpoDue, GetDate()-1000) 
                                               OR    coalesce(@sOldPpoIssType, N'a') <> coalesce(@sPpoIssType, N'a')
                                               OR    coalesce(@nOldPpoFreq, 0) <> coalesce(@nPpoFreq, 0)
                                               OR    coalesce(@sOldPpoPerioduom, N'a') <> coalesce(@sPpoPerioduom, N'a')
                                               OR    coalesce(@sOldPerformonweek, N'a') <> coalesce(@sPerformonweek, N'a')
                                               OR    coalesce(@nOldPerformonday, 0) <> coalesce(@nPerformonday, 0 ) )
                                        BEGIN       
                                          SELECT @sevtcode          = evt_code,                                               
                                                 @devttarget        = evt_target,                                              
                                                 @nevtduration      = evt_duration, 
                                                 @sevtppm           = evt_ppm, 
                                                 @nevtppmrev        = evt_ppmrev, 
                                                 @sevtobject        = evt_object, 
                                                 @sevtobjectorg     = evt_object_org                                           
                                          FROM   r5events
                                          WHERE  evt_ppopk = @nPpoPk
                                          AND    evt_code IN ( SELECT evt_code
                                                               FROM   r5events
                                                               WHERE  evt_ppopk = @nPpoPk
                                                               AND    evt_due = ( SELECT MAX( evt_due )
                                                                                  FROM   r5events
                                                                                  WHERE  evt_ppopk = @nPpoPk ) )
                                          DELETE FROM r5futureevents
                                          WHERE  fut_event = @sevtcode
                                          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7crfut1 NULL, @sevtcode, @sPpoIssType, @devttarget, @dPpoDue, @nPpoFreq, @sPpoPerioduom,

create trigger POSUPD_PRQ
on R5PRODUCTIONREQUESTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser              nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX                 nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRevision          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOrg               nvarchar(15)
    declare @sClass             nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg          nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDesc              nvarchar(80)
    declare @sWorkOrder         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sProdOrder         nvarchar(80)
    declare @dProdStart         datetime
    declare @dProdEnd           datetime
    declare @sAccEntity         nvarchar(22)
    declare @sStatus            nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRStatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEntLocation       nvarchar(80)
    declare @sProdPriority      nvarchar(256)
    declare @dProdReqStart      datetime
    declare @dProdReqEnd        datetime
    declare @dCreated           datetime
    declare @sCreatedby         nvarchar(255)
    declare @dLastStatusUpdate  datetime

    declare @sOldCode           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOldOrg            nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOldClass          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sOldClassOrg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOldDesc           nvarchar(80)
    declare @sOldWorkOrder      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOldProdOrder      nvarchar(80)
    declare @dOldProdStart      datetime
    declare @dOldProdEnd        datetime
    declare @sOldAccEntity      nvarchar(22)
    declare @sOldStatus         nvarchar(4)
    declare @nUpdatecount       int
    declare @nOldUpdatecount    int
    declare @nSqlIdentity       int
    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @sDeforg            nvarchar(200)    --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
    declare @nCountit           int
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
    declare @dOldEventStart     datetime
    declare @dOldActStart       datetime
    declare @dEvtTarget         datetime    
    declare @nActivity          int
    declare @nDiff              int
    declare @nDuration		    int  
    declare @sSeqno1            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChk1              nvarchar(6)
    declare @sGetUser           nvarchar(255)
    declare @dGtTime            datetime
    declare @sGetStype          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sCertnum           nvarchar(20)
    declare @sCerttype          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sRevisionreason    nvarchar(2000)
    declare @ERecord            int

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PRQ_CODE,i.PRQ_REVISION, i.PRQ_ORG, i.PRQ_DESC, i.PRQ_CLASS, i.PRQ_CLASS_ORG,i.PRQ_PRODUCTIONORDER, i.PRQ_PRODUCTIONSTART, i.PRQ_PRODUCTIONEND,i.PRQ_ACCOUNTINGENTITY,i.PRQ_EVENT, i.PRQ_STATUS, i.PRQ_RSTATUS, i.PRQ_ENTERPRISELOCATION, i.PRQ_PRIORITY, i.PRQ_PRODREQUESTSTART, i.PRQ_PRODREQUESTEND, i.PRQ_CREATEDBY, i.PRQ_CREATED, i.PRQ_LASTSTATUSUPDATE, i.PRQ_UPDATECOUNT,
                                          d.PRQ_CODE, d.PRQ_ORG, d.PRQ_DESC, d.PRQ_CLASS, d.PRQ_CLASS_ORG, d.PRQ_PRODUCTIONORDER, d.PRQ_PRODUCTIONSTART, d.PRQ_PRODUCTIONEND,d.PRQ_ACCOUNTINGENTITY,d.PRQ_EVENT, d.PRQ_UPDATECOUNT, i.PRQ_SQLIDENTITY, i.PRQ_REVISIONREASON, d.PRQ_STATUS
                                          from inserted i, deleted d where i.PRQ_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRQ_SQLIDENTITY

            set @sX = NULL
            set @nCountit = 0
            set @sCheckresult = N'0'

            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del 
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sRevision, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sProdOrder, @dProdStart, @dProdEnd, @sAccEntity, @sWorkOrder, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sEntLocation, @sProdPriority, @dProdReqStart, @dProdReqEnd, @sCreatedby, @dCreated, @dLastStatusUpdate, @nUpdatecount, 
                                                    @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldProdOrder, @dOldProdStart, @dOldProdEnd, @sOldAccEntity, @sOldWorkOrder, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @sRevisionreason, @sOldStatus
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            /* get Default Organization*/
                            execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                            /* The values of class/classorg should be provided otherwise not */
                            If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
                                begin
                                    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PREQ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        begin
                                            close c_ins_del
                                            deallocate c_ins_del
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end

                                    if @nCountit = 0
                                        begin
                                            close c_ins_del
                                            deallocate c_ins_del
                                            execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'POSUPD_PRQ', N'TRIG', 1
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end
                                end
				/* If Production details are updated then update the WorkOrder Production Details as well.*/
				if COALESCE(@sProdOrder,'#') <> COALESCE(@sOldProdOrder,'#') OR
				COALESCE(@dProdStart, convert(datetime,'01/01/9999')) <> COALESCE(@dOldProdStart,convert(datetime,'01/01/9999')) OR
				COALESCE(@dProdEnd,convert(datetime,'01/01/9999')) <> COALESCE(@dOldProdEnd,convert(datetime,'01/01/9999')) OR                                
				COALESCE(@sAccEntity,'#') <> COALESCE(@sOldAccEntity,'#')
                               
				begin
					set @nDuration = 1

					IF COALESCE(@sProdOrder,'#') <> COALESCE(@sOldProdOrder,'#')
						AND COALESCE(@dProdStart, convert(datetime,'01/01/9999')) <> COALESCE(@dOldProdStart,convert(datetime,'01/01/9999'))
						AND COALESCE(@dProdEnd,convert(datetime,'01/01/9999')) <> COALESCE(@dOldProdEnd,convert(datetime,'01/01/9999'))
					begin				    	
						set @nDuration = (datediff(dd, @dProdStart, @dProdEnd) + 1)													

						IF @nDuration < 0
							set @nDuration = 1
					end
					UPDATE R5EVENTS
					SET     evt_prodorder = @sProdOrder,
						evt_productionstart = @dProdStart,
						evt_productionend   = @dProdEnd,
						evt_accountingentity= @sAccEntity,
						evt_target          = @dProdStart,
						evt_schedend        = @dProdEnd,
						evt_duration        = @nDuration
					WHERE evt_productionrequest = @sCode

create trigger POSUPD_PSC
on R5PSCATEGORIES
for update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sType       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRtype      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sNotused    		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldType       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldNotused    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0) 
	
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int    	      
	declare @sRentity		nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PSC_CODE,	i.PSC_ORG,	i.PSC_DESC,	i.PSC_TYPE,	i.PSC_RTYPE,
													 	i.PSC_NOTUSED,	i.PSC_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	d.PSC_CODE,	d.PSC_ORG,	d.PSC_DESC,	d.PSC_TYPE,	d.PSC_RTYPE,
													  	d.PSC_NOTUSED,	d.PSC_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.PSC_SQLIDENTITY = d.PSC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sX	 = NULL
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sType,	@sRtype,
												   	@sNotused,	@nUpdatecount,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldType,	@sOldRtype,
													@sOldNotused,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sRentity = case when @sRtype = N'PD' then N'PROV' else N'PSCT' end
							/* Delete dependant data */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, @sRentity, @sType, @sRtype, @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sType,	@sRtype,
														   	@sNotused,	@nUpdatecount,
															@sOldCode,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldType,	@sOldRtype,
															@sOldNotused,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_PSQ
ON R5PATTERNSEQUENCES
FOR UPDATE
AS

 declare @sUser           nvarchar(255)
 declare @sMP             nvarchar(30)
 declare @sMPOrg          nvarchar(15)
 declare @nMPRev          int
 declare @nMPSeq          int
 declare @nMPPK           int
 declare @nFreq           int
 declare @nOldFreq        int
 declare @sPeriodUOM      nvarchar(30)
 declare @sOldPeriodUOM   nvarchar(30)
 declare @sOldMeter       numeric(24,6)
 declare @sMeter          numeric(24,6)
 declare @sOldMeter2      numeric(24,6)
 declare @sMeter2         numeric(24,6)
 declare @sEvtCode        nvarchar(30)
 declare @dEvtDue         datetime
 declare @dMtrDueDate1    datetime
 declare @dMtrDueDate2    datetime
 declare @nMeterDue       numeric(24,6)
 declare @nMeterDue2      numeric(24,6)
 declare @nMeter1due      numeric(24,6)
 declare @nMeter2due      numeric(24,6)
 declare @dDuedate        datetime
 declare @dDormstart      datetime
 declare @dDormend        datetime
 declare @sDormreuse      nvarchar(1)
 declare @sMPSeqType      nvarchar(4)
 declare @sChk            nvarchar(1)

    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
       SET NOCOUNT ON
       set @sChk = N'0'
       declare c_ins_del cursor local FOR SELECT i.psq_mp, i.psq_mp_org, i.psq_revision, i.psq_sequence, i.psq_pk, i.psq_seqtype, i.psq_freq,
                                                d.psq_freq, i.psq_perioduom, d.psq_perioduom, d.psq_meter, i.psq_meter,
                                                d.psq_meter2, i.psq_meter2
                                          FROM   inserted i, deleted d
                                          WHERE  i.psq_sqlidentity = d.psq_sqlidentity

       set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
       if @sUser <> N'SYS'
          begin
             open c_ins_del
             fetch next from c_ins_del into @sMP, @sMPOrg, @nMPRev, @nMPSeq, @nMPPK, @sMPSeqType, @nFreq, @nOldFreq, @sPeriodUOM, @sOldPeriodUOM, @sOldMeter, @sMeter, @sOldMeter2, @sMeter2
             while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
             begin
                /*cursor to retrieve the WOs in awaiting status */
                declare c_evt cursor local for   SELECT evt_code, evt_due, evt_meterdue, evt_meterdue2, evt_meterduedate, evt_meterduedate2, obj_dormstart, obj_dormend, obj_dormreuse
                                                     FROM r5events, r5objects
                                                     WHERE evt_mp = @sMP
                                                     AND evt_mp_org = @sMPOrg
                                                     AND evt_mp_rev = @nMPRev
                                                     AND evt_mp_seq = @nMPSeq
                                                     AND evt_psqpk  = @nMPPK
                                                     AND evt_object = obj_code
                                                     AND evt_object_org = obj_org
                                                     AND evt_rstatus = N'A'
                open c_evt
                fetch next from c_evt into  @sEvtCode, @dEvtDue, @nMeterDue, @nMeterDue2, @dMtrDueDate1, @dMtrDueDate2, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse
                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                   set @dDuedate = @dEvtDue
                   set @nMeter1due = @nMeterDue
                   set @nMeter2due = @nMeterDue2
                   IF coalesce(@nOldFreq,0) <> coalesce(@nFreq,0) OR coalesce(@sOldPeriodUOM,'x') <> coalesce(@sPeriodUOM,'x')
                   BEGIN
                     /*calculate due dates*/
                     set @dDuedate = @dDuedate + dbo.o7gtfreq(-@nOldFreq, @sOldPeriodUOM, @dDuedate) 
                     set @dDuedate = @dDuedate + dbo.o7gtfreq(@nFreq, @sPeriodUOM, @dDuedate)
                   END
                   IF @dDueDate is not null
                   begin
                     IF @sDormreuse = N'+' 
                     BEGIN
                       /* Make sure dormant period is valid for current due date. */
                       WHILE @dDormend < @dDuedate
                       BEGIN
                          SET @dDormstart = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDormstart, 12 )
                          SET @dDormend   = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDormend, 12 )
                       END
                     END

                     IF @dDuedate BETWEEN @dDormstart AND @dDormend
                     BEGIN
                        /* Make sure the new due date falls outside the dormant period. */
                        IF @sMPSeqType = N'D' AND ISNULL( @nFreq, 0 ) > 0
                        BEGIN
                           WHILE @dDuedate <= @dDormend
                              SET @dDuedate = @dDuedate + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nFreq, @sPerioduom, @dDuedate )
                        END
                        ELSE
                           SET @dDuedate = @dDormend + 1    
                     END
                   END   

                   /* re-calculate Meter #1 dues */    
                   set @nMeter1due = @nMeter1due - @sOldMeter + @sMeter
                   /* re-calculate Meter #2 dues */    
                   set @nMeter2due = @nMeter2due - @sOldMeter2 + @sMeter2
                   /* update r5events table with new due date, meterdue and meterdue2 */
                   if @sMeter is null
                         set @dMtrDueDate1 = null
                   if @sMeter2 is null
                         set @dMtrDueDate2 = null
                   update r5events set evt_due = @dDuedate, evt_freq = @nFreq, evt_perioduom = @sPeriodUOM,
                                       evt_meterinterval = @sMeter, evt_meterinterval2 = @sMeter2, 
                                       evt_meterdue = @nMeter1due, evt_meterdue2 = @nMeter2due,
                                       evt_meterduedate = @dMtrDueDate1, evt_meterduedate2 = @dMtrDueDate2
                   where evt_code = @sEvtCode

                   /* call o7mpduedates to recalculate meter due dates and target date */
                   execute o7mpduedates @sEvtCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                   /* fetch next */
                   fetch next from c_evt into  @sEvtCode, @dEvtDue, @nMeterDue, @nMeterDue2, @dMtrDueDate1, @dMtrDueDate2, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse
                end
                close c_evt
                deallocate c_evt

                fetch next from c_ins_del into @sMP, @sMPOrg, @nMPRev, @nMPSeq, @nMPPK, @sMPSeqType, @nFreq, @nOldFreq, @sPeriodUOM, @sOldPeriodUOM, @sOldMeter, @sMeter, @sOldMeter2, @sMeter2
             end
             close c_ins_del
          end
       deallocate c_ins_del
    END
