CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_PTC
ON R5PARTCTPLCONDITIONS
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
	DECLARE @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	DECLARE @sX					nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @sTemplateCode		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sTemplateOrg		nvarchar(15)	
	DECLARE @sConditionCode		nvarchar(20)
	DECLARE @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	DECLARE @sKeyCode			nvarchar(51)
	DECLARE @nReturn			int

	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			DECLARE c_ins_del CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT i.PTC_TEMPLATE, i.PTC_TEMPLATE_ORG, i.PTC_CONDITION, i.PTC_DESC
											   FROM inserted i
			SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			IF @sUser <> N'SYS'

create trigger POSUPD_PTW
on r5permittowork
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser                nvarchar(38)
    declare @sCheckresult         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX                   nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCode                nvarchar(30)
    declare @sKeyCode             nvarchar(40)
    declare @sOrg                 nvarchar(15)
    declare @sUserid              nvarchar(255)
    declare @sDesc                nvarchar(80)
    declare @sOldDesc             nvarchar(80)
    declare @sSeqno               int
    declare @sLogEventType        nvarchar(8)
    declare @sLogReviewedBy       nvarchar(255)
    declare @sLogExtension        numeric (24,6)
    declare @sExtensionHrs        numeric (24,6)
    declare @sOldExtensionHrs     numeric (24,6)
    declare @sExtensionCount      numeric (6,0)
    declare @sOldExtensionCount   numeric (6,0)
    declare @sReviewedType        nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldReviewedType     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sLogReviewedType     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sReviewed            datetime
    declare @sOldReviewed         datetime
    declare @sReviewedBy          nvarchar(255)
    declare @sUpdated             datetime
    declare @sUpdatedBy           nvarchar(255)
    declare @sLogSuspension       nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sSuspensionReason    nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sOldSuspensionReason nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sIsolatedFlag        varchar(1)
    declare @sOldIsolatedFlag     varchar(1)
    declare @sStatus              nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldStatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRStatus             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldRStatus          nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn              int
    declare @nErecord             int
    declare @vtemp                nvarchar(4)
    declare @sInobjectupdate      nvarchar(10)

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.PTW_CODE, i.PTW_ORG, i.PTW_DESC, d.PTW_DESC,
                    i.PTW_EXTENSION, i.PTW_ISOLATED, i.PTW_REVIEWED, i.PTW_REVIEWEDTYPE, i.PTW_STATUS, i.PTW_RSTATUS, 
                    i.PTW_SUSPENSIONREASON, i.PTW_UPDATED, i.PTW_UPDATEDBY, i.PTW_EXTENSIONCOUNT, i.PTW_REVIEWEDBY, 
                    d.PTW_EXTENSION, d.PTW_ISOLATED, d.PTW_REVIEWED, d.PTW_REVIEWEDTYPE, d.PTW_STATUS, d.PTW_RSTATUS, 
                    d.PTW_SUSPENSIONREASON, d.PTW_EXTENSIONCOUNT
                                               from inserted i, deleted d
                                               where i.PTW_SQLIDENTITY = d.PTW_SQLIDENTITY
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del 
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldDesc, 
                        @sExtensionHrs, @sIsolatedFlag, @sReviewed, @sReviewedType, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sSuspensionReason, @sUpdated, @sUpdatedBy, @sExtensionCount, @sReviewedBy, 
                        @sOldExtensionHrs, @sOldIsolatedFlag, @sOldReviewed, @sOldReviewedType, @sOldStatus, @sOldRStatus, @sOldSuspensionReason, @sOldExtensionCount
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sX = NULL
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sKeyCode = @sCode
                            if @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
                                begin
                                    execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'PTW', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode , @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        begin
                                            close c_ins_del
                                            deallocate c_ins_del
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end
                                end

                            execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                    begin
                                        close c_inserted
                                        deallocate c_inserted
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                                    end

                            set @sLogEventType = null
                            set @sLogReviewedBy = @sReviewedBy
                            set @sLogExtension = null
                            set @sLogReviewedType = @sReviewedType
                            set @sLogSuspension = null
                            if @sOldExtensionCount <> @sExtensionCount
                              begin
                                set @sLogEventType = 'EXT'
                                set @sLogExtension = @sExtensionHrs
                              end
                            else if @sOldIsolatedFlag = '-' AND @sIsolatedFlag = '+'
                              set @sLogEventType = 'ISO'
                            else if @sOldIsolatedFlag = '+' AND @sIsolatedFlag = '-'
                              set @sLogEventType = 'DISO'
                            else if @sOldStatus <> @sStatus
                              begin
                                set @sLogEventType = 'ST'
                                if @sRStatus = 'SUSP'
                                  set @sLogSuspension = @sSuspensionReason
                                set @sLogReviewedBy = @sUpdatedBy
                              end

                           if @sLogEventType IS NOT NULL
                             begin
                               execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'PTWL', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                               INSERT INTO r5ptweventlog( ptl_pk, ptl_ptw, ptl_eventtype, ptl_date, ptl_fromstatus, ptl_tostatus, ptl_reviewedtype, ptl_reviewedby,
                                      ptl_extension, ptl_suspensionreason, ptl_created, ptl_createdby)
                               VALUES( @sSeqno, @sCode, @sLogEventType, dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), @sOldStatus, @sStatus, @sLogReviewedType, @sLogReviewedBy,
                                       @sLogExtension, @sLogSuspension, dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), @sUserid)
                             end

                            execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'UPD', N'PTW', @sOldStatus, @sStatus
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                              begin
                                close c_ins_del
                                deallocate c_ins_del
                                rollback transaction
                                return
                              end

                            if @nErecord > 0 
                              begin
                                /* Elec archive. */
                                execute @nReturn = o7ptwelecarchive N'UPDATE', @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                  begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                  end
                              end

                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldDesc, 
                                @sExtensionHrs, @sIsolatedFlag, @sReviewed, @sReviewedType, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sSuspensionRea

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_PVD
  ON r5pvdescriptions
  AFTER UPDATE
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sSysUser   NVARCHAR( 38 )
  DECLARE @sValue     NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @sDesc      NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @sOlddesc   NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @nReturn    INT
  DECLARE @sChk       NVARCHAR( 4 )

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT i.pvd_property + N'#' + i.pvd_value, i.pvd_desc, d.pvd_desc
      FROM   inserted i, deleted d
      WHERE  i.pvd_sqlidentity = d.pvd_sqlidentity
      SET @sSysUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sValue, @sDesc, @sOlddesc
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              IF @sOlddesc IS NOT NULL AND @sDesc IS NULL
                EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', NULL, N'PROM', NULL, N'*', @sValue, NULL, NULL, @sChk OUTPUT
              IF @sOlddesc IS NULL AND @sDesc IS NOT NULL
                EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', NULL, N'PROM', NULL, N'*', @sValue, NULL, @sDesc, @sChk OUTPUT
              IF @sOlddesc <> @sDesc
                EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', NULL, N'PROM', NULL, N'*', @sValue, NULL, @sDesc, @sChk OUTPUT
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sValue, @sDesc, @sOlddesc
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON

                                               from inserted i, deleted d

                begin

                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

                            if @sIsolationmethod <> @sOldIsolationmethod OR @sIsolationmethodrev <> @sOldIsolationmethodrev

create trigger POSUPD_QUA
on R5QUALIFICATIONS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)

	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.QUA_CODE, i.QUA_DESC, i.QUA_CLASS, i.QUA_CLASS_ORG , i.QUA_ORG,
													  d.QUA_CODE, d.QUA_DESC, d.QUA_CLASS, d.QUA_CLASS_ORG , d.QUA_ORG, i.QUA_SQLIDENTITY,
													  i.QUA_UPDATECOUNT, d.QUA_UPDATECOUNT
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.QUA_SQLIDENTITY = d.QUA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg,   @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldOrg, @sOldClassOrg, @nSqlIdentity, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5QUALIFICATIONS set qua_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, QUA_LASTSAVED = getdate() where QUA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'QUAL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'QUAL'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode  + N'#' + @sOldOrg
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg,   @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldOrg, @sOldClassOrg, @nSqlIdentity, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @nReturn			integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.REI_TRANSID,	i.REI_CREATED,	i.REI_SOURCESYSTEM,	i.REI_SOURCECODE,	i.REI_METER,
													  	i.REI_DATE,	i.REI_READING,	i.REI_OBTYPE,	i.REI_OBRTYPE,	i.REI_OBJECT,
													  	i.REI_DIFF,	i.REI_UOM,	i.REI_CALCUOM,	i.REI_RECORDED,	i.REI_TRANS,

													  	d.REI_ORG

													where i.REI_SQLIDENTITY = d.REI_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sMeter,

												   	@nSessionid,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sObject_org,	@sUser,

													@sOldOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--The Oracle version for some reason puts rows in a temporary table and then 
							--	cursors through those rows and calls o7interface.arcupd for each row in there.

							execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ARCUPD @nTransid, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, @sTrans, N'READ', N'R5READINGSINTERFACE', N'REI'

															@dOldDate,	@nOldReading,	@sOldObtype,	@sOldObrtype,	@sOldObject,
															@nOldDiff,	@sOldUom,	@sOldCalcuom,	@dOldRecorded,	@sOldTrans,
															@nOldSessionid,	@nOldTransorgid,	@nOldTransgroup,	@sOldObject_org,	@sOldUser,

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_REQ_S ON R5REQUISITIONS FOR UPDATE AS 
BEGIN 
DECLARE @sTMPStoreVal1   NVARCHAR(24) 
       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(255) 
       ,@sErrCheck       NVARCHAR(10) 
       ,@sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(240) 
       ,@nReturn         INT 

DECLARE ScrollTMP CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT REQ_SQLIDENTITY  FROM inserted

SELECT @sErrCheck = N'0', @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() 
IF @sTenant IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(INT, @sTenant) != -1
   RETURN 

OPEN ScrollTMP 
WHILE 1=1 
      BEGIN 
      FETCH ScrollTMP INTO @sTMPStoreVal1 
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 
         BREAK 
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSUPD_REQ1 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      INSERT INTO FLEX_TRIGGER_WORKAROUND VALUES ( 'R5REQUISITIONS' , 'POST-UPDATE', @sTMPStoreVal1 )
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSUPD_REQ2 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      END 
CLOSE ScrollTMP 
DEALLOCATE ScrollTMP 
IF @nReturn = -1 
   BEGIN 
   ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
   RETURN 
   END 
END

												   	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sType,
												   	@nParent,	@sNormalize,	@sRanklevel,	@nRankvalue,	@sNotused,
												   	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sFormula,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldPk,	@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRevision,
													@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldType,
													@nOldParent,	@sOldNormalize,	@sOldRanklevel,	@nOldRankvalue,	@sOldNotused,
													@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@sOldFormula,
													@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'RISK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' and ( @sOldClass <> isnull( @sClass, N'*' ) or @sOldClass_org <> isnull( @sClass_org, @sDeforg) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'RISK'
								AND   prv_class       = @sClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sCode

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sRisk,	@nRevision,
														   	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sType,
														   	@nParent,	@sNormalize,	@sRanklevel,	@nRankvalue,	@sNotused,
														   	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sFormula,
														   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@nOldPk,	@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRevision,
															@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldType,
															@nOldParent,	@sOldNormalize,	@sOldRanklevel,	@nOldRankvalue,	@sOldNotused,
															@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@sOldFormula,
															@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

as
  declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)

  declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCode             nvarchar(30)
  declare @sRMSCode          nvarchar(30)
  declare @sKeyCode          nvarchar(80)
  declare @sDesc             nvarchar(80)
  declare @nReturn           int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.rmc_code, i.rmc_rmscode, i.rmc_desc  
    from   inserted i

    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
      open c_ins_del
      fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sRMSCode, @sDesc 
      

      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        
        --POSUPD_RMC portion

        set @sX = NULL
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'

        /* Update descriptions */
        set @sKeyCode = @sCode+'#'+ @sRMSCode
        execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'RMXC', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode , @sX, 
                  @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_ins_del
          deallocate c_ins_del
          rollback transaction
          return
        end  
        
        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sRMSCode, @sDesc
      end
      close c_ins_del
    end
    deallocate c_ins_del
  end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_RQL_S ON R5REQUISLINES FOR UPDATE AS 
BEGIN 
DECLARE @sTMPStoreVal1   NVARCHAR(24) 
       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(255) 
       ,@sErrCheck       NVARCHAR(10) 
       ,@sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(240) 
       ,@nReturn         INT 

DECLARE ScrollTMP CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT RQL_SQLIDENTITY  FROM inserted

SELECT @sErrCheck = N'0', @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() 
IF @sTenant IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(INT, @sTenant) != -1
   RETURN 

OPEN ScrollTMP 
WHILE 1=1 
      BEGIN 
      FETCH ScrollTMP INTO @sTMPStoreVal1 
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 
         BREAK 
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSUPD_RQL1 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      INSERT INTO FLEX_TRIGGER_WORKAROUND VALUES ( 'R5REQUISLINES' , 'POST-UPDATE', @sTMPStoreVal1 )
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSUPD_RQL2 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT 
      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 
         BEGIN 
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      IF @sErrCheck != N'0' 
         BEGIN 
         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)
         SET @nReturn = -1 
         BREAK 
         END 
      END 
CLOSE ScrollTMP 
DEALLOCATE ScrollTMP 
IF @nReturn = -1 
   BEGIN 
   ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
   RETURN 
   END 
END

create trigger POSUPD_RRK
on r5reliabilityrankings
for update
as
	declare @sUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClass_org	nvarchar(15)

	declare @sOldCode	nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClass_org	nvarchar(15)

	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX		nvarchar(1)

	declare @sDeforg	nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.RRK_CODE, i.RRK_DESC, i.RRK_ORG, i.RRK_CLASS, i.RRK_CLASS_ORG,
									d.RRK_CODE, d.RRK_DESC, d.RRK_ORG, d.RRK_CLASS, d.RRK_CLASS_ORG
							from inserted i, deleted d
							where i.RRK_SQLIDENTITY = d.RRK_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClass_org,
                                                   @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'RELR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' and ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) or @sOldClass_org <> coalesce( @sClass_org, @sDeforg) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MSTD'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sOldOrg

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClass_org,
                                                           @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_RRL
ON R5RELIABILITYRANKINGLEVELS
FOR UPDATE
AS
   DECLARE @sUser               nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @sPk                 nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sReliabilityranking nvarchar(30)
   DECLARE @nRevision           numeric
   DECLARE @sOrg                nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sDesc               nvarchar(80)
   DECLARE @sFormula            nvarchar(2000)


   DECLARE @sOldPk              nvarchar(20)
   DECLARE @sOldOrg             nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sOldDesc            nvarchar(80)
   DECLARE @sOldFormula         nvarchar(2000)


   DECLARE @nReturn             int
   DECLARE @sCheckresult        nvarchar(4)
   DECLARE @sX                  nvarchar(1)

   DECLARE @sQuestion           nvarchar(255)
   DECLARE @sOldQuestion        nvarchar(255)

   declare @sDeforg             nvarchar(200)   --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_ins_del cursor local for select
                     i.rrl_pk, i.rrl_desc, i.rrl_org, i.rrl_question, i.rrl_reliabilityranking, i.rrl_revision, i.rrl_formula,
                     d.rrl_pk, d.rrl_desc, d.rrl_org, d.rrl_question, d.rrl_formula
                     from inserted i, deleted d
                     where i.rrl_sqlidentity = d.rrl_sqlidentity
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_ins_del
               fetch next from c_ins_del into @sPk,    @sDesc,    @sOrg,    @sQuestion, @sReliabilityranking, @nRevision, @sFormula,
                                              @sOldPk, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @sOldQuestion, @sOldFormula
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'RRLV', @sX, N'*', @sPk, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_ins_del
                           deallocate c_ins_del
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           close c_ins_del
                           deallocate c_ins_del
                           execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_ins_del
                           deallocate c_ins_del
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end


                     IF @sOldQuestion IS NULL AND @sQuestion IS NOT NULL
                         INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingquests( rrq_levelpk, rrq_lang, rrq_question )
                         SELECT @sPk, lin_code, @sQuestion
                         FROM r5langinst
                     ELSE IF @sOldQuestion IS NOT NULL AND @sQuestion IS NULL
                         DELETE FROM r5reliabilityrankingquests
                         WHERE rrq_levelpk = @sOldPk
                     ELSE IF @sQuestion <> @sOldQuestion
                        UPDATE r5reliabilityrankingquests
                        SET    rrq_question  = @sQuestion
                        WHERE  rrq_question  = @sOldQuestion
                        AND    rrq_levelpk   = @sOldPk

                     IF COALESCE( @sOldFormula, '@#$' ) <> COALESCE( @sFormula, '@#$' )
                        -- Update column rrk_setuplastupdated
                        UPDATE r5reliabilityrankings
                        SET    rrk_setuplastupdated = getdate()
                        WHERE  rrk_code     = @sReliabilityranking
                        AND    rrk_org      = @sOrg
                        AND    rrk_revision = @nRevision

                     fetch next from c_ins_del into @sPk,    @sDesc,    @sOrg,    @sQuestion, @sReliabilityranking, @nRevision, @sFormula,
                                                    @sOldPk, @sOldDesc, @sOldOrg, @sOldQuestion, @sOldFormula
                  end
               close c_ins_del
            end
         deallocate c_ins_del
      end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_SEV
ON r5customersurveyevents
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @pk              NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @survey          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @surveyorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @surveytaken     NVARCHAR(  1 )
  DECLARE @oldsurveytaken  NVARCHAR(  1 )
  DECLARE @question        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newpk           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @r               INT
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR(  4 )

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
    
      DECLARE c_ins_del CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT i.sev_pk, i.sev_survey, i.sev_survey_org, i.sev_surveytaken, d.sev_surveytaken  
        FROM   inserted i, deleted d
        WHERE  i.sev_sqlidentity = d.sev_sqlidentity
      OPEN c_ins_del
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @pk, @survey, @surveyorg, @surveytaken, @oldsurveytaken 
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @oldsurveytaken = N'-' AND @surveytaken = N'+'
            BEGIN
              DECLARE csq CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
                SELECT csq_code
                FROM   r5customersurveyquestions
                WHERE  csq_survey     = @survey
                AND    csq_survey_org = @surveyorg
                AND    csq_notused    = N'-'
                AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                   FROM   r5customersurveyresponses
                                   WHERE  ser_customersurveyevent = @pk
                                   AND    ser_question            = csq_code )
              OPEN csq
              FETCH NEXT FROM csq INTO @question
              WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                BEGIN
                  EXECUTE @r = r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'SER', '1', @chk OUTPUT                       
                  IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @r <> 0
                    BEGIN
                      CLOSE csq
                      DEALLOCATE csq
                      CLOSE c_ins_del
                      DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                      ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                      RETURN
                    END
                  INSERT INTO r5customersurveyresponses ( ser_pk, ser_customersurveyevent, ser_question )
                  VALUES( @newpk, @pk, @question )
                  FETCH NEXT FROM csq INTO @question
                END
              CLOSE csq
              DEALLOCATE csq
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @pk, @survey, @surveyorg, @surveytaken, @oldsurveytaken 
        END
      CLOSE c_ins_del
      DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
    END
END

									return

        begin
          close c_ins_del
          deallocate c_ins_del
          rollback transaction
          return
        end  
        
        fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc
      end
      close c_ins_del
    end
    deallocate c_ins_del
  end

CREATE TRIGGER POSUPD_SWS
ON r5syncwspsetup
FOR INSERT, UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @swstable        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swsaction       NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @swsactive       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyflddate1  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swskeyflddate2  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @oldswsactive    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @insstat         NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @abb             NVARCHAR( 3 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT i.sws_table, i.sws_action, i.sws_active, i.sws_keyfld1, i.sws_keyfld2, i.sws_keyfld3, i.sws_keyfld4,
               i.sws_keyfld5, i.sws_keyfld6, i.sws_keyfld7, i.sws_keyfld8, i.sws_keyflddate1, i.sws_keyflddate2, ISNULL( d.sws_active, 'x' ) 
        FROM   inserted i LEFT OUTER JOIN deleted d ON ( d.sws_sqlidentity = i.sws_sqlidentity )
      OPEN c_ins
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @swstable, @swsaction, @swsactive, @swskeyfld1, @swskeyfld2, @swskeyfld3, @swskeyfld4,
                                 @swskeyfld5, @swskeyfld6, @swskeyfld7, @swskeyfld8, @swskeyflddate1, @swskeyflddate2, @oldswsactive
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @swsactive <> @oldswsactive
            BEGIN
              /* Retrieve 3 charcater abbreviation of table. */
              SELECT @abb = SUBSTRING( c.name, 1, 3 )
              FROM   sysobjects t ,syscolumns c
              WHERE  t.type = 'U'
              AND    t.name = @swstable
              AND    c.id   = t.id
              AND    c.name LIKE '%SQLIDENTITY'
              /* Construct the insert into the temp table, needed for deletes. */
              SET @insstat =  '          INSERT INTO r5syncwsptemp( swt_pk, swt_keyfld1, swt_keyfld2, swt_keyfld3, swt_keyfld4, ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'                 swt_keyfld5, swt_keyfld6, swt_keyfld7, swt_keyfld8, swt_keyflddate1, swt_keyflddate2 ) ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'          SELECT @pk, ' + CASE WHEN @swskeyfld1 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld1 END +', '+
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld2 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld2 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld3 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld3 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld4 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld4 END + ', ' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld5 IS NULL THEN '                  NULL' ELSE '                  d.' + @swskeyfld5 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld6 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld6 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld7 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld7 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyfld8 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyfld8 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyflddate1 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyflddate1 END + ', ' +
CASE WHEN @swskeyflddate2 IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'd.' + @swskeyflddate2 END + ' FROM deleted d WHERE ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity '
              /* Activate/Deactivate sync WSP. */
              EXECUTE o7syncwsptrigger @swstable, @swsaction, @swsactive, @insstat, @abb
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @swstable, @swsaction, @swsactive, @swskeyfld1, @swskeyfld2, @swskeyfld3, @swskeyfld4,
                                     @swskeyfld5, @swskeyfld6, @swskeyfld7, @swskeyfld8, @swskeyflddate1, @swskeyflddate2, @oldswsactive
        END 
    END

create trigger POSUPD_TCM
on R5CASEMANAGEMENTTASKS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser             nvarchar(38)
  declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCode             nvarchar(30)
  declare @sOrg              nvarchar(15)
  declare @sDesc             nvarchar(80)
  declare @sOldDesc          nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWODesc		     nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWOOldDesc		 nvarchar(80)
  declare @sWOCheckresult    nvarchar(4)
  declare @nWOReturn	     int
  declare @nReturn           int
  declare @sCasemanagement   nvarchar(30)
  declare @sTaskForChklst    nvarchar(30)
  declare @sTaskRevForChklst nvarchar(4)
  declare @sOldTaskForChklst    nvarchar(30)
  declare @sOldTaskRevForChklst nvarchar(4)
  declare @sCaseOrg				nvarchar(15)
  declare @sCaseStatus			nvarchar(8)
  declare @sPerformed       datetime
  declare @sOldPerformed    datetime
  declare @sReviewed        datetime
  declare @sOldReviewed     datetime
  declare @sReviewedType    nvarchar(4)
  declare @sSeqno           bigint
  declare @sUserid          nvarchar(255)
  declare @sUserName        nvarchar(255)
  declare @sReviewedBy      nvarchar(255)
  declare @sPerformedBy     nvarchar(255)
  declare @nProcReturn	    int
  

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare c_updated cursor local for select i.tcm_code, i.tcm_desc, i.tcm_wo_desc, i.tcm_casemanagement, i.tcm_chklst_task, i.tcm_chklst_taskrev, 
    i.tcm_performed, i.tcm_performedby, i.tcm_reviewed,i.tcm_reviewedby, d.tcm_desc, d.tcm_wo_desc, d.tcm_chklst_task, d.tcm_chklst_taskrev, d.tcm_performed, d.tcm_reviewed  
    from   inserted i, deleted d 
    where i.tcm_sqlidentity = d.tcm_sqlidentity

    set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    
    if @sUser <> N'SYS'
    begin
      open c_updated
      fetch next from c_updated into @sCode, @sDesc, @sWODesc, @sCasemanagement, @sTaskForChklst, @sTaskRevForChklst, 
      @sPerformed, @sPerformedBy, @sReviewed, @sReviewedBy, @sOldDesc, @sWOOldDesc, @sOldTaskForChklst, @sOldTaskRevForChklst, @sOldPerformed, @sOldReviewed 
      

      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        
        --POSUPD_TCM portion

        set @sX = NULL
        set @sOrg = NULL
        set @sCheckresult = N'0'
        set @sWOCheckresult = N'0'

        /* Update descriptions */
        IF @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
			BEGIN
				execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CMTK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, 
                  @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
            END

        /* WO Description updates */
		IF @sWODesc IS NOT NULL AND @sWOOldDesc IS NULL
			BEGIN
		    	execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CATM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
			 END
		ELSE IF @sWODesc IS NULL AND @sWOOldDesc IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
		    	execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CATM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
			END
		ELSE IF @sWODesc <> @sWOOldDesc 
			BEGIN
		    	execute @nWOReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CATM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sWODesc, @sWOCheckresult OUTPUT
			END
		if coalesce(@sTaskForChklst, 'x') <> coalesce(@sOldTaskForChklst, 'x') OR  coalesce(@sTaskRevForChklst, -1) <> coalesce(@sOldTaskRevForChklst, -1)
          begin
    		execute @nProcReturn = o7createactchecklist @sCasemanagement, 0, @sTaskForChklst, @sTaskRevForChklst, 
                      NULL, '%', '-', '-', '-', NULL, @sCode ;
		  end
		  
		  execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                    begin
                                        close c_inserted
                                        deallocate c_inserted
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                                    end
		/* Reset Case Management esignature information */
		UPDATE r5casemanagement SET csm_reviewed = null, csm_reviewedby = null, csm_reviewedtype = null WHERE csm_code = @sCasemanagement;  
		  /* insert event log record when Performed by or Reviewed by action done in checklist tab */
		IF ISNULL( @sOldPerformed, getDate() + 1 ) <> @sPerformed or ISNULL( @sOldReviewed, getDate() + 1 ) <> @sReviewed
          BEGIN   
            IF ISNULL( @sOldPerformed, getDate() + 1 ) <> @sPerformed
              BEGIN
                set @sReviewedType = 'PB01'
               set  @sUserName     = @sPerformedBy
              END
            ELSE IF ISNULL( @sOldReviewed, getDate() + 1 ) <> @sReviewed
              BEGIN
                set @sReviewedType = 'RB01'
                set @sUserName     = @sReviewedBy
              END
              
              BEGIN
                select	@sCaseStatus = csm_status,
					@sCaseOrg = csm_org
					from r5casemanagement where csm_code = @sCasemanagement
			  END	
			            
               execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'CML', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
               INSERT INTO r5casemanagementeventlog( cml_code, cml_casecode, cml_eventtype, cml_eventlog_date, cml_fromstatus, cml_tostatus, cml_esigntype, cml_user,cml_created, cml_createdby )
               VALUES( @sSeqno, @sCasemanagement, N'ESIG', dbo.o7gttime2( @sCaseOrg ), @sCaseStatus, @sCaseStatus, @sReviewedType, @sUserName,dbo.o7gttime2( @sCaseOrg ), @sUserid)
          END
		  
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @nWOReturn <> 0 or @nProcReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_updated
          deallocate c_updated
          rollback transaction
          return
        end  
        
        fetch next from c_updated into @sCode, @sDesc, @sWODesc, @sCasemanagement, @sTaskForChklst, @sTaskRevForChklst, 
	      @sPerformed, @sPerformedBy, @sReviewed, @sReviewedBy, @sOldDesc, @sWOOldDesc, @sOldTaskForChklst, @sOldTaskRevForChklst, @sOldPerformed, @sOldReviewed
      end
      close c_updated
    end
    deallocate c_updated
  end

create trigger POSUPD_TKD
on R5TRACKINGDATA
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     		bigint
	declare @sTrans       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @dTrackdate   		datetime            
	declare @sRstatus     		nvarchar(4)         
	
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TKD_TRANSID,	i.TKD_TRANS,	i.TKD_RSTATUS
												from inserted i
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@sTrans,	@sRstatus
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sRstatus = N'R'
								begin
									if exists (   SELECT 1 FROM r5arctrackdata WHERE atd_transorgid = @nTransid )
										begin
											--The Oracle version for some reason puts rows in a temporary table and then 
											--	cursors through those rows and calls o7interface.arcupd for each row in there.
											--  I am going to just make the o7interface call as I go through the rows here.

											execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ARCUP1 @nTransid, @sTrans
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_DELAPI @nTransid
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
								
							-- databridge event
							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@TKDATA'
																
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@TKDATA'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'
							
							if @sFlag = N'Y'
							begin
																				
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
																							
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
								INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
								(XTS_TRANTYPE,
								XTS_TABLE,
								XTS_KEYFLD1,
								XTS_KEYFLD2,
								XTS_KEYFLD3,
								XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
								)
								SELECT N'TKDATA',
								N'R5TRACKINGDATA',
								@nTransid,
								@sTrans,
								N'R',
								@sTempMsgid
								WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM R5XMLTRANSTATUS WHERE XTS_TRANTYPE=N'TKDATA' AND XTS_KEYFLD1=@nTransid)
							end
							

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@sTrans,	@sRstatus
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger POSUPD_TKP
on R5TRACKINGPROMPTS
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sTrans          		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nSqlidentity    		integer             
	declare @sTemp					nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount					integer
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @dUpdated			datetime

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					set @sTemp = N'INS'
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TKP_TRANS, i.TKP_SQLIDENTITY, NULL, NULL
													from inserted i

				end
			else
				begin
					set @sTemp = N'UPD'
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TKP_TRANS, i.TKP_SQLIDENTITY, i.TKP_UPDATECOUNT, d.TKP_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.TKP_SQLIDENTITY = d.TKP_SQLIDENTITY
				end

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sTrans,	@nSqlidentity, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @nCount = 0
							select @nCount = count(1)
							from r5trackingprompts
							where	tkp_trans    = @sTrans  and
									tkp_datatype = N'FFT'
							
							if @nCount > 1
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'TMASTP', N'FORM', 31
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							if @sTemp = N'UPD'
								begin
									if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
										update R5TRACKINGPROMPTS set TKP_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where TKP_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlidentity
									else
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

			
									set @dUpdated = GetDate()
									update R5TRACKINGPROMPTS set tkp_updated = @dUpdated  where TKP_SQLIDENTITY	= @nSqlidentity
									
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sTrans,	@nSqlidentity, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParentEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sEventOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dEventInterface	datetime
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(400)
	declare @sTempMsgid		nvarchar(256)  
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select TOR_EVENT from inserted
			
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							
							/*************************************************
							  Databridge workorder outbound event
							*************************************************/
							select @sFlag = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' )
							from r5install
							where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'

							if @sFlag = N'A'
							begin
								select	@sEventRstatus = evt_rstatus,
									@sEventRtype = evt_rtype,
									@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
									@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
									@sEventOrg = evt_org,
									@dEventInterface = evt_interface
								from r5events where evt_code = @sEvent

								if (@sEventRtype = N'JOB' or @sEventRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sEventRstatus = N'C' or @sEventRstatus = N'R') 
								begin
									select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
									from r5ucodes
									where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
									if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dEventInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvent										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dEventInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sEventOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end
								end
							end
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger POSUPD_TUI
on R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     		bigint
	declare @dCreated     		datetime            
	declare @sSourcesystem		nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sSourcecode  		nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sEvent       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAct         		numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sMrc         		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sTool        		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dDateused    		datetime            
	declare @nQty         		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nHours       		numeric(12,2)       
	declare @nTariff      		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCost        		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sTrans       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nSessionid   		integer
	declare @nTransorgid  		bigint
	declare @nTransgroup  		integer
	declare @sTranstype   		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sUser        		nvarchar(255)        
	declare @sOrg         		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer             

	declare @nOldTransid     	bigint
	declare @dOldCreated     	datetime            
	declare @sOldSourcesystem	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sOldSourcecode  	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sOldEvent       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldAct         	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sOldMrc         	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldTool        	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dOldDateused    	datetime            
	declare @nOldQty         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOldHours       	numeric(12,2)       
	declare @nOldTariff      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOldCost        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sOldTrans       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nOldSessionid   	integer
	declare @nOldTransorgid  	bigint
	declare @nOldTransgroup  	integer
	declare @sOldTranstype   	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldUser        	nvarchar(255)        
	declare @sOldOrg         	nvarchar(15)   
	
	declare @nReturn			integer     

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TUI_TRANSID,	i.TUI_CREATED,	i.TUI_SOURCESYSTEM,	i.TUI_SOURCECODE,	i.TUI_EVENT,
													  	i.TUI_ACT,	i.TUI_MRC,	i.TUI_TOOL,	i.TUI_DATEUSED,	i.TUI_QTY,
													  	i.TUI_HOURS,	i.TUI_TARIFF,	i.TUI_COST,	i.TUI_TRANS,	i.TUI_SESSIONID,
													  	i.TUI_TRANSORGID,	i.TUI_TRANSGROUP,	i.TUI_TRANSTYPE,	i.TUI_USER,	i.TUI_ORG,
													 	i.TUI_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.TUI_TRANSID,	d.TUI_CREATED,	d.TUI_SOURCESYSTEM,	d.TUI_SOURCECODE,	d.TUI_EVENT,
													  	d.TUI_ACT,	d.TUI_MRC,	d.TUI_TOOL,	d.TUI_DATEUSED,	d.TUI_QTY,
													  	d.TUI_HOURS,	d.TUI_TARIFF,	d.TUI_COST,	d.TUI_TRANS,	d.TUI_SESSIONID,
													  	d.TUI_TRANSORGID,	d.TUI_TRANSGROUP,	d.TUI_TRANSTYPE,	d.TUI_USER,	d.TUI_ORG
													  
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.TUI_SQLIDENTITY = d.TUI_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sEvent,
												   	@nAct,	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@dDateused,	@nQty,
												   	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@sTrans,	@nSessionid,
												   	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTranstype,	@sUser,	@sOrg,
												   	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldTransid,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldSourcesystem,	@sOldSourcecode,	@sOldEvent,
													@nOldAct,	@sOldMrc,	@sOldTool,	@dOldDateused,	@nOldQty,
													@nOldHours,	@nOldTariff,	@nOldCost,	@sOldTrans,	@nOldSessionid,
													@nOldTransorgid,	@nOldTransgroup,	@sOldTranstype,	@sOldUser,	@sOldOrg
												
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--The Oracle version for some reason puts rows in a temporary table and then 
							--	cursors through those rows and calls o7interface.arcupd for each row in there.
							--  I am going to just make the o7interface call as I go through the rows here.

							execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ARCUPD @nTransid, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, @sTrans, N'TOUS', N'R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE', N'TUI'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sEvent,
														   	@nAct,	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@dDateused,	@nQty,
														   	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@sTrans,	@nSessionid,
														   	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTranstype,	@sUser,	@sOrg,

create trigger POSUPD_UDL
on r5userdefinedfieldlovvals
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser        nvarchar(38)
  declare @sUEntity     nvarchar(4)
  declare @sX           nvarchar(1)
  declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(4)
  declare @sREntity     nvarchar(4)
  declare @sField       nvarchar(20)
  declare @sCode        nvarchar(80)
  declare @sDesc        nvarchar(80)
  declare @sDescPK      nvarchar(100)
  declare @sOldREntity  nvarchar(4)
  declare @sOldField    nvarchar(20)
  declare @sOldCode     nvarchar(80)
  declare @nReturn      int

  declare @nUpdatecount		int
  declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
  declare @nSqlIdentity		int

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_ins_del cursor local for
        select i.udl_rentity, i.udl_field, i.udl_code, i.udl_desc, d.udl_rentity, d.udl_field, d.udl_code,
                i.UDL_UPDATECOUNT, d.UDL_UPDATECOUNT, i.UDL_SQLIDENTITY
        from   inserted i, deleted d
        where i.UDL_SQLIDENTITY = d.UDL_SQLIDENTITY

      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_ins_del
          fetch next from c_ins_del into @sREntity, @sField, @sCode, @sDesc, @sOldREntity, @sOldField, @sOldCode,
                                            @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              set @sCheckresult = N'0'

              if ( @sREntity <> @sOldREntity OR @sField <>  @sOldField OR @sCode <> @sOldCode )
                begin
                  close c_ins_del
                  deallocate c_ins_del
                  execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sUEntity OUTPUT, @sREntity, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_inserted
                  deallocate c_inserted
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              set @sCheckresult = N'0'
              set @sDescPK = @sField + @sCode
              execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'UDLV', @sUEntity, @sREntity, @sDescPK, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
              if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                  close c_ins_del
                  deallocate c_ins_del
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

              if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                begin
                  close c_ins_del
                  deallocate c_ins_del
                  execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                  rollback transaction
                  return
                end

		update r5userdefinedfieldlovvals set UDL_UPDATED = GetDate() where UDL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

              --preupd2 portion
              if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
				    update r5userdefinedfieldlovvals set UDL_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where UDL_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
			  else
			      begin
					    close c_ins_del
					    deallocate c_ins_del
					    execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
					    rollback transaction
					    return
			      end

              fetch next from c_ins_del into @sREntity, @sField, @sCode, @sDesc, @sOldREntity, @sOldField, @sOldCode,
                                             @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
            end
          close c_ins_del
        end
      deallocate c_ins_del
    end

ON r5alerts
INSTEAD OF DELETE
AS
  DECLARE @sysuser    NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @code       NVARCHAR(30)        

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT alt_code 
        FROM   deleted
      SET @sysuser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      OPEN c_deleted
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @code
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @sysuser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
              -- Delete child records.
              DELETE FROM r5alertmail 
              WHERE  alm_alert = @code
              DELETE FROM r5alerttextparams 
              WHERE  atp_alert = @code
              -- Delete actual record.
              DELETE FROM r5alerts 
              WHERE alt_code = @code
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @code
        END
      CLOSE c_deleted
      DEALLOCATE c_deleted
    END

create trigger PREDEL_APR
on R5ADDPROPERTIES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    --This trigger combines the following into one:
    --  presdel_apr
    --  predel_apr
    --  posdel_apr
    --  possdel_apr
    --  o7prop.apr_to_delete
    --  o7prop.delete_values
    --  o7prop.delete_lovs
    --  o7prop.clear_aprdel_tab
    --
    --This was done because in SQL Server there are no BEFORE or FOR EACH ROW triggers.
    --Therefore all of the four DELETE triggers for this table had to be combined into one.
    --Since the package was used to hold elements from each different timing, it was no longer necessary.
    --Its functionality has been moved here as well.
    --The BEFORE STATEMENT trigger functionality is not necessary due to the new implementation.
    --o7prop.clear_aprdel_tab is also not necessaery in the new implementation
    declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
    declare @sPtype         nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
    declare @sProperty      nvarchar(8)
    declare @sRentity       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sClass         nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg      nvarchar(15)
    declare @sList          nchar(1)
    declare @nCount         int
    declare @sCursor        nvarchar(255)
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @sCode          nvarchar(100)
    declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_deleted cursor local for select APR_PROPERTY, APR_RENTITY, APR_CLASS, APR_CLASS_ORG, APR_LIST from deleted
            create table #tAprDel ( Prop    nvarchar(8),
                                    Ltyp    nvarchar(1),
                                    Ptyp    nvarchar(8),
                                    Rent    nvarchar(4),
                                    Clas    nvarchar(8),
                                    Clsorg  nvarchar(15) )
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_deleted
                    fetch next from c_deleted into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sList
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            --BEFORE EACH ROW portion
                            SELECT @sPtype = pro_type
                              FROM r5properties
                             WHERE pro_code = @sProperty

                            if @sPtype <> N'RENT' and @sList <> N'-'
                                begin
                                    --o7prop.apr_to_delete functionality here
                                    select  @nCount = count(*)
                                      from  #tAprDel
                                     where  Prop    = @sProperty    AND
                                            Rent    = @sRentity     AND
                                            Clas    = @sClass       AND
                                            Clsorg  = @sClassOrg
                                    if @nCount = 0
                                        insert into #tAprDel values ( @sProperty, @sList, @sPtype, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg )
                                end

                            --AFTER EACH ROW portion
                            --o7prop.delete_values functionality here
                            DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
                                WHERE prv_property  = @sProperty
                                AND   prv_rentity   = @sRentity
                                AND   prv_class     = @sClass
                                AND   prv_class_org = @sClassOrg
                                AND   prv_code IS NOT NULL

                                -- need to update both list view and record view.
                                update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                where pgc_rentity=@sRentity
                                and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')

                                /* If handling PART or OBJ or EVNT entity, then translate to PEVL or EEVL or PPM respectively */
                                /* SSEVAL shows PART custom fields , OSEVAL shows OBJ custom fields and WSPPMS shows EVNT custom fields */
                                if( @sRentity = 'PART' OR @sRentity = 'OBJ' )
                                   begin
                                      update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                         where pgc_rentity= CASE @sRentity 
                                         		    WHEN 'PART' THEN 'PEVL'
                                         		    ELSE 'EEVL' END
                                         and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')
                                   end

                                if( @sRentity = 'EVNT' )
                                   begin
                                      update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                         where pgc_rentity in ( N'PPM', N'STWO' )
                                         and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')
                                   end

							-- Clean up any Group Label translations
							set @sCode = @sProperty + '#' + @sRentity + '#' + @sClass + '#' + @sClassOrg
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', NULL, N'CFGL', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, NULL, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

                            fetch next from c_deleted into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sList
                        end
                    close c_deleted

                    --AFTER STATEMENT portion
                    declare c_apr_del cursor local for select Prop, Ltyp, Ptyp, Rent, Clas, Clsorg from #tAprDel
                    --o7prop.delete_lovs functionality here
                    execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROP', N'DELETE_IS_CASCADING', N'TRUE'
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                            drop table #tAprDel
                            deallocate c_deleted
                            rollback transaction
                            return
                        end


                    open c_apr_del
                    fetch next from c_apr_del into @sProperty, @sList, @sPtype, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if dbo.O7PROP_LIST_EXISTS( @sProperty, @sPtype, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sList ) = 1
                                begin
                                    DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
                                    WHERE prv_code IS NULL
                                    AND   prv_property   = @sProperty
                                    AND   prv_rentity    = CASE @sList WHEN N'P' THEN N'*' ELSE @sRentity END
                                    AND   prv_class      = CASE @sList WHEN N'C' THEN @sClass ELSE N'*' END
                                    AND   prv_class_org  = @sClassOrg

create trigger PREDEL_BOO
on R5BOOKEDHOURS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nACD				bigint
	declare @nHours				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nACT				numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOcrType			nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDesc              nvarchar(80)
    declare @sMisc              nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select BOO_ACD, BOO_OCRTYPE, BOO_HOURS, BOO_ACT, BOO_EVENT, BOO_DESC, BOO_MISC from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = Null
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @nACD, @sOcrType, @nHours,  @nACT, @sEvent, @sDesc, @sMisc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
							/* W0331 - Deletion not allowed, unless archived. */
							IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
							FROM   r5bookedhours_archive
							WHERE  abk_event = @sEvent)
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_BOO', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							--posdel_boo
							/* W0340 - Update activity */
                            if @sMisc = '-'
                                begin
							        execute @nReturn = o7upact1 0, @nHours, @sOcrType,@nACT, @sEvent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
							        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								        begin
									        close c_deleted
									        deallocate c_deleted
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
							        if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								        begin
									        close c_deleted
									        deallocate c_deleted
									        execute O7RAE N'O7UPACT1', N'PROC', N'1', @@ERROR
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
                                end

							--posdel_boo2
							DELETE FROM r5accountdetail WHERE acd_code = @nACD

							IF @sEvent IS NOT NULL
								/* Flag WO as to recalculate costs. */
								UPDATE r5eventcost
								SET    evo_recalccost = N'+', evo_costcalculated = N'-'
								WHERE  evo_event = @sEvent
								AND    ISNULL( evo_recalccost, N'-' ) <> N'+'

							fetch next from c_deleted into @nACD, @sOcrType, @nHours,  @nACT, @sEvent, @sDesc, @sMisc
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_CLS
on R5CLASSES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRentity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRentitycode		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select CLS_CODE, CLS_ORG, CLS_RENTITY, CLS_RENTITYCODE from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, @sRentitycode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
							set @nCountit = 0
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'R5CLAS', N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, N'*', N'*', N'*', N'*', @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							if @nCountit = 0
								set @sX = null
							else
								begin
									if @nCountit > 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_CLS', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_CLS', N'TRIG', N'999', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
								
							execute O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_CLS', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
								

							if (@sRentity = N'FUNC') and (@sOrg = @sDeforg)
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_CLS', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							if @sRentity = N'OBJ'
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5actclasses
									WHERE  acl_class     = @sCode
									AND    acl_class_org = @sOrg

									DELETE FROM r5reqclasses
									WHERE  rcl_class     = @sCode
									AND    rcl_class_org = @sOrg

									DELETE FROM r5causeclasses
									WHERE  cac_class     = @sCode
									AND    cac_class_org = @sOrg

									DELETE FROM r5failureclasses
									WHERE  fca_class     = @sCode
									AND    fca_class_org = @sOrg
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'CLAS', @sRentitycode, @sRentity, @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, @sRentitycode
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_DCK
on R5DOCKRECEIPTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode        	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg         	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sStatus      	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRstatus     	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSupplier    	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSupplier_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrder       	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrder_org   	nvarchar(15)
	declare @dRecvdate    	datetime
	declare @sDockid      	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sLocation    	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sShipvia     	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPackslip    	nvarchar(45)
	declare @sFreight     	nvarchar(24)
	declare @sReference   	nvarchar(45)
	declare @sMrc         	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sReceiver    	nvarchar(15)
	declare @dCreated     	datetime
	declare @sUser        	nvarchar(255)
	declare @dUpdated     	datetime
	declare @sUpduser     	nvarchar(255)
	declare @sClass       	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	DCK_CODE,	DCK_ORG,	DCK_DESC,	DCK_STATUS,	DCK_RSTATUS,
													  	DCK_SUPPLIER,	DCK_SUPPLIER_ORG,	DCK_ORDER,	DCK_ORDER_ORG,	DCK_RECVDATE,
													  	DCK_DOCKID,	DCK_LOCATION,	DCK_SHIPVIA,	DCK_PACKSLIP,	DCK_FREIGHT,
													  	DCK_REFERENCE,	DCK_MRC,	DCK_RECEIVER,	DCK_CREATED,	DCK_USER,
													  	DCK_UPDATED,	DCK_UPDUSER,	DCK_CLASS,	DCK_CLASS_ORG,	DCK_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	DCK_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
												   	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,	@sOrder,	@sOrder_org,	@dRecvdate,
												   	@sDockid,	@sLocation,	@sShipvia,	@sPackslip,	@sFreight,
												   	@sReference,	@sMrc,	@sReceiver,	@dCreated,	@sUser,
												   	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sRstatus <> N'U' and @sRstatus <> N'C'
								begin
									IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5dockreceipts_archive WHERE  adt_code = @sCode)
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_DCK', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--posdel_dck portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							execute @nReturn = o7descs N'DEL', @sX, N'DOCK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
														   	@sSupplier,	@sSupplier_org,	@sOrder,	@sOrder_org,	@dRecvdate,
														   	@sDockid,	@sLocation,	@sShipvia,	@sPackslip,	@sFreight,
														   	@sReference,	@sMrc,	@sReceiver,	@dCreated,	@sUser,
														   	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
														   	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_DDS
on R5DDDATASPY
for delete
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sDdspyname        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nDdspyid          	numeric(14,0)       
	declare @sAutorun          	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sScope            	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOrganization     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dUpdatestamp      	datetime            
	declare @sUpdatebyuser     	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dCreatedstamp     	datetime            
	declare @sUpdateable       	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sFilterstrxml     	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @sSortstrxml       	varchar(2000)       
	declare @sFieldlist        	varchar(2200)       
	declare @nUpdatecount      	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nDisplayrow       	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOwner            	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nGridid           	numeric(14,0)       
	declare @sType             	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sDefaultflag      	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sFieldlist_portlet	varchar(500)        
	declare @nClientrows       	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nPortletrows      	numeric(2,0)        
	declare @sHints            	varchar(255)        
	declare @sBotname          	varchar(61)         
	declare @nSqlidentity      	integer             
	declare @sUserfilter       	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @sSecuritydataspy  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sMekey            	nvarchar(10)        

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	DDS_DDSPYNAME,	DDS_DDSPYID,	DDS_AUTORUN,	DDS_SCOPE,	DDS_ORGANIZATION,
													  	DDS_UPDATESTAMP,	DDS_UPDATEBYUSER,	DDS_CREATEDSTAMP,	DDS_UPDATEABLE,	DDS_FILTERSTRXML,
													  	DDS_SORTSTRXML,	DDS_FIELDLIST,	DDS_UPDATECOUNT,	DDS_DISPLAYROW,	DDS_OWNER,
													  	DDS_GRIDID,	DDS_TYPE,	DDS_DEFAULTFLAG,	DDS_FIELDLIST_PORTLET,	DDS_CLIENTROWS,
													  	DDS_PORTLETROWS,	DDS_HINTS,	DDS_BOTNAME,	DDS_SQLIDENTITY,	DDS_USERFILTER,
													  	DDS_SECURITYDATASPY,	DDS_MEKEY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sDdspyname,	@nDdspyid,	@sAutorun,	@sScope,	@sOrganization,
												   	@dUpdatestamp,	@sUpdatebyuser,	@dCreatedstamp,	@sUpdateable,	@sFilterstrxml,
												   	@sSortstrxml,	@sFieldlist,	@nUpdatecount,	@nDisplayrow,	@sOwner,
												   	@nGridid,	@sType,	@sDefaultflag,	@sFieldlist_portlet,	@nClientrows,
												   	@nPortletrows,	@sHints,	@sBotname,	@nSqlidentity,	@sUserfilter,
												   	@sSecuritydataspy,	@sMekey
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if exists ( select 1 FROM r5grid
                                        WHERE grd_gridid = @nGridid
                                        AND grd_gridtype = 8 )
                                UPDATE r5alerts
                                   SET alt_dataspyid = null,
                                       alt_active = N'-',
                                       alt_nexteval = null
                                 WHERE alt_dataspyid = @nDdspyid

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sDdspyname,	@nDdspyid,	@sAutorun,	@sScope,	@sOrganization,
														   	@dUpdatestamp,	@sUpdatebyuser,	@dCreatedstamp,	@sUpdateable,	@sFilterstrxml,
														   	@sSortstrxml,	@sFieldlist,	@nUpdatecount,	@nDisplayrow,	@sOwner,
														   	@nGridid,	@sType,	@sDefaultflag,	@sFieldlist_portlet,	@nClientrows,
														   	@nPortletrows,	@sHints,	@sBotname,	@nSqlidentity,	@sUserfilter,
														   	@sSecuritydataspy,	@sMekey
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

name: PREDEL_EAS
body:
create trigger PREDEL_EAS
on R5EVENTASPECTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @dClosed		datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare	@sX			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sAspect		nvarchar(30)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select EAS_EVENT, EAS_ASPECT from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent, @sAspect
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'	
							set @nCountit = 0
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
							FROM   r5events  e
							WHERE  e.evt_code   = @sEvent
							AND    coalesce( e.evt_routerstatus, 'U' ) = 'U'

							if @nCountit > 0
								set @sX = null
							else
								begin
									IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5eventaspects_archive WHERE  aec_aspect = @sAspect AND    aec_event  = @sEvent )
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											set @sCheckresult = N'990'
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_EAS', N'TRIG', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent, @sAspect
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end
