create trigger PREDEL_ELA
on R5ELECARCHIVE
for delete
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dDate       	datetime            
	declare @sSigntype   	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sScode      	nvarchar(100)       
	declare @sAcode      	nvarchar(100)       
	declare @sEntity     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sEntcode    	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sEntorg     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sStatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer        
	declare @sCheckResult	nvarchar(4)
	     

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	ELA_CODE,	ELA_USER,	ELA_DATE,	ELA_SIGNTYPE,	ELA_SCODE,
													  	ELA_ACODE,	ELA_ENTITY,	ELA_ENTCODE,	ELA_ENTORG,	ELA_STATUS,
													  	ELA_SQLIDENTITY
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckResult= N'2'
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sUser,	@dDate,	@sSigntype,	@sScode,
												   	@sAcode,	@sEntity,	@sEntcode,	@sEntorg,	@sStatus,
												   	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							
							/* W0331 Delete not allowed  */
							IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
							FROM   r5elecarchive_archive
							WHERE  aea_code = @sCode ) 
								begin
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_ELA', N'TRIG', @sCheckResult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sUser,	@dDate,	@sSigntype,	@sScode,
														   	@sAcode,	@sEntity,	@sEntcode,	@sEntorg,	@sStatus,
														   	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)

	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nCountit		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select EPO_CODE, EPO_EVENT from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--predel_epo portion
							select @nCountit = count(*)
							FROM   r5events  e
							WHERE  e.evt_code = @sEvent
							AND    isnull( e.evt_routerstatus, N'U' )  <> N'U'
							if @nCountit > 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_EPO', N'TRIG', N'990', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--posdel_epo portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'INRL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							--Reset work order esignature information
							DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sEvent and ets_updatecount <> -999						
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sEvent
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_HMG
on R5HOMEGROUPS
for delete
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sHomcode    	nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sGroup      	nvarchar(12)  
	declare @sHomtype    	nvarchar(24)     
	declare @sHomgen	    nvarchar(1) 

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select HMG_HOMCODE, HMG_HOMTYPE, HMG_GROUP from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sHomcode, @sHomtype, @sGroup
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							SELECT @sHomgen = HOM_GEN FROM R5HOME WHERE HOM_CODE = @sHomcode AND HOM_TYPE = @sHomtype
							if (@sHomgen = '-')
								DELETE FROM r5homeusers
								WHERE  hmu_user IN
									(SELECT usr_code
									FROM r5users
									WHERE usr_group   = @sGroup)
									AND   hmu_homcode = @sHomcode
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sHomcode, @sHomtype, @sGroup
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

								ivl_curr, ivl_sourcesystem, ivl_sourcecode, ivl_interface, ivl_exchtodual, ivl_exchfromdual, ivl_invoice_org,
								ivl_order_org, ivl_tax, ivl_tax2, ivl_tottaxamount, ivl_totextra, ivl_type, ivl_rtype, ivl_matched,
								ivl_returnqty, ivl_lostcredit, ivl_updatecount, ivl_sqlidentity
						FROM	deleted

					OPEN c_deleted
					FETCH NEXT
					FROM c_deleted
					INTO	@delivl_invoice, @delivl_invline, @delivl_order, @delivl_ordline, @delivl_invqty, @delivl_invvalue,
							@delivl_discount, @delivl_price, @delivl_exch, @delivl_curr, @delivl_sourcesystem, @delivl_sourcecode,
							@delivl_interface, @delivl_exchtodual, @delivl_exchfromdual, @delivl_invoice_org, @delivl_order_org,
							@delivl_tax, @delivl_tax2, @delivl_tottaxamount, @delivl_totextra, @delivl_type, @delivl_rtype,
							@delivl_matched, @delivl_returnqty, @delivl_lostcredit, @delivl_updatecount, @delivl_sqlidentity

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							-- BEGIN predel_ivl
							-- Initialize
							SET @checkresult = N'0'
							SET @x = NULL

							IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
							FROM   r5invoicelines_archive
							WHERE  aii_invoice = @delivl_invoice
							AND    aii_invoice_org = @delivl_invoice_org)
								begin
									-- P13411 invoice rstatus = 'U'
									EXECUTE @nReturn = o7existp	N'INV', N'4', @delivl_invoice, N'U', @delivl_invoice_org, @x, @x, @x,
																@nCountit OUTPUT, @checkresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										BEGIN
											CLOSE c_deleted
											DEALLOCATE c_deleted
											ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
											RETURN
										END

									IF @nCountit <= 0
										BEGIN
											IF @nCountit = 0
												BEGIN
													CLOSE c_deleted
													DEALLOCATE c_deleted
													EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREDEL_IVL', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
													RETURN
												END
											ELSE
												BEGIN
													CLOSE c_deleted
													DEALLOCATE c_deleted
													EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'O7EXISTP', N'PROC', @checkresult, @@ERROR
													ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
													RETURN
												END
										END
								end
							-- END predel_ivl

							-- BEGIN posdel_ivl
							DELETE FROM r5extcharges
							WHERE	ech_invord_code = @delivl_invoice
								AND	ech_invord_org  = @delivl_invoice_org
								AND	ech_invord_line = @delivl_invline

							DELETE FROM r5invdistributions
							WHERE	ivd_invoice = @delivl_invoice
								AND	ivd_org     = @delivl_invoice_org
								AND	ivd_line    = @delivl_invline
							-- END posdel_ivl

							FETCH NEXT
							FROM c_deleted
							INTO	@delivl_invoice, @delivl_invline, @delivl_order, @delivl_ordline, @delivl_invqty, @delivl_invvalue,
									@delivl_discount, @delivl_price, @delivl_exch, @delivl_curr, @delivl_sourcesystem, @delivl_sourcecode,
									@delivl_interface, @delivl_exchtodual, @delivl_exchfromdual, @delivl_invoice_org, @delivl_order_org,
									@delivl_tax, @delivl_tax2, @delivl_tottaxamount, @delivl_totextra, @delivl_type, @delivl_rtype,
									@delivl_matched, @delivl_returnqty, @delivl_lostcredit, @delivl_updatecount, @delivl_sqlidentity

						END
					CLOSE c_deleted
					DEALLOCATE c_deleted
				END
		END
END

CREATE TRIGGER PREDEL_MAP
ON r5mailparameters
FOR DELETE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @chk       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @mtamtemp  NVARCHAR( 100 ) 
  DECLARE @template  NVARCHAR( 18 )
  DECLARE @table     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @parameter NUMERIC( 2 )
  DECLARE @column    NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      EXECUTE o7dflt @mtamtemp OUTPUT, N'MTAMTEMP', @chk OUTPUT
      DECLARE c_del CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT map_template, map_table, map_parameter, map_column
        FROM   deleted
      OPEN c_del
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_del INTO @template, @table, @parameter, @column
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @template = @mtamtemp AND @table = N'R5MOBILENOTEBOOKS' AND @parameter = 1 AND @column = N'MNB_MNECODE'
            BEGIN
              EXECUTE o7rae N'PREDEL_CCL', N'TRIG', 1, NULL
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_del INTO @template, @table, @parameter, @column
        END
      CLOSE c_del
      DEALLOCATE c_del
    END
END

create trigger PREDEL_MPJ
on R5MPPROJECTS
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @sCode           	nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDesc           	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sMrc            	nvarchar(15)
	declare @dStartdate      	datetime
	declare @dEnddate        	datetime
	declare @sJobtype        	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sJobstatus      	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sTrade          	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObject         	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectclass    	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sProject        	nvarchar(20)
	declare @sPriority       	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sUser           	nvarchar(255)
	declare @dDate           	datetime
	declare @sDevice         	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sImp            	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sExp            	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sChild          	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSesstype       	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRstatus        	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sStatus         	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObjectclass_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObject_org     	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg            	nvarchar(15)

	declare @sTool           	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSupplier       	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nUpdatecount    	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nSqlidentity    	integer
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	MPJ_CODE,	MPJ_DESC,	MPJ_MRC,	MPJ_STARTDATE,	MPJ_ENDDATE,
													  	MPJ_JOBTYPE,	MPJ_JOBSTATUS,	MPJ_TRADE,	MPJ_OBJECT,	MPJ_OBJECTCLASS,

													  	MPJ_STATUS,	MPJ_OBJECTCLASS_ORG,	MPJ_OBJECT_ORG,	MPJ_ORG,	MPJ_PERSONNEL,
													  	MPJ_AUXILOBJ,	MPJ_TOOL,	MPJ_SUPPLIER,	MPJ_UPDATECOUNT,	MPJ_SQLIDENTITY

													from deleted

				begin

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sMrc,	@dStartdate,	@dEnddate,
														   	@sJobtype,	@sJobstatus,	@sTrade,	@sObject,	@sObjectclass,
														   	@sProject,	@sPriority,	@sUser,	@dDate,	@sDevice,
														   	@sImp,	@sExp,	@sChild,	@sSesstype,	@sRstatus,
														   	@sStatus,	@sObjectclass_org,	@sObject_org,	@sOrg,	@sPersonnel,
														   	@sAuxilobj,	@sTool,	@sSupplier,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity

						end

				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_MTL
on R5MATLISTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nRevision		numeric(4)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)

	declare @nMatlcnt		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(64)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select mtl_code, mtl_revision, mtl_org from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--Before each row portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nMatlcnt = 0

							if substring( @sCode, 1, 2 ) <> N'V-'
								begin
									select	@nMatlcnt = count(*)
									FROM	r5activities
									WHERE	act_matlist = @sCode
									if @nMatlcnt > 0 
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_MTL', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									select	@nMatlcnt = count(*)
									FROM	r5ppmacts
									WHERE	ppa_matlist = @sCode
									if @nMatlcnt > 0 
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_MTL', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									select	@nMatlcnt = count(*)
									FROM	r5standwacts
									WHERE	wac_matlist = @sCode
									if @nMatlcnt > 0 
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_MTL', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									select	@nMatlcnt = count(*)
									FROM	r5deferredact
									WHERE	dfa_matlist = @sCode
									if @nMatlcnt > 0 
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_MTL', N'TRIG', N'5', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--after each row portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							set @sConcat = @sCode + N'#' + cast( @nRevision as nvarchar(38) )
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'MATL', @sX, N'*', @sConcat, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_OAC
on R5OBJACTUALCONSUMPTION
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sUser        nvarchar(38)
  declare @sObject      nvarchar(30)
  declare @sObjectOrg   nvarchar(15)
  declare @sCommodity   nvarchar(15)
  declare @dDate        datetime 

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_deleted cursor local for 
        select OAC_OBJECT, OAC_OBJECT_ORG, OAC_COMMODITY, OAC_DATE from deleted
      set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      if @sUser <> N'SYS'
        begin
          open c_deleted 
          fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dDate
          while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
              DELETE FROM r5commodityenergyeff
              WHERE  cee_date       = @dDate
              AND    cee_object     = @sObject
              AND    cee_object_org = @sObjectOrg
              AND    cee_commodity  = @sCommodity
              AND    cee_origin     = N'C';

              UPDATE r5utilityrates
              SET    utr_indexed    = N'-'
              WHERE  utr_date       = @dDate
              AND    utr_object     = @sObject
              AND    utr_object_org = @sObjectOrg
              AND    utr_commodity  = @sCommodity
              AND    utr_calculatedaverage = N'+';

              fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dDate
            end
          close c_deleted
        end
      deallocate c_deleted
    end

create trigger PREDEL_OBJ
on R5OBJECTS
instead of delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sSysUser          nvarchar(38)
   declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
   declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
   declare @sSeqno            nvarchar(30)
   declare @sChk1             nvarchar(6)
   declare @nReturn           int
   declare @sConcat           nvarchar(50)
   declare @nErecord          int
   declare @sGetUser          nvarchar(255)
   declare @dGtTime           datetime
   declare @sGetStype         nvarchar(8)

   declare @sObtype           nvarchar(4)
   declare @sObrtype          nvarchar(4)
   declare @sCode             nvarchar(30)
   declare @nAcd              bigint
   declare @sOrg              nvarchar(15)
   declare @sStatus           nvarchar(4)
   

   declare @sCertnum          nvarchar(20)   --r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certification%TYPE
   declare @sCerttype         nvarchar(8)    --r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certificationtype%TYPE
    
   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_deleted cursor local for select OBJ_OBTYPE, OBJ_OBRTYPE, OBJ_CODE, OBJ_ACD, OBJ_ORG, OBJ_STATUS                                                                                                                           
                                       from deleted
         set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_deleted
               fetch next from c_deleted into @sObtype, @sObrtype, @sCode, @nAcd, @sOrg, @sStatus
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     --BEFORE EACH ROW portion
                            if exists ( select 1 FROM   r5translines
                                        WHERE  trl_object     = @sCode
                                        AND    trl_object_org = @sOrg )
                                begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_OBJ', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                                end

                     UPDATE   r5meters
                     SET      met_obtype  = NULL,
                           met_obrtype = NULL,
                           met_object  = NULL
                      WHERE  met_obtype     = @sObtype
                      AND    met_object     = @sCode
                      AND    met_object_org = @sOrg

                     if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_OBJ', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     UPDATE r5standworks
                      SET    stw_obtype  = NULL,
                           stw_obrtype = NULL,
                           stw_object  = NULL
                      WHERE  stw_obtype     = @sObtype
                      AND    stw_object     = @sCode
                      AND    stw_object_org = @sOrg

                     if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_OBJ', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     --AFTER EACH ROW portion
                     DELETE FROM r5accountdetail WHERE acd_code = @nAcd

                     set @sCheckresult = N'0'

                     DELETE FROM r5entityparts
                        WHERE  epa_rentity = N'OBJ'
                        AND    epa_code    = @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg

                     if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'POSDEL_OBJ', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     DELETE FROM r5permentities
                        WHERE  pre_rentity = N'OBJ'
                        AND    pre_type    = @sObtype
                        AND    pre_code    = @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg

                     if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'POSDEL_OBJ', N'TRIG', N'5', @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     set @sConcat = @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg
                     execute @nReturn = O7DEDOC1 N'OBJ', @sObrtype, @sConcat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'O7DEDOC1', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'OBJ', @sObtype, @sObrtype, @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           close c_deleted
                           deallocate c_deleted
                           execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     if @sObrtype = N'L'
                        begin
                           execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'LOC', N'*', N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_deleted
                                 deallocate c_deleted
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                              begin
                                 close c_deleted
                                 deallocate c_deleted
                                 execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end
                        end
                        
                        if @sObrtype = N'C'
                        begin
                           execute @nReturn = O7DEADD1 N'OBJ', N'*', @sCode, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                           if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                              begin
                                 close c_deleted
                                 deallocate c_deleted
                                 rollback transaction

create trigger PREDEL_ORG
on R5ORGANIZATION
instead of delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sCommon      	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer             

	declare @sMos     			nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select ORG_CODE, ORG_COMMON, ORG_SQLIDENTITY from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_deleted
			fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sCommon, @nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
                            SELECT @sMos = ett_mos FROM r5entitytables WHERE  ett_rentity = N'CLAS'
                            if @sMos = N'+'
                                delete r5classes 
                                 where cls_org = @sCode 
                                   and (cls_code = N'*' OR (cls_code = N'N' AND cls_rentity = N'PART'))

						    delete r5contactcenteroptions where cop_org = @sCode
						    
						    IF @sCommon = N'+' 
    							delete r5userorganization where uog_org = @sCode
						    ELSE	
							    delete r5userorganization 
                                 where uog_org = @sCode 
                                   and (uog_user = N'DATABRIDGEINTERNALUSER' OR uog_user = N'EAM-DOCUMOTOUSER')
								   
							delete r5organizationoptions where opa_org = @sCode
						end
					delete from R5ORGANIZATION where org_sqlidentity = @nSqlidentity
    
			        fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sCommon, @nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_deleted
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_PER
on R5PERSONNEL
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select PER_CODE, PER_ORG from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							-- BEFORE EACH ROW portion 
							execute @nReturn = O7UPCOM1 sCode, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7UPCOM1', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							-- AFTER EACH ROW portion 
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'PERS', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7UPCOM1', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sOrg
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

												   	@sSupplier_org,	@sAuth,	@dApprov,	@sDfltauth,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity,	@dLastsav
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--PREDEL
							if 	@sStatus <> N'U'
								begin
									IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' 
									FROM   r5picklists_archive
									WHERE  api_code = @sCode)
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_PIC', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--POSDEL 
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'PICK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							
							execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'PICK', @sStatus, N'-'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nErecord > 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									
									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end



									select @nCount = count(*) 
									from r5events
									WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent	
									
									if @nCount = 1 
									   SELECT @sEvtOrg = evt_org
									   FROM   r5events
									   WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent
									else
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sEvtOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYNUM @sCertnum OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYTYPE @sCerttype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

								
									execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sOrg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									INSERT INTO r5elecarchive (  ELA_CODE,  ELA_USER, ELA_DATE, ELA_SIGNTYPE, ELA_CERTIFYNUM, ELA_CERTIFYTYPE,
														  ELA_SCODE, ELA_ENTITY,ELA_ENTCODE,ELA_ENTORG,   ELA_STATUS, ELA_PARENT,
														  ELA_FLD1,  ELA_FLD2,   ELA_FLD3,   ELA_FLD4,
														  ELA_FLD5,  ELA_FLD6,   ELA_FLD7,   ELA_FLD8,
														  ELA_FLD9,  ELA_FLD10,  ELA_FLD11,  ELA_FLD12,
														  ELA_FLD13, ELA_FLD14,  ELA_FLD15,  ELA_FLD16,
														  ELA_FLD17, ELA_FLD18,  ELA_FLD19,  ELA_FLD20,
														  ELA_FLD21, ELA_FLD22,  ELA_FLD23,  ELA_FLD24,
														  ELA_FLD25, ELA_FLD26 )
									VALUES ( @sSeqno,	@sGetUser,	@dGtTime,	@sGetStype, @sCertnum, @sCerttype,
										  null,    N'PICK',          @sCode,       @sOrg,                 @sStatus,     null,
										  @sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@sObtype, @sObrtype,	@sObject,	
										  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dRequired, N'DD-MON-YYYY' ),
										  @sOrigin,	@sStore, @sTransaction,	
										  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dPrintdate, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS' ),
										  @sObject_org,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,    @sStatus,
										  @sRstatus,	@sDeladdress,	@sPerson,	@sSupplier,
										  @sSupplier_org,	@sAuth,	
										  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dApprov, N'DD-MON-YYYY' ),	@sDfltauth,	@nUpdatecount,
										  dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dLastsav, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'))

								end


							fetch next

create trigger PREDEL_POI
on R5POINTS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sObject      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sObrtype     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sObtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sPoint       	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sPointtype   	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sObject_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer  
	declare @nCount 	int 
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select
													   poi_object,
													   poi_obrtype,
													   poi_obtype,
													   poi_point,
													   poi_desc,
													   poi_pointtype,
													   poi_object_org,
													   poi_updatecount,
													   poi_sqlidentity
												from deleted

			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @nCount = 0
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sObject,
												 @sObrtype,
												 @sObtype,
												 @sPoint,
												 @sDesc,
												 @sPointtype,
												 @sObject_org,
												 @nUpdatecount,
												 @nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							SELECT @nCount = COUNT( * )
							FROM   r5aspectpoints a
							WHERE  a.apo_object     = @sObject
							AND    a.apo_object_org = @sObject_org
							AND    a.apo_obtype     = @sObtype
							AND    a.apo_point      = @sPoint
							AND    a.apo_pointtype  = @sPointtype

							if @nCount > 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_POI', N'TRIG', N'990', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_deleted into  @sObject,
															 @sObrtype,
															 @sObtype,
															 @sPoint,
															 @sDesc,
															 @sPointtype,
															 @sObject_org,
															 @nUpdatecount,
															 @nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_PRV
on R5PROPERTYVALUES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as


	declare @sListtype	nchar
	declare @sUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(100)
	declare @sRentity	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sProperty	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sValue		nvarchar(40)
	declare	@nValue		numeric(24,6)
	declare	@dValue		datetime
	declare @sPtype		nvarchar(4)		--r5properties.pro_type%TYPE
	declare	@sThe_value	nvarchar(40)		--r5propertyvalues.prv_value%TYPE
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAudit		nvarchar(1)		--r5entities.ent_caaudit%TYPE
	declare @sLtype		nchar
	declare @sCascade	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sCursor	nvarchar(256)
	declare @sCoalesced	nvarchar(255)
	declare @sConcat	nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sFormdat	nvarchar(200)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	PRV_CODE, PRV_RENTITY, PRV_CLASS, PRV_PROPERTY, 
														PRV_VALUE, PRV_NVALUE, PRV_DVALUE from deleted

			create table #tProperties_prv ( prop	nvarchar(24), 
										ltyp	nvarchar(4),
										ptype	nvarchar(4),
										value	nvarchar(40) )
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					set @sListtype = N'C'
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sRentity, @sClass, @sProperty, @sValue, @nValue, @dValue
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sCode is null
								begin
									if @sRentity = N'*'
										set @sListtype = N'P'
									else
										begin
											if @sClass = N'*'
												set @sListtype = N'E'
										end

									--o7prop.prv_to_delete functionality here
									set @sPtype = N'CHAR'
									if @nValue is not null
										begin
											set @sPtype = N'NUM'
											set @sThe_value = convert( nvarchar, @nValue )
										end
									else
										begin
											if @dValue is not null
												begin
													set @sPtype = N'DATE'
													set @sThe_value = convert( nvarchar, @dValue )
												end
											else
												set @sThe_value = @sValue
										end

									select	@nCount = count(*)
									  from	#tProperties_prv
									 where	prop	= @sProperty	AND
											ltyp	= @sListtype	AND
											value	= @sThe_value

									if @nCount = 0
										insert into #tProperties_prv values (@sProperty, @sListtype, @sPtype, @sThe_value)
								end
								
							if @dValue is not null
								begin
									select @sType = pro_type from r5properties where pro_code = @sProperty
									if @sType = N'DATE'
										set @sFormdat = isnull(dbo.o7dflt2(N'FORMDATE'), N'DD-MON-RRRR')
									else
										set @sFormdat = isnull(dbo.o7dflt2(N'FORMDATI'), N'DD-MON-RRRR HH24:MI:SS')
								end
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							select	@sAudit = coalesce( ent_caaudit, N'-' )
							  FROM  r5entities
							 WHERE  ent_rentity = @sRentity

							if @sAudit = N'+' and @sCode is not null
								begin
									set @sCoalesced = coalesce( @sValue, coalesce( cast(@nValue as nvarchar), dbo.f_date_to_char(@dValue, @sFormdat) ) )
									set @sConcat = @sRentity + N' ' + @sCode
									execute @nReturn = O7AUDIT 0, N'DELETE', N'R5PROPERTYVALUES', @sCoalesced, null, @sProperty, @sConcat, @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @sCode is null
								--o7prop.delete_lovdesc functionality here
								DELETE FROM R5PVDESCRIPTIONS
									WHERE PVD_PROPERTY = @sProperty
									AND   PVD_VALUE    = @sValue
							--Reset work order esignature information
							if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sCode and ets_updatecount <> -999
							end
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sRentity, @sClass, @sProperty, @sValue, @nValue, @dValue
						end
					close c_deleted

					--AFTER statement portion
					--o7prop.elements_in_use functionality here
					execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROP', N'DELETE_IS_CASCADING', @sCascade OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							deallocate c_deleted
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					if @sCascade = N'FALSE'
						begin
							declare c_properties cursor local for select prop, ltyp, ptype, value from #tProperties_prv
							open c_properties
							fetch next from c_properties into @sProperty, @sLtype, @sPtype, @sValue
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									if @sPtype = N'DATE'
										begin
											set @dValue = cast( @sValue as datetime )
											select	@nCount = count(*)
											  FROM	r5propertyvalues v,
													r5addproperties a
											 WHERE	a.apr_property  = @sProperty
											  AND   a.apr_property  = v.prv_property
											  AND   a.apr_rentity   = v.prv_rentity
											  AND   a.apr_class     = v.prv_class
											  AND   a.apr_class_org = v.prv_class_org
											  AND   a.apr_list      = @sLtype
											  AND   a.apr_listvalid = N'+'
											  AND   v.prv_dvalue    = @dValue
										end
									else
										begin
											if @sPtype = N'NUM'
												begin
													set @nValue = cast( @sValue as numeric(24,6) )
													select	@nCount = count(*)
													  FROM	r5propertyvalues v,
															r5addproperties a
													 WHERE	a.apr_property  = @sProperty
													  AND   a.apr_property  = v.prv_property
													  AND   a.apr_rentity   = v.prv_rentity
													  AND   a.apr_class     = v.prv_class
													  AND   a.apr_class_org = v.prv_class_org
													  AND   a.apr_list      = @sLtype
													  AND   a.apr_listvalid = N'+'
													  AND   v.prv_nvalue    = @nValue
												end
											else
												begin
													select	@nCount = count(*)
													  FROM	r5propertyvalues v,
															r5addproperties a
													 WHERE	a.apr_property  = @sProperty
													  AND   a.apr_property  = v.prv_property
													  AND   a.apr_rentity   = v.prv_rentity
													  AND   a.apr_class     = v.prv_class
													  AND   a.apr_class_org = v.prv_class_org
													  AND   a.apr_list      = @sLtype
													  AND   a.apr_listvalid = N'+'
													  AND   v.prv_value    = @sValue
												end
										end
									fetch next from c_properties into @sProperty, @sLtype, @sPtype, @sValue
								end
							close c_properties
							deallocate c_properties
						end
				end
			drop table #tProperties_prv
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_PSL
on R5PACKINGSLIP
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sDock        	nvarchar(30) 
	declare @nLine			numeric(8,0)
	declare @sOrder      	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrdline    	numeric(8,0)
	declare @sOrder_org  	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPart       	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPart_org   	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRecvqty    	numeric(24,6)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select PSL_DOCK, PSL_LINE, PSL_ORDER, PSL_ORDER_ORG, PSL_ORDLINE, PSL_PART, PSL_PART_ORG, PSL_RECVQTY from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sDock, @nLine, @sOrder, @sOrder_org, @sOrdline, @sPart, @sPart_org, @sRecvqty 
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF EXISTS (SELECT  '1' FROM r5dockreceipts WHERE dck_code = @sDock AND dck_rstatus NOT IN ( N'U', N'C' )) 
								begin
									IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5packingslip_archive WHERE APS_DOCK = @sDock and APS_LINE = @nLine) 
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_PSL', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end							
							UPDATE r5orderlines
							SET    orl_dckrecvqty = orl_dckrecvqty - @sRecvqty
							WHERE  orl_order      = @sOrder
							AND    orl_ordline    = @sOrdline
							AND    orl_order_org  = @sOrder_org
							AND    orl_part       = @sPart
							AND    orl_part_org   = @sPart_org
							AND EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM r5dockreceipts WHERE dck_code = @sDock AND dck_rstatus <> N'C')
							AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5packingslip_archive WHERE APS_DOCK = @sDock and APS_LINE = @nLine) 
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sDock, @nLine, @sOrder, @sOrder_org, @sOrdline, @sPart, @sPart_org, @sRecvqty 
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_QUL
on R5QUOTLINES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sQuotation		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSeqno			nvarchar(2)
	declare @sCompositecode	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQuline		numeric(8,0)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select QUL_QUOTATION, QUL_SEQNO, QUL_LINE from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @nQuline
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
							FROM   r5quotlines_archive
							WHERE  aql_quotation = @sQuotation
							AND    aql_seqno = @sSeqno)
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7EXISTQ N'QUOT', N'*', @sQuotation, N'STAT', @sSeqno, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit > 0 
										set @sX = null
									else
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_deleted
													deallocate c_deleted
													execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_QUL', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											else
												begin
													close c_deleted
													deallocate c_deleted
													execute O7RAE N'O7EXISTQ', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							set @sCompositecode = coalesce(@sQuotation,N'') + N'#' + coalesce(@sSeqno,N'') + N'#' +  coalesce(cast( @nQuline as nvarchar(8)),N'')
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'QUOL', @sX, N'*', @sCompositecode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							IF @sCheckresult <> '0' 
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							fetch next from c_deleted into @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @nQuline
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

	declare @nCount			int

	declare @sCerttype		nvarchar(8)		--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certificationtype%TYPE

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	QUO_CODE,	QUO_SEQNO,	QUO_DESC,	QUO_CLASS,	QUO_STATUS,

												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,	@dLastsav

									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									if	@nRetval = 0

												deallocate c_deleted

												return

							--POSDEL 
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'QUOT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'

									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'DEL', N'QUOT', @sStatus, N'-'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return

							if @nErecord > 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno1 OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT

											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction

										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction

									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg

create trigger PREDEL_RQL

as

	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sReq				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nRecvqty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRecvvalue			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReqline			numeric(8)
	declare @nAcd				bigint
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sComposite_code	nvarchar(80)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

			declare c_deleted cursor local for select RQL_REQ, RQL_RECVQTY, RQL_RECVVALUE, RQL_REQLINE, RQL_ACD from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sReq, @nRecvqty, @nRecvvalue, @nReqline, @nAcd
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--PREDEL_RQL portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
							FROM   r5requislines_archive
							WHERE  ari_req = @sReq)
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7CKRQL1 @sReq, @nRecvqty, @nRecvvalue, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'O7CKRQL1', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--POSDEL_RQL portion
							set @sX = null
							set @sComposite_code = @sReq + N'#' + cast(@nReqline as nvarchar(8))

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'REQL', @sX, N'*', @sComposite_code, null, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSDEL_RQL2 portion
							DELETE FROM r5accountdetail
							WHERE acd_code = @nAcd

							fetch next from c_deleted into @sReq, @nRecvqty, @nRecvvalue, @nReqline, @nAcd
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

	declare @nTime				numeric(7,2)

	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(2)

				begin

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
								
/*DB 48730 start*/

/*DB 48730 end*/

						end

				end

		end

	declare @sPerson			nvarchar(15)
	declare @dShiftStart       		datetime

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount				integer	
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select SHP_SHIFT,SHP_PERSON,SHP_START,SHP_END from deleted 
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sShift, @sPerson, @dShiftStart, @dShiftEnd
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
								
/*DB start*/

									select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSEP'
									if @nCount > 0
										select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSEP'
									else
										set @sFlag = N'N'

									if @sFlag = N'Y'
										begin

											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
											   XTS_TABLE,
											   XTS_KEYFLD1,
											   XTS_KEYFLD2,
											   XTS_KEYFLD3,
											   XTS_KEYFLDDATE1,
											   XTS_KEYFLDDATE2,
											   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
											  )
											VALUES(
											  N'SYNCSHIFTEMP',
											  N'R5SHFPERS',
											  @sShift,
											  @sPerson,
											  N'D',
											  @dShiftStart,
											  @dShiftEnd,
											  @sTempMsgid )
										end

/*DB end*/
								

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sShift,  @sPerson, @dShiftStart, @dShiftEnd

						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_STC
on R5STRUCTURES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sObjRstatus		nvarchar(4)	--r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(3)

	declare @sParent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sParent_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sParentrtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sParenttype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChild				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sChild_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sChildrtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRolldown			nvarchar(1)
	declare @chk			nvarchar(4)
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	STC_PARENT, STC_PARENT_ORG, STC_PARENTRTYPE,	STC_PARENTTYPE, 
														STC_CHILD,	STC_CHILD_ORG,	STC_CHILDRTYPE,		STC_ROLLDOWN
												from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sParent, @sParent_org, @sParentrtype, @sParenttype, @sChild, 
													@sChild_org, @sChildrtype, @sRolldown
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							if @sRolldown = N'+'
								begin
									select @sObjRstatus = obj_rstatus
									FROM   r5objects 
									WHERE  obj_code    = @sParent
									AND    obj_org     = @sParent_org
									AND    obj_obrtype = @sParentrtype
									AND    obj_obtype  = @sParenttype

									if @sObjRstatus in (N'B', N'C')
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_STC', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							if @sParentrtype = @sChildrtype
								UPDATE  r5objects
								SET     obj_parent     = NULL,
										obj_parent_org = NULL,
										obj_depend     = N'-'
								WHERE   obj_code     = @sChild
								AND     obj_org      = @sChild_org

							if @sParentrtype = N'P'
								UPDATE  r5objects
								SET     obj_position     = NULL,
										obj_position_org = NULL,
										obj_ptype        = NULL
								WHERE   obj_code     = @sChild
								AND     obj_org      = @sChild_org
								
							if @sParentrtype = N'S'
								UPDATE  r5objects
								SET     obj_primarysystem     = NULL,
										obj_primarysystem_org = NULL,
										obj_ptype        = NULL
								WHERE   obj_code     = @sChild
								AND     obj_org      = @sChild_org
								AND     obj_primarysystem = @sParent
								AND     obj_primarysystem_org = @sParent_org
								
							if @sParentrtype = N'L' or @sRolldown = N'+'
								UPDATE  r5objects
								SET     obj_location     = NULL,
										obj_location_org = NULL,
										obj_ltype        = NULL
								WHERE   obj_code     = @sChild
								AND     obj_org      = @sChild_org
								AND   ( obj_parent IS NULL OR
										obj_depend = N'-' )
							
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sParent, @sParent_org, @sParentrtype, @sParenttype, @sChild, 
															@sChild_org, @sChildrtype, @sRolldown
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
			execute O7UPOBJGIS @sChildrtype, @sChild, @sChild_org, @sParentrtype, @sParent, @sParent_org, @chk
		end

create trigger PREDEL_TOU
on R5TOOLUSAGE
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sMrc           	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTool          	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sEvent         	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct           	numeric(8,0)
	declare @dDatebooked    	datetime
	declare @dDateused      	datetime
	declare @nHours         	numeric(12,2)
	declare @nTariff        	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost          	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQty           	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sGltransferflag	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTranscode     	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nTransorgid    	integer
	declare @nTransgroup    	integer
	declare @nAcd           	bigint
	declare @dGltransfer    	datetime
	declare @nUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOrighours     	numeric(12,2)
	declare @sRouterec      	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nSqlidentity   	integer

	declare @sMrcTemp           	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sToolTemp          	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sEventTemp         	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nActTemp           	numeric(8,0)
	declare @dDateTemp				datetime

	declare @nCount					integer
	declare @nReturn				integer
	declare @sChk					nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSplitusage			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCt					integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	TOU_MRC,	TOU_TOOL,	TOU_EVENT,	TOU_ACT,	TOU_DATEBOOKED,
													  	TOU_DATEUSED,	TOU_HOURS,	TOU_TARIFF,	TOU_COST,	TOU_QTY,
													  	TOU_GLTRANSFERFLAG,	TOU_TRANSCODE,	TOU_TRANSORGID,	TOU_TRANSGROUP,	TOU_ACD,
													  	TOU_GLTRANSFER,	TOU_UPDATECOUNT,	TOU_ORIGHOURS,	TOU_ROUTEREC,	TOU_SPLITUSAGE, TOU_SQLIDENTITY

													from deleted

			create table #tProperties_tou_del ( event	nvarchar(30),
										act		numeric(8,0),
										mrc		nvarchar(15),
										tool	nvarchar(12),
										dateused datetime)


			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
												   	@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
												   	@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,
												   	@dGltransfer,	@nUpdatecount,	@nOrighours,	@sRouterec,	@sSplitusage, @nSqlidentity

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sSplitusage <> N'N'
								begin
									select @nCt = 1
										from   r5events
										where  evt_routeparent = @sEvent and
										( @sSplitusage = N'A' OR ( @sSplitusage = N'O' AND evt_rstatus <> N'C' ) ) and
											EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
												FROM   r5activities
												WHERE  act_event = evt_code
												AND    act_act   = @nAct ) 
												
									if @nCt = 1												
										insert into #tProperties_tou_del values (@sEvent, @nAct, @sMrc, @sTool, @dDateused)
								end

							DELETE FROM r5accountdetail WHERE acd_code = @nAcd
							If @@ERROR <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									drop table #tProperties_tou_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
														   	@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
														   	@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,
														   	@dGltransfer,	@nUpdatecount,	@nOrighours,	@sRouterec,	@sSplitusage, @nSqlidentity

						end
					close c_deleted

					--AFTER statement portion
					declare c_properties cursor local for select event, act, mrc, tool, dateused from #tProperties_tou_del
					open c_properties
					fetch next from c_properties into @sEventTemp, @nActTemp, @sMrcTemp, @sToolTemp, @dDateTemp
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = o7crtou1 @sEventTemp, @nActTemp, null, @dDateTemp, @sMrcTemp, @sToolTemp, null, null, null, null, N'DEL', null,null,null, N'O'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_properties
									deallocate c_properties
									deallocate c_deleted
									drop table #tProperties_tou_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_properties into @sEventTemp, @nActTemp, @sMrcTemp, @sToolTemp, @dDateTemp
						end
					close c_properties
					deallocate c_properties
				end
			drop table #tProperties_tou_del
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_TRL
on R5TRANSLINES
for delete
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sTrans              	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sEvent              	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAcd                	bigint             
  
    declare @sCrstatus              nvarchar(4)  
    declare @nError                 numeric(38,0)
    declare @nCount                 numeric(38,0)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	TRL_TRANS,	TRL_ACD, TRL_EVENT
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted
					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sTrans,	@nAcd, @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
                            set @nError = 0 

                            SELECT @sCrstatus = tra_rstatus
                            FROM r5transactions
                            WHERE tra_code = @sTrans
                            Select @nCount = @@ROWCOUNT , @nError = @@ERROR
                            IF @nCount = 0 
					            begin
						            EXECUTE O7RAE N'PREDEL_TRL', N'TRIG', '1', @nError
						            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
						            return
					            end


                            /* S2441 - Deletion of Line is not allowed if Rstatus <> 'U'  */
                            IF @sCrstatus <> N'U' 
                                begin
                                    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1'
                                    FROM   r5translines_archive
                                    WHERE  atl_trans = @sTrans)
                                        begin
						                    EXECUTE O7RAE N'PREDEL_TRL', N'TRIG', '2', @nError
						                    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
						                    return
					                    end
                                end
                                    
                            DELETE FROM r5accountdetail WHERE acd_code = @nAcd

							IF @sEvent IS NOT NULL
								/* Flag WO as to recalculate costs. */
								UPDATE r5eventcost
								SET    evo_recalccost = N'+', evo_costcalculated = N'-'
								WHERE  evo_event = @sEvent
								AND    ISNULL( evo_recalccost, N'-' ) <> N'+'

							fetch next from c_deleted into 		@sTrans,	@nAcd, @sEvent
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_UCO
on R5UCODES
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sEntity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTextcode		nvarchar(12)	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select UCO_RENTITY, UCO_ENTITY, UCO_CODE, UCO_DESC, UCO_TEXTCODE from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sRentity, @sEntity, @sCode, @sDesc, @sTextcode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
							if @sRentity not in ( N'JBTP', N'OBTP', N'JBPR', N'EXTP', N'INTP', N'ESTP', N'OBCR', N'PRCA', N'PRCC', N'PCOA', N'UBRC', 
												N'OBRG', N'OBPU',N'CPPR', N'FLTP', N'CGTP', N'OBRI', N'ROOM', N'UNIT', N'KNTE', N'LIVN', N'VIPS', 
												N'SLTN', N'MGCT', N'DSCR', N'CVTP', N'OSTP', N'IBTP', N'UMDN', N'DLTP', N'RETP', N'OFTP', N'FLOW',
												N'CPDW', N'JPTP', N'TSTP', N'VHTP', N'KYTP', N'KYAL', N'SRPR', N'SEVE', N'INTN', N'IMPT', N'MATP',
												N'LDIR', N'LETP', N'NAOP', N'CFOP', N'GRPL', N'CNOT', N'ECFC', N'RESP', N'CORE', N'RCTP', N'OMOD',
												N'CNTR', N'FMTP', N'CACO', N'TACA', N'HUFA', N'WOMS', N'HUOV', N'MOFD', N'ATTP')
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_UCO', N'TRIG', N'990', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							---AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'UCOD', @sEntity, @sX, @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sTextcode > 1000000
								DELETE r5alltexts
								WHERE atx_code = @sTextcode

							IF @sRentity = N'JBTP' 
								/* Delete from the budget items table. */
								DELETE FROM r5budgetitems
								WHERE  bit_code = @sCode
								AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
											FROM   r5budgetgroups
											WHERE  bgr_code = bit_group
											AND    bgr_rentity = N'JBTP' )


							fetch next from c_deleted into @sRentity, @sEntity, @sCode, @sDesc, @sTextcode
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger PREDEL_UGR
on R5GROUPS
instead of delete
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode          	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sDesc          	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass         	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sMrc           	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sPrinter       	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sCorrbook      	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sClass_org     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sLogin         	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sRequestor     	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dCreated       	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated       	datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity   	integer             
	declare @nSessiontimeout	numeric(3,0) 
	declare @sJobType		     	nvarchar(8)         

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	UGR_CODE,	UGR_DESC,	UGR_CLASS,	UGR_MRC,	UGR_PRINTER,
													  	UGR_CORRBOOK,	UGR_CLASS_ORG,	UGR_LOGIN,	UGR_REQUESTOR,	UGR_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	UGR_CREATED,	UGR_UPDATED,	UGR_SQLIDENTITY,	UGR_SESSIONTIMEOUT,
														UGR_JOBTYPE
													from deleted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_deleted
			fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sMrc,	@sPrinter,
												@sCorrbook,	@sClass_org,	@sLogin,	@sRequestor,	@nUpdatecount,
												@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,	@nSessiontimeout,
												@sJobType
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @sCode = N'*'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'PREDEL_UGR', N'TRIG', N'990', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
													
							DELETE FROM R5PULLDOWNMENU
							WHERE  PDM_GROUP = @sCode

							DELETE FROM R5IPGROUPPERMISSIONS
							WHERE  IPG_GROUP = @sCode

							DELETE FROM R5PDMLANG
							WHERE  PDL_GROUP = @sCode

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'GROU', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							DELETE FROM r5pagelayout where plo_usergroup =  @sCode

							DELETE FROM R5PAGECACHE WHERE PGC_USERGROUP = @sCode
							
							DELETE FROM r5unavailablegridfields WHERE ugf_usergroup=@sCode

						end
						DELETE FROM R5GROUPS  WHERE  UGR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_deleted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sMrc,	@sPrinter,
														@sCorrbook,	@sClass_org,	@sLogin,	@sRequestor,	@nUpdatecount,
														@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,	@nSessiontimeout,
														@sJobType
				end
			close c_deleted
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREDEL_WLS
ON r5wolaborschedparams
FOR DELETE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
    DECLARE @sUser                NVARCHAR(38)
    DECLARE @swlscode             NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @nwlssessionid        NUMERIC(18)
    DECLARE @sEvent               NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @sActEvent            NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @nActWlssessionid     NUMERIC(18)
    DECLARE @nActExists           NUMERIC(1)

    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON
          DECLARE c_deleted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT wls_code, wls_sessionid  FROM deleted
          SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
          IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
              BEGIN
                OPEN c_deleted FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @swlscode, @nwlssessionid
                    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE r5activities SET act_schedulingsessionid = null, act_schedulingsessiontype = null WHERE
                        act_schedulingsessionid = @nwlssessionid AND act_schedulingsessiontype = 'WOLS'

                        UPDATE r5personnel SET per_schedulingsessionid = null, per_schedulingtype = null WHERE per_schedulingsessionid = CAST( @nwlssessionid AS NVARCHAR ) AND per_schedulingtype = 'WOLS'

                        DECLARE c_event_codes CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT evt_code FROM r5events WHERE evt_mpproj = CAST( @nwlssessionid AS NVARCHAR ) AND evt_mpprojtype = 'WOLS'
    
                        OPEN c_event_codes FETCH NEXT FROM c_event_codes INTO @sEvent
                            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                            BEGIN
                                SET @nActExists = 0
                                DECLARE c_actevent_session_codes CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT act_schedulingsessionid, act_event FROM r5activities WHERE act_event = @sEvent AND act_schedulingsessiontype = 'WOLS' AND
                                act_schedulingsessionid IS NOT NULL AND act_schedulingsessionid <> @nwlssessionid ORDER BY act_event, act_act ASC
                                
                                OPEN c_actevent_session_codes 
                                FETCH NEXT FROM c_actevent_session_codes INTO @nActWlssessionid, @sActEvent
                                    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                                    BEGIN
                                        SET @nActExists = 1
                                        UPDATE r5events SET evt_mpproj = @nActWlssessionid WHERE evt_code = @sActEvent
                                        FETCH NEXT FROM c_actevent_session_codes INTO @nActWlssessionid, @sActEvent
                                    END
                                CLOSE c_actevent_session_codes
                                DEALLOCATE c_actevent_session_codes
                                IF @nActExists = 0
                                BEGIN
                                    UPDATE r5events SET evt_mpproj = '-', evt_mpprojtype = null WHERE evt_code = @sEvent
                                END
                                FETCH NEXT FROM c_event_codes INTO @sEvent
                            END
                        CLOSE c_event_codes
                        DEALLOCATE c_event_codes
                        FETCH NEXT FROM c_deleted INTO @swlscode, @nwlssessionid
                    END
                    CLOSE c_deleted
                    DEALLOCATE c_deleted
              END  
        END

create trigger PREINSUPD_ACD
on R5ACCOUNTDETAIL
for insert,update  NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sAccounted  	nvarchar(2)  
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)       
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	bigint
	declare @sErrortext		nvarchar(255)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE;	         

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	ACD_ACCOUNTED,	ACD_UPDATECOUNT,	ACD_SQLIDENTITY from inserted
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sAccounted, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
											
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					SELECT @sDesc = ins_desc
					FROM r5install
					WHERE ins_code = N'ACCOUNT'
					if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
						set @sDesc = N'NO'

					IF @sAccounted IS NULL 
						set @sAccounted = N'*'

					IF (@sDesc = N'NO' AND @sAccounted IN ( N'DR', N'CR')) 
						begin
							set @sErrortext = SUBSTRING( N'Install parameter is NO for ACCOUNT and acd_accounted cannot be DR or CR',1,255)
							RAISERROR(@sErrortext, 16, 1 )
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					IF (@sDesc = 'YES' AND @sAccounted NOT IN (N'DR',N'CR', N'TP'))
						begin
							set @sErrortext = SUBSTRING( N'Install parameter is YES for ACCOUNT and acd_accounted should be either DR or CR',1,255)
							RAISERROR(@sErrortext, 16, 1 )
							rollback transaction
							return
						end


					IF (@sDesc IS NULL OR @sAccounted NOT IN (N'*',N'DR',N'CR', N'TP')) 
						begin
							set @sErrortext = SUBSTRING( N'Either there is no value for ACCOUNT in install parameter or there is no value for acd_accounted',1,255)
							RAISERROR(@sErrortext, 16, 1 )
							rollback transaction
							return
						end

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sAccounted, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
													
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINSUPD_BIS
on R5BINSTOCK
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nQuantity			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRepairQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sStore				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStoreOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPart				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCreatedBy			nvarchar(255)
	declare @dCreated			datetime
	declare @sBin				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sLot				nvarchar(12)
	declare @nOldQuantity		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOldRepairQty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldPartOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCreatedBy		nvarchar(255)
	declare @dOldCreated		datetime
	declare @sOldBin			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldLot			nvarchar(12)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nNewUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer
	declare @sFlag				NVARCHAR(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid			NVARCHAR(256)             

	declare @nTempQuantity		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTempRepairQty		numeric(24,6)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin

					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	BIS_STORE, BIS_PART, BIS_PART_ORG, BIS_QTY, BIS_REPAIRQTY, BIS_CREATEDBY, BIS_CREATED, BIS_BIN, BIS_LOT,	BIS_SQLIDENTITY
															from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sStore, @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nQuantity, @nRepairQty, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @sBin, @sLot, @nSqlidentity
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'

									set @dCreated = GetDate()
									execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCreatedBy OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
									end									
									set @sCreatedBy = Coalesce( @sCreatedBy,N'R5' )

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									-- Mod - 3/07/2003 - C. Reagan - Original change the values of @nQuantity which did not happen in Oracle.
									set @nTempQuantity = -1 * @nQuantity
									set @nTempRepairQty = -1 * @nRepairQty
									execute O7UPBIS1 @sStore, @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nTempQuantity, @nTempRepairQty, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7UPBIS1', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
										end

									update r5binstock set BIS_QTY		= @nQuantity, 
															BIS_REPAIRQTY	= @nRepairQty,
															BIS_CREATEDBY = @sCreatedBy,
															BIS_CREATED =  @dCreated
											where	BIS_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlidentity

									-- 49787 - D. Jones - Adding INSERT R5XMLTRANSTATUS code
									SELECT @sFlag = ISNULL(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@INVYCNT'
									IF UPPER(@sFlag) = N'Y'
									BEGIN
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										BEGIN
											CLOSE c_inserted
											DEALLOCATE c_inserted
											ROLLBACK TRAN
											RETURN
										END

										select @sStoreOrg = STR_ORG from R5STORES where STR_CODE = @sStore

										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											(XTS_TRANTYPE
											,XTS_TABLE
											,XTS_KEYFLD1
											,XTS_KEYFLD2
											,XTS_KEYFLD3
											,XTS_KEYFLD4
											,XTS_ORG
											,XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)	
										SELECT 
											 N'INVYCOUNT' -- Event Name
										    ,N'R5BINSTOCK' -- Table Name
										    ,@sPart+'#'+@sPartOrg
											,@sStore
											,@sBin
											,@sLot
											,@sStoreOrg
										    ,@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from R5XMLTRANSTATUS where XTS_TRANTYPE=N'INVYCOUNT' and 
										xts_keyfld1 = @sPart+'#'+@sPartOrg and XTS_KEYFLD3 = @sBin and XTS_KEYFLD4 = @sLot)
									END

									fetch next from c_inserted into @sStore, @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nQuantity, @nRepairQty, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @sBin, @sLot, @nSqlidentity
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.BIS_STORE, i.BIS_PART, i.BIS_PART_ORG, i.BIS_QTY, i.BIS_REPAIRQTY, i.BIS_CREATEDBY, i.BIS_CREATED, i.BIS_BIN, i.BIS_LOT, i.BIS_UPDATECOUNT,i.BIS_SQLIDENTITY, 
																d.BIS_STORE, d.BIS_PART, d.BIS_PART_ORG, d.BIS_QTY, d.BIS_REPAIRQTY, d.BIS_CREATEDBY, d.BIS_CREATED, d.BIS_BIN, d.BIS_LOT, d.BIS_UPDATECOUNT
														from inserted i, deleted d
											where	i.BIS_SQLIDENTITY		= d.BIS_SQLIDENTITY

					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_ins_del 
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStore, @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nQuantity, @nRepairQty, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @sBin, @sLot, @nUpdatecount,@nSqlidentity,
														   @sOldStore, @sOldPart, @sOldPartOrg, @nOldQuantity, @nOldRepairQty, @sOldCreatedBy, @dOldCreated, @sOldBin, @sOldLot, @nOldUpdatecount

							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									if @sStore      <> @sOldStore
									 or @sPart  <> @sOldPart
									 or @sPartOrg <> @sOldPartOrg
									 or @sBin  <> @sOldBin
									 or @sLot       <> @sOldLot
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									set @sCheckresult = N'0'

									set @dCreated = GetDate()
									execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCreatedBy OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
									end									
									set @sCreatedBy = Coalesce( @sCreatedBy,N'R5' )

									if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
										set @nNewUpdateCount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
									else
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									-- Mod - 3/07/2003 - C. Reagan - Original change the values of @nQuantity which did not happen in Oracle.
									set @nTempQuantity = coalesce(@nOldQuantity,0) - coalesce(@nQuantity,0)
									set @nTempRepairQty = coalesce(@nOldRepairQty,0) - coalesce(@nRepairQty,0)
									execute O7UPBIS1 @sStore, @sPart, @sPartOrg, @nTempQuantity, @nTempRepairQty, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0
