											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'O7UPBIS1', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR

															BIS_REPAIRQTY	= @nRepairQty,

	declare @sNewUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sNotused			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)

	--The Following Trigger Combines the following 5 triggers into 1:
	-- PREINSUPD_CST
	-- PREINS_CST
	-- PREUPD_CST
	-- POSINS_CST
	-- POSUPD_CST

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin
					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	CST_CODE, CST_ORG, CST_CLASS, CST_CLASS_ORG, CST_CREATEDBY, CST_CREATED, CST_SQLIDENTITY, CST_DESC, CST_NOTUSED
															from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @nSQLIdentityID, @sDesc, @sNotused
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									set @nCountit = 0
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @sX = NULL

									if @sClass is not null
									begin

										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CSTC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit <= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CST', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
												if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
													begin
														close c_inserted

											end
									end

									execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sNewUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									set @sCreatedBy = Coalesce( @sNewUser,N'R5' )
									set @dCreated = GetDate()


									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CSTC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted

										(XTS_TRANTYPE,XTS_TABLE,XTS_KEYFLD1,XTS_KEYFLD2,XTS_KEYFLD3,XTS_ORG,XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
										VALUES
										(N'CODEDEF',N'COSTCENTER',@sCode,@sDesc,@sNotused,@sOrg,@sTempMsgid)
									end

									update r5costcodes set 	CST_CREATEDBY = @sCreatedBy,
															CST_CREATED =  @dCreated
											where	CST_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSQLIdentityID
																		
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @nSQLIdentityID, @sDesc, @sNotused
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CST_CODE, i.CST_ORG, i.CST_CLASS, i.CST_CLASS_ORG, i.CST_CREATEDBY, i.CST_CREATED, i.CST_UPDATECOUNT, i.CST_DESC, i.CST_NOTUSED,
																d.CST_CODE, d.CST_ORG, d.CST_CLASS, d.CST_CLASS_ORG, d.CST_CREATEDBY, d.CST_CREATED, d.CST_UPDATECOUNT, i.CST_SQLIDENTITY
														from inserted i, deleted d
														where	i.CST_SQLIDENTITY		= d.CST_SQLIDENTITY

					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_ins_del 
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @nUpdateCount, @sDesc, @sNotused,
														   @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldCreatedBy, @dOldCreated, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSQLIdentityID

							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion

									execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @nCountit = 0
									set @sX = NULL

									if @sCode <> @sOldCode
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									if @sClass is not null and 
									 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR 
									   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) ) 
										begin
											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CSTC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

												end

											if @nCountit = 0

													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CST', N'TRIG', 1

										end

									if isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )

									else

											rollback transaction

as

		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

				--INSERTING
				begin

					declare c_inserted cursor local for 
						select DMS_TABLE, DMS_FIELD, DMS_STATUSENTITY, DMS_ENTITY, DMS_STATUSENTITYBOT, DMS_ENTITYBOT, DMS_UPDATED from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

						begin

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sTable, @sField, @sStatusEntity, @sEntity, @nStatusEntityBot, @nEntityBot, @dUpdated
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion

									set @dUpdated = GetDate()

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
						
									update R5DWMETASTATUSES set DMS_UPDATED = @dUpdated	where	DMS_TABLE = @sTable and DMS_FIELD = @sField
																		
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sTable, @sField, @sStatusEntity, @sEntity, @nStatusEntityBot, @nEntityBot, @dUpdated
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for 
						select	i.DMS_TABLE, i.DMS_FIELD, i.DMS_STATUSENTITY, i.DMS_ENTITY, i.DMS_STATUSENTITYBOT, i.DMS_ENTITYBOT, i.DMS_UPDATED, i.DMS_SQLIDENTITY,

						from		inserted i, deleted d

					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin

							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion

									set @dUpdated = GetDate()

									update r5dwmetastatuses set DMS_UPDATED = @dUpdated where DMS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSQLIdentity

									fetch next from c_ins_del into 
										@sTable, @sField, @sStatusEntity, @sEntity, @nStatusEntityBot, @nEntityBot, @dUpdated, @nSQLIdentity,
										@sOldTable, @sOldField, @sOldStatusEntity, @sOldEntity, @nOldStatusEntityBot, @nOldEntityBot, @dOldUpdated

						end
					deallocate c_ins_del
				end
		end

create trigger PREINSUPD_RGN
on R5REGIONS
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)	
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg			nvarchar(15)		
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE	
	declare @nSQLIdentityID			int

	--The Following Trigger Combines the following 4 triggers into 1:	
	-- PREINS_RGN
	-- PREUPD_RGN
	-- POSINS_RGN
	-- POSUPD_RGN

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin
					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	RGN_CODE, RGN_ORG, RGN_CLASS, RGN_CLASS_ORG, RGN_SQLIDENTITY, RGN_DESC	from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @nSQLIdentityID, @sDesc
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									set @nCountit = 0
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @sX = NULL

									if @sClass is not null
									begin

										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'REGN', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit <= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_RGN', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
												if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
									end							

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'REGN', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
																											
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @nSQLIdentityID, @sDesc
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.RGN_CODE, i.RGN_ORG, i.RGN_CLASS, i.RGN_CLASS_ORG, i.RGN_DESC, d.RGN_CODE, d.RGN_ORG, d.RGN_CLASS, d.RGN_CLASS_ORG, i.RGN_SQLIDENTITY		from inserted i, deleted d	where	i.RGN_SQLIDENTITY = d.RGN_SQLIDENTITY
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							open c_ins_del 
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nSQLIdentityID

							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion

									execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @nCountit = 0
									set @sX = NULL

									if @sCode <> @sOldCode
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									if @sClass is not null and 
									 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR 
									   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) ) 
										begin
											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'REGN', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_RGN', N'TRIG', 1
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									
									--AFTER EACH ROW portion

									if @sUser <> N'SYS'
										begin
											set @sCheckresult = N'0'
											set @sX = null
											execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'REGN', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											if coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND
											  ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg))
												delete from R5PROPERTYVALUES
												 WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CTC'
												 AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
												 AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
												 AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
										end 
																							
									fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nSQLIdentityID
								end
							close c_ins_del
						end
					deallocate c_ins_del
				end
		end

	declare @sCode				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)

	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJobType			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sObjClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sObjClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObjType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCreatedBy			nvarchar(255)
	declare @dCreated			datetime
	declare @nUpdateCount		int
	declare @sWoClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sWoClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldPriority		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldJobType		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldObjClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldObjClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldObjType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldObject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCreatedBy		nvarchar(255)
	declare @dOldCreated		datetime
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @sOldWoClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldWoClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sType				nvarchar(4)
	declare	@nReturn			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nNewUpdateCount	int
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nSQLIdentity		int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin


					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	STW_CODE, STW_DESC, STW_PRIORITY, STW_CLASS, STW_CLASS_ORG, STW_JOBTYPE,STW_OBCLASS, STW_OBJECT, STW_OBTYPE, STW_OBJECT_ORG, STW_CLASS_ORG, STW_CREATEDBY, STW_CREATED, STW_ORG, STW_OBCLASS_ORG, STW_SQLIDENTITY, STW_TYPE
															from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sPriority, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sJobType, @sObjClass, @sObject,@sObjType,@sObjectOrg, @sClassOrg, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @sOrg, @sObjClassOrg, @nSQLIdentity, @sType
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									/* Default type to 'SWO' */
									set @sType = coalesce (@sType, N'SWO')
									set @sChk = N'0'
									set @nCountit = 0
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @sX = NULL
									/* W30221 - class must exist ( r5classes, rEntity = 'STWO' ) */
									if @sClass is not null
										begin

											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'STWO', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									begin
										if @sObject is not null
											/* W30225 - Object, Obj. Type, Class of object must exist ( r5objects ) */
											begin
												execute @nReturn = O7EXISTO N'STWO', N'*', N'*', @sObjType, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sObjClass, @sObjClassOrg, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
												if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														rollback transaction
														return
													end

												if @nCountit = 0
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_STW', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
										else
											/* W30226 - class of object must exist ( r5classes, rEntity = 'OBJ' ) */

											begin
												execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sObjClass, @sObjClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
												if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
												if @nCountit = 0
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_STW', N'TRIG', N'5', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end

											end
									end

									set @sCreatedBy = Coalesce( @sUser,N'R5' )
									set @dCreated = GetDate()

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'STWO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									update R5STANDWORKS set STW_CREATEDBY = @sCreatedBy,
															STW_CREATED =  @dCreated,
															STW_TYPE = @sType
														where	STW_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSQLIdentity
																		
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sPriority, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sJobType, @sObjClass, @sObject,@sObjType,@sObjectOrg, @sClassOrg, @sCreatedBy, @dCreated, @sOrg, @sObjClassOrg, @nSQLIdentity, @sType
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
				end
			else

				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.STW_CODE, i.STW_DESC, i.STW_PRIORITY, i.STW_CLASS, i.STW_CLASS_ORG, i.STW_JOBTYPE, i.STW_OBCLASS, i.STW_OBJECT,

create trigger PREINS_ACL
on R5ACTCLASSES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sGen			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sAction		nvarchar(8)  -- r5actioncodes.acc_gen%TYPE;
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select ACL_CLASS, ACL_CLASS_ORG, ACL_ACTION from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sAction
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* A07121 : Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'OBJ' ) */
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit >= 0
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ACL', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							SELECT @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5actioncodes 
							WHERE  acc_code = @sAction

							/* A07123 : Action Code can't be general (r5actioncodes) */
							if @nCount <= 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ACL', N'TRIG', N'999', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							else
								begin
									SELECT @sGen = acc_gen
									FROM   r5actioncodes 
									WHERE  acc_code = @sAction
									
									if @sGen = N'+'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ACL', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sAction
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

	declare @sSTARTTIME    numeric(24,6) 
	declare @sENDTIME      numeric(24,6) 
	declare @sHOURS        numeric(24,6) 
	declare @sRESPONSIBLE  nvarchar (15) 
	declare @sSHIFT        nvarchar (4) 
	declare @sSCHEDULER    nvarchar (255) 
	declare @sFROZEN       nvarchar (1) 
	declare @sOBJECT_ORG   nvarchar (15) 
	declare @sMPPROJ       nvarchar (20) 
	declare @sUPDATECOUNT  numeric (38) 
	declare @sCODE         nvarchar (30)
    declare @dUpdated       datetime
	declare @nShiftScheduleSession  numeric (18) 

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			declare c_inserted cursor local for select ACS_EVENT, ACS_ACTIVITY, ACS_COMMENT, ACS_MRC, ACS_TRADE, ACS_OBJECT, ACS_SCHED, ACS_STARTTIME, ACS_ENDTIME, ACS_HOURS,
														ACS_RESPONSIBLE, ACS_SHIFT, ACS_SCHEDULER, ACS_FROZEN, ACS_OBJECT_ORG, ACS_MPPROJ, ACS_UPDATECOUNT,ACS_CODE,
                                                        ACS_UPDATED, ACS_SHIFTSCHEDULESESSION from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = null

			fetch next from c_inserted into @sEVENT, @sACTIVITY, @sCOMMENT, @sMRC, @sTRADE, @sOBJECT, @sSCHED, @sSTARTTIME, @sENDTIME, @sHOURS, @sRESPONSIBLE, @sSHIFT, @sSCHEDULER,
											@sFROZEN, @sOBJECT_ORG, @sMPPROJ, @sUPDATECOUNT, @sCODE, @dUpdated, @nShiftScheduleSession

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @sCODE is NULL
								execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCODE OUTPUT, N'ACS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if @sFROZEN is NULL
								set @sFROZEN = N'-'
							
							if @sMRC = ''
								set @sMRC = NULL

							IF @sRESPONSIBLE IS NOT NULL 
								UPDATE r5activities
								SET    act_perresp = @sRESPONSIBLE
								WHERE  act_event   = @sEVENT
								AND    act_act     = @sACTIVITY
								AND    act_perresp IS NULL

						end

					insert into R5ACTSCHEDULES	(	ACS_EVENT, ACS_ACTIVITY, ACS_COMMENT, ACS_MRC, ACS_TRADE, ACS_OBJECT, ACS_SCHED, ACS_STARTTIME, ACS_ENDTIME, ACS_HOURS,
													ACS_RESPONSIBLE, ACS_SHIFT, ACS_SCHEDULER, ACS_FROZEN, ACS_OBJECT_ORG, ACS_MPPROJ, ACS_UPDATECOUNT,ACS_CODE,
                                                    ACS_UPDATED, ACS_SHIFTSCHEDULESESSION )
					values ( @sEVENT, @sACTIVITY, @sCOMMENT, @sMRC, @sTRADE, @sOBJECT, @sSCHED, @sSTARTTIME, @sENDTIME, @sHOURS, @sRESPONSIBLE, @sSHIFT, @sSCHEDULER,
								@sFROZEN, @sOBJECT_ORG, @sMPPROJ, @sUPDATECOUNT, @sCODE, @dUpdated,@nShiftScheduleSession)


					fetch next from c_inserted into @sEVENT, @sACTIVITY, @sCOMMENT, @sMRC, @sTRADE, @sOBJECT, @sSCHED, @sSTARTTIME, @sENDTIME, @sHOURS, @sRESPONSIBLE, @sSHIFT, @sSCHEDULER,
													@sFROZEN, @sOBJECT_ORG, @sMPPROJ, @sUPDATECOUNT, @sCODE, @dUpdated,@nShiftScheduleSession
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ADD
on R5ADDETAILS
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEntity     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRentity    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sType       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(100)       
	declare @sLang       	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @nLine       	numeric(12,0)        
	declare @sPrint      	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @nCount				int
	declare	@sFlag				nvarchar(2)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @dGetdate			datetime
	declare @sSQL				nvarchar(500)
	declare @sPevEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSessuser			nvarchar(255)
	declare @sRtype_copy      	        nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	ADD_ENTITY,	ADD_RENTITY,	ADD_TYPE,	ADD_RTYPE,	ADD_CODE,
													  	ADD_LANG,	ADD_LINE,	ADD_PRINT,	ADD_CREATED,
													  	ADD_USER,	ADD_UPDATED,	ADD_UPDUSER,	ADD_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@sCode,
												@sLang,	@nLine,	@sPrint,	@dCreated,
												@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount
											
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					set @sRtype_copy = @sRtype
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @sRtype is null
                                begin
                                    set @sRtype = N'*'
                                    set @sType = N'*'
                                end
                            execute @nReturn = o7sess_cur_user @sSessuser OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	                            begin
		                            close c_inserted
		                            deallocate c_inserted
		                            rollback transaction
		                            return
	                            end

                                set	@sUser = isnull( @sUser, isnull( @sSessuser, N'R5')) 
                                set @dCreated = isnull( @dCreated, GetDate() )

						end

                    --NOTE: SQLIdentity column value has not been set yet and is zero.  If more than one row 
                    --      is in the INSERTED table then you will be inserting multiple rows with the same
                    --      PK if you use the SQLIdentity column in the where clause.  Since this is an insert, 
                    --      using the PK columns in the where clause is OK.
					IF @sRtype_copy is not null 
						insert into R5ADDETAILS(	ADD_ENTITY,	ADD_RENTITY,	ADD_TYPE,	ADD_RTYPE,	ADD_CODE,
								            		ADD_LANG,	ADD_LINE,	ADD_PRINT,	ADD_TEXT,	ADD_CREATED,
								            		ADD_USER,	ADD_UPDATED,	ADD_UPDUSER,	ADD_UPDATECOUNT)
									select	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@sCode,
												@sLang,	@nLine,	@sPrint,	ADD_TEXT,	@dCreated,
									    		@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount
									from inserted where ADD_CODE    = @sCode
												   and  ADD_RENTITY = @sRentity 
												   and  ADD_TYPE    = @sType 
												   and  ADD_LANG    = @sLang 
												   and  ADD_LINE    = @nLine
					else
						insert into R5ADDETAILS(	ADD_ENTITY,	ADD_RENTITY,	ADD_TYPE,	ADD_RTYPE,	ADD_CODE,
								            		ADD_LANG,	ADD_LINE,	ADD_PRINT,	ADD_TEXT,	ADD_CREATED,
								            		ADD_USER,	ADD_UPDATED,	ADD_UPDUSER,	ADD_UPDATECOUNT)
									select	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@sCode,
												@sLang,	@nLine,	@sPrint,	ADD_TEXT,	@dCreated,
									    		@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount
									from inserted where ADD_CODE    = @sCode
												   and  ADD_RENTITY = @sRentity 
												   and  ADD_LANG    = @sLang 
												   and  ADD_LINE    = @nLine

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@sCode,
														@sLang,	@nLine,	@sPrint,	@dCreated,
														@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount
													
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ADI
on R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sSysUser       nvarchar(38)

   declare @nSessionid     integer
   declare @sUser          nvarchar(255)        
   declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)        
   declare @sCode          nvarchar(100)       
   declare @sRentity       nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sEntity        nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sType          nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sLang          nvarchar(2)         
   declare @nLine          numeric(8,0)        
   declare @sPrint         nvarchar(1)         
   declare @sCode1         nvarchar(40)        
   declare @sOrg1          nvarchar(15)        
   declare @dCreated       datetime            
   declare @sEvtalias      nvarchar(45)        
   declare @nSqlidentity   integer   
   
   declare @nReturn        integer          
   declare @sChk           nvarchar(3)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_inserted cursor local for select   ADI_TRANSID,   ADI_SOURCESYSTEM, ADI_SOURCECODE,   ADI_TRANSORGID,   ADI_TRANSGROUP,
                                          ADI_TRANS,  ADI_TRANSTYPE, ADI_SESSIONID, ADI_USER,   ADI_ORG,
                                          ADI_CODE,   ADI_RENTITY,   ADI_ENTITY, ADI_TYPE,   ADI_LANG,
                                          ADI_LINE,   ADI_PRINT,  ADI_CODE1,  ADI_ORG1,
                                          ADI_CREATED,   ADI_EVTALIAS,  ADI_SQLIDENTITY
                                       from inserted
         set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         open c_inserted
         fetch next from c_inserted into  @nTransid,  @sSourcesystem,   @sSourcecode,  @nTransorgid,  @nTransgroup,
                                    @sTrans, @sTranstype,   @nSessionid,   @sUser,  @sOrg,
                                    @sCode,  @sRentity,  @sEntity,   @sType,  @sLang,
                                    @nLine,  @sPrint, @sCode1, @sOrg1,
                                    @dCreated,  @sEvtalias, @nSqlidentity
         while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
               if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
                  begin
                     set @sChk = null
                     execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nTransid OUTPUT, N'INTERFACE', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                     execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ASTINT N'INSERT', @nSessionid, @sTrans, N'R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE', @nTransid, null, null, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, null, null
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                  end

               --adi_comment is an NTEXT column so we have to do the insert a little differently
               insert into R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE(   ADI_TRANSID,   ADI_SOURCESYSTEM, ADI_SOURCECODE,   ADI_TRANSORGID,   ADI_TRANSGROUP,
                                                ADI_TRANS,  ADI_TRANSTYPE, ADI_SESSIONID, ADI_USER,   ADI_ORG,
                                                ADI_CODE,   ADI_RENTITY,   ADI_ENTITY, ADI_TYPE,   ADI_LANG,
                                                ADI_LINE,   ADI_COMMENT,   ADI_PRINT,  ADI_CODE1,  ADI_ORG1,
                                                ADI_CREATED,   ADI_EVTALIAS)
                        select @nTransid, @sSourcesystem,   @sSourcecode,  @nTransorgid,  @nTransgroup,
                                 @sTrans, @sTranstype,   @nSessionid,   @sUser,  @sOrg,
                                 @sCode,  @sRentity,  @sEntity,   @sType,  @sLang,
                                 @nLine,  ADI_COMMENT,   @sPrint, @sCode1, @sOrg1,
                                 @dCreated,  @sEvtalias
                               from inserted where ADI_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

               fetch next from c_inserted into  @nTransid,  @sSourcesystem,   @sSourcecode,  @nTransorgid,  @nTransgroup,
                                          @sTrans, @sTranstype,   @nSessionid,   @sUser,  @sOrg,
                                          @sCode,  @sRentity,  @sEntity,   @sType,  @sLang,
                                          @nLine,  @sPrint, @sCode1, @sOrg1,
                                          @dCreated,  @sEvtalias, @nSqlidentity
            end
         close c_inserted
         deallocate c_inserted
      end

create trigger PREINS_AGR
on R5AGREEMENTS
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sStatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sDebtor     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sArrangement	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dStart      	datetime            
	declare @dEnd        	datetime            
	declare @sObject     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sProject    	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sObject_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	AGR_CODE,	AGR_DESC,	AGR_STATUS,	AGR_RSTATUS,	AGR_CLASS,
													  	AGR_DEBTOR,	AGR_ARRANGEMENT,	AGR_START,	AGR_END,	AGR_OBJECT,
													  	AGR_PROJECT,	AGR_EVENT,	AGR_ORG,	AGR_CLASS_ORG,	AGR_OBJECT_ORG,
													  	AGR_UPDATECOUNT,	AGR_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
												@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
												@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
												@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7PREAGR N'INS', null, null, null, null, null, 
														null, null, null, null, null, null,	null, null,
														@sCode OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sArrangement, @sClass, 
														@sClass_org, @sDebtor, @sDesc, @dEnd, @sObject, @sProject,
														@sEvent, @dStart
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					insert into R5AGREEMENTS(	AGR_CODE,	AGR_DESC,	AGR_STATUS,	AGR_RSTATUS,	AGR_CLASS,
								             	AGR_DEBTOR,	AGR_ARRANGEMENT,	AGR_START,	AGR_END,	AGR_OBJECT,
								             	AGR_PROJECT,	AGR_EVENT,	AGR_ORG,	AGR_CLASS_ORG,	AGR_OBJECT_ORG,
								             	AGR_UPDATECOUNT)
								values (	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
											@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
											@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
									    	@nUpdatecount
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
														@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
														@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
														@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

on R5ARRPARTS

as

	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sArrangement	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sCharge		numeric(5,2)
	declare @sParClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sParclass_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select apa_arrangement, apa_charge,apa_parclass, apa_parclass_org from inserted 
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = o7preapa N'INS', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sArrangement, @sCharge, @sParClass, @sParclass_org
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sArrangement, @sCharge,@sParClass, @sParclass_org

						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_APL
ON r5approvelists
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @user   NVARCHAR( 38 )
  DECLARE @chk    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @x      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @code   NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @desc   NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @org    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      SET @user = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      IF @user <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT apl_code, apl_org, apl_desc FROM inserted
          OPEN c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @code, @org, @desc
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @chk = N'0'
              SET @x   = NULL
              EXECUTE o7descs N'INS', @x, N'APPL', @x, N'*', @code, @org, @desc, @chk OUTPUT
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @code, @org, @desc
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
          DEALLOCATE c_inserted
        END
    END

create trigger PREINS_APR
on R5ADDPROPERTIES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUser       nvarchar(38)
   declare @sProperty      nvarchar(8)
   declare @sRentity    nvarchar(4)
   declare @sClass         nvarchar(8)
   declare @sClassOrg      nvarchar(15)
   declare @sUom        nvarchar(30)
   declare @sList       nchar(1)
   declare @sGroupLabel nvarchar(255)
   declare @nReturn     int
   declare @sCode       nvarchar(100)
   declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_inserted cursor local for select APR_PROPERTY, APR_RENTITY, APR_CLASS, APR_CLASS_ORG, APR_UOM, APR_LIST, APR_GROUPLABEL from inserted
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_inserted
               fetch next from c_inserted into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sUom, @sList, @sGroupLabel
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     execute @nReturn = O7PROP_PREAPR N'INS', @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sUom, @sList
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end

                        --posins_apr
                        update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                        where pgc_rentity= @sRentity
                        AND pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')

                        /* If handling PART or OBJ or EVNT entity, then translate to PEVL or EEVL or PPM respectively */
                        /* SSEVAL shows PART custom fields , OSEVAL shows OBJ custom fields and WSPPMS shows EVNT custom fields*/
                        if( @sRentity = 'PART' OR @sRentity = 'OBJ' )
                           begin
                              update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                 where pgc_rentity= CASE @sRentity 
                                 			WHEN 'PART' THEN 'PEVL'
                                 			ELSE 'EEVL' END
                                 and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')
                           end

                        if( @sRentity = 'EVNT' )
                           begin
                              update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                 where pgc_rentity in ( N'PPM', N'STWO' )
                                 and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')
                           end

						-- Insert any Group Label translations
						set @sCode = @sProperty + '#' + @sRentity + '#' + @sClass + '#' + @sClassOrg
						execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', NULL, N'CFGL', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, @sGroupLabel, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							begin
								close c_inserted
								deallocate c_inserted
								rollback transaction
								return
							end

                     fetch next from c_inserted into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sUom, @sList, @sGroupLabel
                  end
               close c_inserted
            end
         deallocate c_inserted
      end

create trigger PREINS_ASP
on R5ASPECTS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTimeDep		nvarchar(2)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sType			nvarchar(8)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select ASP_TIMEDEP, ASP_CODE, ASP_DESC, ASP_CLASS, ASP_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sTimeDep, @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sType = NULL
						
							If @sTimeDep is not null 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sTimeDep OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, N'TIMD', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ASP', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end


							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'ASPC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ASP', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'ASPC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sTimeDep, @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nAttribute,	@sTable,	@sPrimaryid,	@sSecondaryid,	@sFrom,
												@sTo,	@dChanged,	@sModifiedby,	@sFunction,	@sUpdated,
												@sInserted,	@sDeleted,	@nUpdatecount,	@sScode, @nSqlidentity,
                                                @sMobile
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin

							set @sValue = cast(coalesce(@nAttribute,N'') as nvarchar(38)) + coalesce(@sTable,N'') + coalesce(@sPrimaryid,N'') + coalesce(@sSecondaryid,N'')  +
										coalesce(@sFrom,N'') + coalesce(@sTo,N'') +	cast(coalesce(@dChanged,N'') as nvarchar(64)) +	coalesce(@sModifiedby,N'') +	coalesce(@sFunction,N'') +	coalesce(@sUpdated,N'') +
										coalesce(@sInserted,N'') +	coalesce(@sDeleted,N'') +	cast(coalesce(@nUpdatecount,N'') as nvarchar(38)) 	

							set @sTemp = coalesce( @sModifiedby, N'GBJMIONL')

							SET @sScode = dbo.O7HASH(@sValue, @sTemp)


						end
					insert into R5AUDVALUES(	AVA_ATTRIBUTE,	AVA_TABLE,	AVA_PRIMARYID,	AVA_SECONDARYID,	AVA_FROM,
								            	AVA_TO,	AVA_CHANGED,	AVA_MODIFIEDBY,	AVA_FUNCTION,	AVA_UPDATED,
								            	AVA_INSERTED,	AVA_DELETED,	AVA_UPDATECOUNT, AVA_SCODE, AVA_MOBILE, AVA_PRIMARYID2 )
								values (	@nAttribute,	@sTable,	@sPrimaryid,	@sSecondaryid,	@sFrom,
											@sTo,	@dChanged,	@sModifiedby,	@sFunction,	@sUpdated,
									    	@sInserted,	@sDeleted,	@nUpdatecount, @sScode, @sMobile,
									    	CASE @sTable WHEN N'R5OBJECTS' THEN @sPrimaryid ELSE NULL END )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nAttribute,	@sTable,	@sPrimaryid,	@sSecondaryid,	@sFrom,
														@sTo,	@dChanged,	@sModifiedby,	@sFunction,	@sUpdated,
														@sInserted,	@sDeleted,	@nUpdatecount,	@sScode, @nSqlidentity, 
                                                        @sMobile
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

as

	declare @sLocationgr  	nvarchar(5)         
	declare @sObjectgr    	nvarchar(5)         
	declare @sJobtypegr   	nvarchar(5)         
	declare @sCosttypegr  	nvarchar(5)

	declare @nAmount      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOriginal    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nSeqno       	numeric(2,0)        
	declare @sObject_org  	nvarchar(15)

	declare @sProject		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCostcodegr	nvarchar(5)
	declare @sProjectgr		nvarchar(5)
	declare @sParent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer             

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	BDT_CODE,	BDT_BUDGET,	BDT_YEAR,	BDT_LEVEL,	BDT_PERIOD,
													  	BDT_MRC,	BDT_LOCATION,	BDT_OBJECT,	BDT_JOBTYPE,	BDT_COSTTYPE,
													  	BDT_COSTRTYPE,	BDT_MRCGR,	BDT_LOCATIONGR,	BDT_OBJECTGR,	BDT_JOBTYPEGR,

													  	BDT_OBJECT_ORG,	BDT_LOCATION_ORG,	BDT_UPDATECOUNT,	BDT_CREATED,	BDT_UPDATED,
														BDT_COSTCODE, BDT_PROJECT, BDT_COSTCODEGR, BDT_PROJECTGR, BDT_PARENT, BDT_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sBudget,	@sYear,	@nLevel,	@sPeriod,

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin

									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

											close c_inserted

										end



      								if @sCheckresult <> N'0'

										deallocate c_inserted
										execute O7RAE N'O7CKCODE', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end
								end
   
							execute @nReturn = o7prebdt N'INS', @sBudget, @sYear, @nLevel, @sPeriod, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocation_org,
										@sObject, @sObject_org, @sJobtype, @sCosttype, @sMrcgr, @sLocationgr, @sObjectgr, @sJobtypegr, @sCosttypegr,
										@sCode OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
  							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
   
   
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREBDT', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @dCreated  = getdate()

						end

					insert into R5BUDGETDETAILS(	BDT_CODE,	BDT_BUDGET,	BDT_YEAR,	BDT_LEVEL,	BDT_PERIOD,
										            BDT_MRC,	BDT_LOCATION,	BDT_OBJECT,	BDT_JOBTYPE,	BDT_COSTTYPE,
										            BDT_COSTRTYPE,	BDT_MRCGR,	BDT_LOCATIONGR,	BDT_OBJECTGR,	BDT_JOBTYPEGR,
										            BDT_COSTTYPEGR,	BDT_SPENT,	BDT_AMOUNT,	BDT_ORIGINAL,	BDT_SEQNO,
										            BDT_OBJECT_ORG,	BDT_LOCATION_ORG,	BDT_UPDATECOUNT,	BDT_CREATED,	BDT_UPDATED,
													BDT_COSTCODE, BDT_PROJECT, BDT_COSTCODEGR, BDT_PROJECTGR, BDT_PARENT )
										        
								values (	@sCode,	@sBudget,	@sYear,	@nLevel,	@sPeriod,
											@sMrc,	@sLocation,	@sObject,	@sJobtype,	@sCosttype,
											@sCostrtype,	@sMrcgr,	@sLocationgr,	@sObjectgr,	@sJobtypegr,
											@sCosttypegr,	@nSpent,	@nAmount,	@nOriginal,	@nSeqno,
											@sObject_org,	@sLocation_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
											@sCostcode, @sProject, @sCostcodegr, @sProjectgr, @sParent
										   )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sBudget,	@sYear,	@nLevel,	@sPeriod,
														@sMrc,	@sLocation,	@sObject,	@sJobtype,	@sCosttype,
														@sCostrtype,	@sMrcgr,	@sLocationgr,	@sObjectgr,	@sJobtypegr,
														@sCosttypegr,	@nSpent,	@nAmount,	@nOriginal,	@nSeqno,
														@sObject_org,	@sLocation_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
														@sCostcode, @sProject, @sCostcodegr, @sProjectgr, @sParent, 
														@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_BIN
on R5BINS
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @sBinorg			nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_org%TYPE
	declare @sStore				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @sOldStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @sCurrUser			nvarchar(255)
	declare @dReturn			datetime
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sNotused		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldnotused		nvarchar(1)
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
					if @nCount = 0
						begin
							--INSERTING
							declare c_inserted cursor local for select BIN_STORE, BIN_CODE from inserted
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sStore, @sCode
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									select @sBinorg = str_org from r5stores where str_code = @sStore

									execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCurrUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dReturn OUTPUT, @sBinorg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									update r5bins set bin_createdby = coalesce( @sCurrUser, N'R5' ), bin_created = @dReturn
									 where bin_store = @sStore and bin_code = @sCode
							
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sStore, @sCode
								end
							close c_inserted
							deallocate c_inserted
						end
					else
						begin
							--UPDATING
							declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.BIN_STORE, i.BIN_CODE, i.BIN_UPDATECOUNT,
																		d.BIN_STORE, d.BIN_CODE, d.BIN_UPDATECOUNT,
																		i.BIN_NOTUSED, d.BIN_NOTUSED
																from	inserted i, deleted d
																where	i.BIN_SQLIDENTITY = d.BIN_SQLIDENTITY
							open c_ins_del 
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStore, @sCode, @nUpdatecount, @sOldStore, @sOldCode, @nOldUpdatecount, 
															@sNotused, @sOldnotused
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									if @sCode	<> @sOldCode OR
									  @sStore	<> @sOldStore
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									
									IF coalesce( @sOldnotused, N'-' ) = N'-' AND coalesce( @sNotused, N'-' ) = N'+' 
										UPDATE r5stock
										SET    sto_defaultbin = null
										WHERE  sto_store      = @sStore
										AND    sto_defaultbin = @sCode


									if coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) <> coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1)
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1'
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCurrUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dReturn OUTPUT, @sBinorg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									update r5bins set	bin_updatedby	= coalesce( @sCurrUser, N'R5' ), 
														bin_updated		= @dReturn,
														bin_updatecount	= coalesce( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 ) + 1
									 where bin_store = @sStore and bin_code = @sCode
									
									fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStore, @sCode, @nUpdatecount, @sOldStore, @sOldCode, @nOldUpdatecount,
																	@sNotused, @sOldnotused
								end
							close c_ins_del
							deallocate c_ins_del
						end
				end
		end

create trigger PREINS_BLL
on R5BLANKETORDLINES
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sBlanketorder 	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nBlanketline  	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sType         	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRtype        	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sCommodity    	nvarchar(15)         
	declare @sPart         	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sUom          	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nUomprice     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMultiply     	numeric(10,4)       
	declare @sCurr         	nvarchar(3)         
	declare @nExch         	numeric(24,12)      
	declare @nQty          	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMaxlineqty   	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMaxlineamount	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCurqtyrel    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCuramountrel 	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nNumreleased  	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sLastord      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sQuotation    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nQuoteline    	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sSeqno        	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @nExchtodual   	numeric(24,12)      
	declare @nExchfromdual 	numeric(24,12)      
	declare @sRef          	nvarchar(50)        
	declare @sLastord_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sPart_org     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sInspect      	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount  	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sTask         	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sTrade        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sCostcode     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOrdqty       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTaskqty      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sPuruom       	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @nPrice        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sDeladdress   	nvarchar(20) 
	declare @nTodual   		numeric(24,12)      
	declare @nFromdual 		numeric(24,12)
	declare @sExchorg	nvarchar(15)	
	declare @dCreateddate	datetime
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @nTempprice		numeric(24,6)       	
	declare @nTemp			numeric(24,6) 
	declare @nSqlidentity		int
	declare @nReturn		int   
	declare @sObject		nvarchar(30)   	  
	declare @sObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nTaskrev		numeric(4)
	declare @nTempExch		numeric(24,12)   
	    
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	BLL_BLANKETORDER,	BLL_BLANKETLINE,	BLL_TYPE,	BLL_RTYPE,	BLL_COMMODITY,
													  	BLL_PART,	BLL_UOM,	BLL_UOMPRICE,	BLL_MULTIPLY,	BLL_CURR,
													  	BLL_EXCH,	BLL_QTY,	BLL_MAXLINEQTY,	BLL_MAXLINEAMOUNT,	BLL_CURQTYREL,
													  	BLL_CURAMOUNTREL,	BLL_NUMRELEASED,	BLL_LASTORD,	BLL_QUOTATION,	BLL_QUOTELINE,
													  	BLL_SEQNO,	BLL_EXCHTODUAL,	BLL_EXCHFROMDUAL,	BLL_REF,	BLL_LASTORD_ORG,
													  	BLL_PART_ORG,	BLL_INSPECT,	BLL_UPDATECOUNT,	BLL_TASK,	BLL_TRADE,
													  	BLL_COSTCODE,	BLL_ORDQTY,	BLL_TASKQTY,	BLL_PURUOM,	BLL_PRICE,
													  	BLL_DELADDRESS,	BLL_OBJECT, BLL_OBJECT_ORG, BLL_TASKREV, BLL_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sBlanketorder,	@nBlanketline,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@sCommodity,
												@sPart,	@sUom,	@nUomprice,	@nMultiply,	@sCurr,
												@nExch,	@nQty,	@nMaxlineqty,	@nMaxlineamount,	@nCurqtyrel,
												@nCuramountrel,	@nNumreleased,	@sLastord,	@sQuotation,	@nQuoteline,
												@sSeqno,	@nExchtodual,	@nExchfromdual,	@sRef,	@sLastord_org,
												@sPart_org,	@sInspect,	@nUpdatecount,	@sTask,	@sTrade,
												@sCostcode,	@nOrdqty,	@nTaskqty,	@sPuruom,	@nPrice,
												@sDeladdress, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @nTaskrev,	@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* M26121 - Type, rtype must exist(r5ucodes)                               */
							IF @sType IS NOT NULL 
								begin
									set @sRtype = @sX
									EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @sRtype OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, N'PLTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									IF @sCheckresult <> 0
									begin
										close c_inserted
										deallocate c_inserted
										EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								end								

							/* M2612B - Price is required for catalogued Purchases                     */
							if  @sPart     IS NOT NULL AND @nUomprice IS     NULL
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							IF @nMaxlineamount IS NOT NULL 
								begin
									IF @nUomprice IS NOT NULL  
										begin
											IF ROUND(( @nUomprice)/coalesce(@nExch, 1 ), 2 ) * coalesce(@nQty, 1) >  ROUND(( @nMaxlineamount)/ coalesce(@nExch,1 ) , 2 )  
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'10', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									IF @nPrice IS NOT NULL 
										begin
											IF ROUND(( @nPrice)/coalesce(@nExch, 1 ), 2 )  * coalesce(@nOrdqty, 1) > ROUND(( @nMaxlineamount)/ coalesce(@nExch,1 ) , 2 ) 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'11', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							SELECT @nTemp = ROUND( b.blo_maxamount/ isnull( b.blo_exch, 1 ), 2 )
							FROM   r5blanketorders b
							WHERE  b.blo_blanketorder = @sBlanketorder

							IF @nTemp IS NOT NULL 
								begin
									IF ROUND((@nMaxlineamount)/ coalesce(@nExch,1 ) , 2 ) > @nTemp 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'6', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
										begin
											IF ROUND(( @nUomprice)/coalesce(@nExch, 1 ), 2 ) * coalesce(@nQty, 1) > @nTemp 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'5', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											ELSE 
												begin
													IF ROUND(( @nPrice)/coalesce(@nExch, 1 ), 2 ) * coalesce(@nOrdqty, 1) > @nTemp 
														begin
															close c_inserted
															deallocate c_inserted
															EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'5', @@ERROR
															rollback transaction
															return
														end
												end
										end
								end
							ELSE
								begin
									IF @nQty IS NOT NULL 
										begin
											IF @nMaxlineqty IS NULL AND @nMaxlineamount IS NULL 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'7', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									ELSE
										begin
											IF @nOrdqty IS NOT NULL 
												begin
													IF @nMaxlineqty IS NULL AND @nMaxlineamount IS NULL 
														begin
															close c_inserted
															deallocate c_inserted
															EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rae N'PREINS_BLL', N'TRIG', N'8', @@ERROR
															rollback transaction
															return

create trigger PREINS_BOT
on R5BOILERTEXTS
for insert, update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUser            nvarchar(38)
   declare @sFunction        nvarchar(6)
   declare @nNumber          int
   declare @sLang            nvarchar(2)
   declare @sDevt            nvarchar(1)
   declare @nUpdatecount     int
   declare @nOldUpdatecount  int
   declare @nCount           int
   declare @nSQLIdentity     int
   declare @sCloned          nvarchar(1)
   declare @nEquipLOVText    int
   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
         if @nCount = 0  --INSERTING
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select BOT_FUNCTION, BOT_NUMBER, BOT_LANG, null, null, BOT_SQLIDENTITY, BOT_CLONED from inserted
         else  --UPDATING
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.BOT_FUNCTION, i.BOT_NUMBER, i.BOT_LANG, i.BOT_UPDATECOUNT, d.BOT_UPDATECOUNT, i.BOT_SQLIDENTITY, i.BOT_CLONED
                                       from inserted i, deleted d
                                      where i.BOT_SQLIDENTITY = d.BOT_SQLIDENTITY
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
               open c_ins_del
               fetch next from c_ins_del into @sFunction, @nNumber, @sLang, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSQLIdentity, @sCloned
               while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  begin
                     select @sDevt = SUBSTRING( ins_desc, 1, 1 )
                     FROM   r5install
                     WHERE  ins_code = N'KEEPBOT'

                     if @sDevt = N'+' AND coalesce( @sCloned, N'-' ) = N'-'
                        update  R5BOILERTEXTS set BOT_CHANGED = N'+'
                         where  BOT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSQLIdentity

                     update R5BOILERTEXTS set BOT_CLONED = N'-'
                         where  BOT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSQLIdentity

                     if @nCount > 0
                        begin
                           update  R5BOILERTEXTS set BOT_UPDATED = GetDate()
                            where  BOT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSQLIdentity

                           --PREUPD2_BOT portion
                           if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
                              update   R5BOILERTEXTS set BOT_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
                               where  BOT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSQLIdentity
                           else
                              begin
                                 close c_ins_del
                                 deallocate c_ins_del
                                 execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                                 rollback transaction
                                 return
                              end

                           --POSUPD_BOT
                           IF ISNULL( @sCloned, '-' ) = '-'
                             BEGIN
                               IF @sFunction = N'BSDESC'
                                  update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount Where pgc_TABNAME=N'DES'
                               ELSE
                                  begin
                                     IF @sFunction = N'BSPARA'
                                         update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount Where pgc_TABNAME=N'PAS'
                                     ELSE
                                        begin
                                           IF @sFunction = N'BSADRS'
                                            update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount Where pgc_TABNAME= N'ADR'
                                           ELSE
                                              begin
                                                 update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_FUNCTION=@sFunction

                                                 -- Handle boilertext changes for text on the equipment lookups
                                                 select @nEquipLOVText = count(1)
                                                 from  r5gridfield
                                                 where gfd_gridid IN ( 67, 1907, 2032, 2216, 1398, 2085, 2372, 2445, 1059, 1416, 1483, 157, 1700, 1973, 412, 1283, 1039, 1984, 1986 )
                                                 and   gfd_botfunction = @sFunction
                                                 and   gfd_botnumber   = @nNumber

                                                 IF @nEquipLOVText > 0
                                                    update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount = pgc_updatecount where pgc_FUNCTION = N'OSEQPP'
                                              end
                                        end
                                  end
                             end
                        end

                     fetch next from c_ins_del into @sFunction, @nNumber, @sLang, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSQLIdentity, @sCloned
                  end
               close c_ins_del
            end
         deallocate c_ins_del
      end

create trigger PREINS_CAC
on R5CAUSECLASSES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sGen			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCause		nvarchar(8)  -- r5causes.cau_gen%TYPE;
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CAC_CLASS, CAC_CLASS_ORG, CAC_CAUSE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCause
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* W41201 - Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'OBJ' ) */
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit >= 0
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CAC', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							SELECT @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5causes 
							WHERE  cau_code = @sCause

							/* W41220 - Cause Code can't be general (r5causes) */
							if @nCount <= 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CAC', N'TRIG', N'999', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							else
								begin
									SELECT @sGen = cau_gen
									FROM   r5causes
									WHERE  cau_code = @sCause
									
									if @sGen = N'+'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CAC', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCause
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

  ON r5assetclassdefcapacities
  INSTEAD OF INSERT
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sOcdpk               nvarchar(30)

  DECLARE @sUdfchkbox05      nvarchar(1)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON

      SELECT ccp_ocdpk, ccp_capacitycode, ccp_capacity, ccp_desiredcapacity, 
             ccp_totaldesiredcapacity, ccp_effective, ccp_expired,
             ccp_created, ccp_createdby, ccp_updated, ccp_updatedby,
             ccp_udfchar01, ccp_udfchar02, ccp_udfchar03, ccp_udfchar04, ccp_udfchar05,

             ccp_udfchkbox01, ccp_udfchkbox02, ccp_udfchkbox03, ccp_udfchkbox04, ccp_udfchkbox05
      FROM  INSERTED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sOcdpk, @sCapacitycode, @nCapacity, @nDesiredCapacity, 
                @nTotDesiredCapacity, @dEffectivedate, @dExpiredate,
                @dCreated, @sCreatedby, @dUpdated, @sUpdatedby,
                @sUdfchar01, @sUdfchar02, @sUdfchar03, @sUdfchar04, @sUdfchar05,
                @sUdfchar06, @sUdfchar07, @sUdfchar08, @sUdfchar09, @sUdfchar10, 
                @sUdfchar11, @sUdfchar12, @sUdfchar13, @sUdfchar14, @sUdfchar15, 
                @sUdfchar16, @sUdfchar17, @sUdfchar18, @sUdfchar19, @sUdfchar20,

                @nUdfnum01, @nUdfnum02, @nUdfnum03, @nUdfnum04, @nUdfnum05,  
                @dUdfdate01, @dUdfdate02, @dUdfdate03, @dUdfdate04, @dUdfdate05, 
                @sUdfchkbox01, @sUdfchkbox02, @sUdfchkbox03, @sUdfchkbox04, @sUdfchkbox05
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN

              SELECT @dExpiredate = MIN( ccp_effective ) - 1
              FROM   r5assetclassdefcapacities
              WHERE  ccp_ocdpk        = @sOcdpk
              AND    ccp_capacitycode = @sCapacitycode
              AND    ccp_effective    > @dEffectivedate
              
              SET @dExpiredate = ISNULL( @dExpiredate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

              INSERT INTO r5assetclassdefcapacities
                    ( ccp_ocdpk, ccp_capacitycode, ccp_capacity, ccp_desiredcapacity,
                      ccp_totaldesiredcapacity, ccp_effective, ccp_expired,
                      ccp_created, ccp_createdby, ccp_updated, ccp_updatedby,
                      ccp_udfchar01, ccp_udfchar02, ccp_udfchar03, ccp_udfchar04, ccp_udfchar05,
                      ccp_udfchar06, ccp_udfchar07, ccp_udfchar08, ccp_udfchar09, ccp_udfchar10,
                      ccp_udfchar11, ccp_udfchar12, ccp_udfchar13, ccp_udfchar14, ccp_udfchar15,
                      ccp_udfchar16, ccp_udfchar17, ccp_udfchar18, ccp_udfchar19, ccp_udfchar20,
                      ccp_udfchar21, ccp_udfchar22, ccp_udfchar23, ccp_udfchar24, ccp_udfchar25,
                      ccp_udfchar26, ccp_udfchar27, ccp_udfchar28, ccp_udfchar29, ccp_udfchar30,
                      ccp_udfnum01,  ccp_udfnum02,  ccp_udfnum03,  ccp_udfnum04,  ccp_udfnum05,
                      ccp_udfdate01, ccp_udfdate02, ccp_udfdate03, ccp_udfdate04, ccp_udfdate05,
                      ccp_udfchkbox01, ccp_udfchkbox02, ccp_udfchkbox03, ccp_udfchkbox04, ccp_udfchkbox05 )
              VALUES( @sOcdpk, @sCapacitycode, @nCapacity, @nDesiredCapacity, 
                      @nTotDesiredCapacity, @dEffectivedate, @dExpiredate,
                      @dCreated, @sCreatedby, @dUpdated, @sUpdatedby,
                      @sUdfchar01, @sUdfchar02, @sUdfchar03, @sUdfchar04, @sUdfchar05,
                      @sUdfchar06, @sUdfchar07, @sUdfchar08, @sUdfchar09, @sUdfchar10, 
                      @sUdfchar11, @sUdfchar12, @sUdfchar13, @sUdfchar14, @sUdfchar15, 
                      @sUdfchar16, @sUdfchar17, @sUdfchar18, @sUdfchar19, @sUdfchar20,
                      @sUdfchar21, @sUdfchar22, @sUdfchar23, @sUdfchar24, @sUdfchar25, 
                      @sUdfchar26, @sUdfchar27, @sUdfchar28, @sUdfchar29, @sUdfchar30, 
                      @nUdfnum01, @nUdfnum02, @nUdfnum03, @nUdfnum04, @nUdfnum05,  
                      @dUdfdate01, @dUdfdate02, @dUdfdate03, @dUdfdate04, @dUdfdate05, 
                      @sUdfchkbox01, @sUdfchkbox02, @sUdfchkbox03, @sUdfchkbox04, @sUdfchkbox05)

              SELECT @dMaxeffectivedate = MAX( ccp_effective )
              FROM   r5assetclassdefcapacities
              WHERE  ccp_ocdpk        = @sOcdpk
              AND    ccp_capacitycode = @sCapacitycode
              AND    ccp_effective    < @dEffectivedate
              
              IF @dMaxeffectivedate IS NOT NULL
                UPDATE r5assetclassdefcapacities
                SET    ccp_expired      = @dEffectivedate - 1
                WHERE  ccp_ocdpk        = @sOcdpk
                AND    ccp_capacitycode = @s

create trigger PREINS_CCY
on R5CONTYPECLAUSES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sContype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sContypeorg		nvarchar(15)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CCY_CONTYPE, CCY_CONTYPE_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sContype, @sContypeorg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CONT', @sContype, @sContypeorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CCY', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sContype, @sContypeorg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_CDI
on R5CONDISCOUNTS
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUsr_name		nvarchar(38)

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCONTRACT     nvarchar (30) 
	declare @sPART         nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sTYPE         nvarchar (4) 
	declare @sRTYPE        nvarchar (4) 
	declare @nVALUE        numeric(24,6) 
	declare @nPURQTY       numeric(24,6) 
	declare @nDISPERC      numeric(7,4) 
	declare @dSTART        datetime
	declare @dEND          datetime
	declare @sPART_ORG     nvarchar (15) 
	declare @nUPDATECOUNT  numeric(38,0) 
	declare @nPk			numeric(38,0)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select  CDI_CONTRACT, CDI_PART, CDI_TYPE, CDI_RTYPE, CDI_VALUE, CDI_PURQTY, CDI_DISPERC, CDI_START, CDI_END, CDI_PART_ORG, CDI_UPDATECOUNT, CDI_PK from inserted

			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sCONTRACT, @sPART, @sTYPE, @sRTYPE, @nVALUE, @nPURQTY, @nDISPERC, @dSTART, @dEND, @sPART_ORG, @nUPDATECOUNT , @nPk


			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							IF @nPk IS NULL 
								begin
   									execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @nPk OUTPUT, N'CDI', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end   

							execute @nReturn = O7PRECDI N'INS', @sTYPE OUTPUT, @sRTYPE OUTPUT, @sCONTRACT,
																@nVALUE, @nPURQTY, @dSTART,
																@dEND, @sPART, @sPART_ORG, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRECDI', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
							
					insert into R5CONDISCOUNTS	( CDI_CONTRACT, CDI_PART, CDI_TYPE, CDI_RTYPE, CDI_VALUE, CDI_PURQTY, CDI_DISPERC, CDI_START, CDI_END, CDI_PART_ORG, CDI_UPDATECOUNT, CDI_PK )
						values (	@sCONTRACT, @sPART, @sTYPE, @sRTYPE, @nVALUE, @nPURQTY, @nDISPERC, @dSTART, @dEND, @sPART_ORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @nPk  )

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCONTRACT, @sPART, @sTYPE, @sRTYPE, @nVALUE, @nPURQTY, @nDISPERC, @dSTART, @dEND, @sPART_ORG, @nUPDATECOUNT , @nPk
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted

												@sAgreement,	@nLab_cost,	@nMat_cost,	@nPrice,	@sIncrementable,

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
