CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_CFM
  ON r5compfuelmix
  INSTEAD OF INSERT
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sSupplier    NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sSuporg      NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCommodity   NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sType        NVARCHAR(8)
  DECLARE @nCapacity    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @dFromdate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @dTodate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUser        NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dMaxfromdate DATETIME

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT cfm_supplier, cfm_supplier_org, cfm_commodity, cfm_type,
             cfm_capacity, cfm_fromdate, cfm_todate
      FROM   INSERTED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sSupplier, @sSuporg, @sCommodity, 
                @sType, @nCapacity, @dFromdate, @dTodate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN

              SELECT @dTodate = MIN( cfm_fromdate ) - 1
              FROM   r5compfuelmix
              WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
              AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSuporg
              AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
              AND    cfm_type         = @sType
              AND    cfm_fromdate     > @dFromdate;
              SET @dTodate = ISNULL( @dTodate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

              INSERT INTO r5compfuelmix( cfm_supplier, cfm_supplier_org, cfm_commodity, 
                     cfm_type, cfm_capacity, cfm_fromdate, cfm_todate )
              VALUES( @sSupplier, @sSuporg, @sCommodity, 
                      @sType, @nCapacity, @dFromdate, @dTodate )

              SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX( cfm_fromdate )
              FROM   r5compfuelmix
              WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
              AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSuporg
              AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
              AND    cfm_type         = @sType
              AND    cfm_fromdate     < @dFromdate
              IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                UPDATE r5compfuelmix
                SET    cfm_todate       = @dFromdate - 1
                WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
                AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSuporg
                AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
                AND    cfm_type         = @sType
                AND    cfm_fromdate     = @dMaxfromdate

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sSupplier, @sSuporg, @sCommodity, 
                    @sType, @nCapacity, @dFromdate, @dTodate
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

create trigger PREINS_CFS
on R5CONFIGSETTINGS
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(20)
	declare @sGroup      	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sUser       	nvarchar(255)
	declare @sComptype   	nvarchar(20)
	declare @nConfig     	integer
	declare @dCreated    	datetime
	declare @dUpdated    	datetime
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer
	declare @sDesk			nvarchar(1)
	
    declare @sMobReset          nvarchar(8)		
	declare @sUserid		nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn		int	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	CFS_CODE,	CFS_GROUP,	CFS_USER,	CFS_COMPTYPE,	CFS_CONFIG,
													  	CFS_CREATED,	CFS_UPDATED,	CFS_UPDATECOUNT,	CFS_DESK, CFS_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sGroup,	@sUser,	@sComptype,	@nConfig,
												@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nUpdatecount,	@sDesk, @nSqlidentity

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
						    set @sDesk = coalesce(@sDesk, N'0')


							delete from r5configsettings
							where cfs_code = @sCode
							and cfs_group = @sGroup
							and cfs_user = @sUser
							and cfs_comptype = @sComptype
							and cfs_config = @nConfig
						    and cfs_desk = @sDesk

							IF @sCode =N'SYNCON_IPAD' AND @sGroup <> N'*' AND @sUser = N'*'
							BEGIN
							    EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
							    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									SELECT @sUserid = ''
								END
								
								SET @sMobReset = N'NO'
								SELECT @sMobReset = N'YES' FROM dual where 
								   (  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code=N'MOBRESET' AND ins_desc=N'YES') 
								      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code=N'MOBRESET'))
									AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5users WHERE usr_code = @sUserid AND usr_mobileadm=N'+')

								IF @sMobReset=N'YES'
									DELETE FROM r5configsettings
									WHERE cfs_code= @sCode
									AND cfs_group = @sGroup AND cfs_user <> N'*'
							END


							IF @sCode =N'SYNCON' and @sGroup = N'*' and @sUser = N'*'
								DELETE FROM r5configsettings
								WHERE cfs_code= N'SYNCON'
								AND NOT ( cfs_group = N'*' AND cfs_user = N'*')
								AND cfs_desk = @sDesk
							ELSE
								begin
									IF @sCode= N'SYNCON' AND @sGroup <> N'*' AND @sUser = N'*'
										delete from r5configsettings
										where cfs_code='SYNCON'
										and cfs_user <> N'*'
										AND cfs_desk = @sDesk
										and exists (select N'x' from r5users
													where usr_code = cfs_user
													and usr_group = @sGroup)
								end

							if @sComptype = N'U' and @sGroup = N'*' and @sUser = N'*'
								DELETE FROM r5configsettings
								WHERE cfs_code = @sCode
								AND cfs_comptype = N'U'
								AND cfs_config <> 1
								AND cfs_desk = @sDesk
							else
								begin
									if @sComptype = N'U' and @sGroup <> N'*' and @sUser = N'*'
										DELETE FROM r5configsettings
										WHERE cfs_code = @sCode
										AND cfs_comptype = N'U'
										AND cfs_desk = @sDesk
										AND cfs_user <> N'*'
										AND EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM r5users
													  WHERE usr_code = cfs_user
													  AND usr_group = @sGroup)
								end
						end
					--CFS_XCONFIG is an NTEXT column so we have to do the insert a little differently
					--must use the PK to join the inserted table and not the SQLIdentity Column.
					insert into R5CONFIGSETTINGS(	CFS_CODE,	CFS_GROUP,	CFS_USER,	CFS_COMPTYPE,	CFS_CONFIG,
								                 	CFS_XMLCONFIG,	CFS_CREATED,	CFS_UPDATED,	CFS_DESK, CFS_UPDATECOUNT)
								select	@sCode,	@sGroup,	@sUser,	@sComptype,	@nConfig,
									    	CFS_XMLCONFIG,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@sDesk, @nUpdatecount
									from inserted where CFS_CODE = @sCode AND
														CFS_GROUP = @sGroup AND
														CFS_USER = @sUser AND
														CFS_COMPTYPE = @sComptype AND
														CFS_CONFIG = @nConfig AND
														CFS_DESK = @sDesk

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sGroup,	@sUser,	@sComptype,	@nConfig,
														@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nUpdatecount,	@sDesk, @nSqlidentity

				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_CMD
on R5COMMODITIES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CMD_CODE, CMD_Org, CMD_DESC, CMD_CLASS, CMD_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

								/* W21221 : Class must exist ( r5classes, rentity = N'SHIF' ) */
								If @sClass is not null
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'COMM', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit >= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0 
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREINS_CMD', N'TRIG', 3
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CMD', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
										else
											begin
												set @sX = Null
											end
									end

							   /* M09150 insert descriptions */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'COMM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_CON
on R5CONTRACTS
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCODE          nvarchar (30)  
	declare @sDESC          nvarchar (80)
	declare @sCLASS         nvarchar (8) 
	declare @sSUPPLIER      nvarchar (30)
	declare @sLANG          nvarchar (2)
	declare @sCURR          nvarchar (3)
	declare @sCOPY          nvarchar (30) 
	declare @sSTORE         nvarchar (15)
	declare @sSTATUS        nvarchar (4)
	declare @sRSTATUS       nvarchar (4)
	declare @sOWN           nvarchar (1)
	declare @sREF           nvarchar (50) 
	declare @dCREATE        datetime
	declare @dSTART         datetime
	declare @dEND           datetime
	declare @dRENEW         datetime
	declare @sPRINTED       nvarchar (1)
	declare @sOWNCONTACT    nvarchar (15)
	declare @sCONTACT       nvarchar (45) 
	declare @sORG           nvarchar (15)
	declare @sCLASS_ORG     nvarchar (15) 
	declare @sSUPPLIER_ORG  nvarchar (15)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CON_CODE, CON_DESC, CON_CLASS, CON_SUPPLIER, CON_LANG, CON_CURR, CON_COPY, 
														CON_STORE, CON_STATUS, CON_RSTATUS, CON_OWN, CON_REF, CON_CREATE, CON_START, 
														CON_END, CON_RENEW, CON_PRINTED, CON_OWNCONTACT, CON_CONTACT, CON_ORG, CON_CLASS_ORG, 
														CON_SUPPLIER_ORG, CON_UPDATECOUNT from inserted 
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted 
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCLASS, @sSUPPLIER, @sLANG, @sCURR, @sCOPY, @sSTORE, @sSTATUS, @sRSTATUS, 
											@sOWN, @sREF, @dCREATE, @dSTART, @dEND, @dRENEW, @sPRINTED, @sOWNCONTACT, @sCONTACT, @sORG, 
											@sCLASS_ORG, @sSUPPLIER_ORG, @nUpdatecount 
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0



							If @sCOPY is not null AND @sCLASS is not null
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CON', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7PRECON N'INS', @sORG, @dCREATE OUTPUT,   @sSTATUS OUTPUT, @sRSTATUS OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRECON', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7CKOCOM @sORG, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7CKOCOM', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end



					insert into R5CONTRACTS	(	CON_CODE, CON_DESC, CON_CLASS, CON_SUPPLIER, CON_LANG, CON_CURR, CON_COPY, 
												CON_STORE, CON_STATUS, CON_RSTATUS, CON_OWN, CON_REF, CON_CREATE, CON_START, 
												CON_END, CON_RENEW, CON_PRINTED, CON_OWNCONTACT, CON_CONTACT, CON_ORG, CON_CLASS_ORG, 
												CON_SUPPLIER_ORG, CON_UPDATECOUNT  )
					values ( @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCLASS, @sSUPPLIER, @sLANG, @sCURR, @sCOPY, @sSTORE, @sSTATUS, @sRSTATUS, 
													@sOWN, @sREF, @dCREATE, @dSTART, @dEND, @dRENEW, @sPRINTED, @sOWNCONTACT, @sCONTACT, @sORG, 
													@sCLASS_ORG, @sSUPPLIER_ORG, @nUpdatecount  )

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCLASS, @sSUPPLIER, @sLANG, @sCURR, @sCOPY, @sSTORE, @sSTATUS, @sRSTATUS, 
													@sOWN, @sREF, @dCREATE, @dSTART, @dEND, @dRENEW, @sPRINTED, @sOWNCONTACT, @sCONTACT, @sORG, 
													@sCLASS_ORG, @sSUPPLIER_ORG, @nUpdatecount 
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_CRC
ON r5crcorrtemp
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @rtype     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @trans     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @line      NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @price     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @qty       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @obj       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @r         INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
    
      DECLARE c_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT crc_rtype, crc_trans, crc_line, crc_price, crc_qty, crc_object, crc_object_org
        FROM   inserted
        WHERE  crc_rtype IS NOT NULL
        AND    crc_trans IS NOT NULL
        AND    crc_line  IS NOT NULL
        AND    ( ( crc_price IS NOT NULL AND crc_qty IS NOT NULL ) OR ( crc_object IS NOT NULL AND crc_object_org IS NOT NULL ) )
      OPEN c_ins
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @rtype, @trans, @line, @price, @qty, @obj, @objorg 
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @r = o7crcorr @rtype, @trans, @line, @price, @qty, NULL, NULL, @obj, @objorg
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @rtype, @trans, @line, @price, @qty, @obj, @objorg 
        END
      CLOSE c_ins
      DEALLOCATE c_ins
    END
END

	declare @sCallcenter_org	nvarchar(15)

	declare @sNewvalue      	nvarchar(250)

	declare @sComment       	nvarchar(2000)
	declare @nSqlidentity   	integer
	declare @sEvent         	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRentity       	nvarchar(4)

    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	CRH_PK,	CRH_CALLCENTERCODE,	CRH_CALLCENTER_ORG,	CRH_REQDATE,	CRH_EVENTTYPE,
													  	CRH_USERCODE,	CRH_FIELD,	CRH_OLDVALUE,	CRH_NEWVALUE,	CRH_UPDATECOUNT,

													from inserted

			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sPk,	@sCallcentercode,	@sCallcenter_org,	@dReqdate,	@sEventtype,
												@sUsercode,	@sField,	@sOldvalue,	@sNewvalue,	@nUpdatecount,
												@sComment,	@nSqlidentity,	@sEvent,	@sRentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

create trigger PREINS_CRR
on R5EXCHRATES
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUsr_name		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCode			int 
	declare @sCURR          nvarchar (3)
	declare @nEXCH          numeric(24,12)
	declare @dSTART         DATETIME
	declare @dEND           DATETIME
	declare @sACTIVE        nvarchar (1) 
	declare @sSOURCESYSTEM  nvarchar (45) 
	declare @sSOURCECODE    nvarchar (45) 
	declare @dINTERFACE     DATETIME 
	declare @sORGCURR       nvarchar (3)
	declare @nUPDATECOUNT   numeric(38)
  declare @sCRRCODE       nvarchar(30)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select  CRR_CURR, CRR_EXCH, CRR_START, CRR_END, CRR_ACTIVE, CRR_SOURCESYSTEM, CRR_SOURCECODE, CRR_INTERFACE, CRR_ORGCURR, CRR_UPDATECOUNT, CRR_CODE from inserted

			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sCURR, @nEXCH, @dSTART, @dEND,  @sACTIVE, @sSOURCESYSTEM, @sSOURCECODE, @dINTERFACE, @sORGCURR, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sCRRCODE


			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin

							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCRRCODE OUTPUT, N'EXC', N'1', @sChk	 OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							execute @nReturn = O7PRECRR N'INS',  @sCURR,   @dEND OUTPUT,  @dSTART OUTPUT,  @sORGCURR, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRECRR', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
						end
						insert into R5EXCHRATES	(	CRR_CURR, CRR_EXCH, CRR_START, CRR_END, CRR_ACTIVE, CRR_SOURCESYSTEM, 
													CRR_SOURCECODE, CRR_INTERFACE, CRR_ORGCURR, CRR_UPDATECOUNT, CRR_CODE )
										values (	@sCURR, @nEXCH, @dSTART, @dEND,  @sACTIVE, @sSOURCESYSTEM,	
													@sSOURCECODE, @dINTERFACE, @sORGCURR, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sCRRCODE  )

						fetch next from c_inserted into @sCURR, @nEXCH, @dSTART, @dEND,  @sACTIVE, @sSOURCESYSTEM, @sSOURCECODE, @dINTERFACE, @sORGCURR, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sCRRCODE				
					end
			close c_inserted
		deallocate c_inserted
	end

create trigger PREINS_CRW
on R5CREWS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		        nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CRW_CODE, CRW_ORG, CRW_DESC, CRW_CLASS, CRW_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CREW', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit >= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0 
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CRW', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
										else
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CREW', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
								
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_CUR
on R5CURRENCIES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select CUR_CODE, CUR_DESC, CUR_CLASS, CUR_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CURR', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_CUR', N'TRIG', 1, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end



							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'CURR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_DBE
on R5DATABRIDGEERRORS
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     	integer       
	declare @nXtsseqnum   	integer       
	declare @nParentseqnum	integer       
	declare @dCreate      	datetime            
	declare @sErrormessage	varchar(4000)      
	declare @nGltransid   	integer       
	declare @nRunid       	integer       
	declare @sGltable     	nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sGlprocess   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sTblrowid    	nvarchar(250)       
	declare @nGlentryid   	integer       
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38)        
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer 
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3)            
	declare @sTableName		nvarchar(32)
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(500)
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(64)
	declare @nEntries		integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	DBE_TRANSID,	DBE_XTSSEQNUM,	DBE_PARENTSEQNUM,	DBE_CREATE,	DBE_ERRORMESSAGE,
													  	DBE_GLTRANSID,	DBE_RUNID,	DBE_GLTABLE,	DBE_GLPROCESS,	DBE_TBLROWID,
													  	DBE_GLENTRYID,	DBE_UPDATECOUNT,	DBE_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nTransid,	@nXtsseqnum,	@nParentseqnum,	@dCreate,	@sErrormessage,
												@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
												@nGlentryid,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
						    if (@nTransid is NULL) OR (@nTransid = 0)
								begin
									set @sChk = null
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nTransid OUTPUT, N'DBE', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										set @dCreate = GetDate()
								end

							execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_errorentries', @sTemp OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @nEntries = cast( @sTemp as integer )
							set @nEntries = @nEntries + 1
							set @sTemp = cast( @nEntries as nvarchar(64) )
							
							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_errorentries', @sTemp
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7XMLVAL_DBE_TMP_TABLE
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sTableName = dbo.GET_O7XMLVAL_DBE_TEMP_TBLNAME()

							set @sSQL = N'insert into ' + @sTableName + ' ( dbe_errormessage, dbe_xtsseqnum ) 
											values ( @sErr, @nSeq ) '

							execute sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sErr varchar(4000), @nSeq integer', @sErrormessage, @nXtsseqnum
							if @@ERROR <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
					insert into R5DATABRIDGEERRORS(	DBE_TRANSID,	DBE_XTSSEQNUM,	DBE_PARENTSEQNUM,	DBE_CREATE,	DBE_ERRORMESSAGE,
								                   	DBE_GLTRANSID,	DBE_RUNID,	DBE_GLTABLE,	DBE_GLPROCESS,	DBE_TBLROWID,
								                   	DBE_GLENTRYID,	DBE_UPDATECOUNT)
								values (	@nTransid,	@nXtsseqnum,	@nParentseqnum,	@dCreate,	@sErrormessage,
											@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
									    	@nGlentryid,	@nUpdatecount
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nTransid,	@nXtsseqnum,	@nParentseqnum,	@dCreate,	@sErrormessage,
														@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
														@nGlentryid,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_DIA
on R5DIAGNOSTICS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select DIA_CODE, DIA_DESC, DIA_CLASS, DIA_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0
							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DIAG', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREINS_DIA', N'TRIG', 1
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_DIA', N'TRIG', 1, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'DIAG', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

on R5DETAILAUDIT
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @dDate		datetime
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer
	declare @sMobile	nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select DTA_DATE, DTA_SQLIDENTITY, DTA_MOBILE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sMobile = N'+'
								set @dDate = dbo.o7gttime2(null)

							insert into R5DETAILAUDIT ( DTA_ENTITY, DTA_RENTITY, DTA_TYPE,
										DTA_CODE, DTA_LANG, DTA_LINE,
										DTA_PRINT, DTA_UPDATED, DTA_UPDUSER,

										DTA_TEXT, DTA_MOBILE )
									select DTA_ENTITY, DTA_RENTITY, DTA_TYPE,
										DTA_CODE, DTA_LANG, DTA_LINE,

						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_EAS
on R5EVENTASPECTS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @dClosed		datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare	@sX			nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select EAS_EVENT from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'	
							set @nCountit = 0
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
							FROM   r5events  e
							WHERE  e.evt_code   = @sEvent
							AND    e.evt_rstatus <> N'C'

							if @nCountit > 0
								set @sX = null
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									set @sCheckresult = N'1'
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_EAS', N'TRIG', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ELS
on R5ELECSIGN

NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUsr_name           nvarchar(30)

   declare @sEls_org            nvarchar(15)
   declare @sEls_user           nvarchar(255)
   declare @dEls_date           datetime
   declare @sEls_entity         nvarchar(4)
   declare @sEls_signtype       nvarchar(8)
   declare @sEls_status         nvarchar(4)
   declare @sEls_parent         nvarchar(30)
   declare @sEls_certifynum     nvarchar(20)
   declare @sEls_certifytype    nvarchar(8)
   declare @dEls_externaldate   datetime

   declare @sUserdesc           nvarchar(80)
   declare @sSigntypedesc       nvarchar(80)

   declare @sLang               nvarchar(200)
   declare @sChk                nvarchar(4)

   declare @nReturn int
   declare @sEls_externaldate   nvarchar(25)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_inserted cursor local for SELECT  ELS_CODE, ELS_ENTCODE, ELS_ORG, ELS_USER, ELS_DATE, ELS_ENTITY, ELS_SIGNTYPE, ELS_STATUS,
                                          ELS_PARENT, ELS_CERTIFYNUM, ELS_CERTIFYTYPE, ELS_EXTERNALDATE, ELS_USERDESC, ELS_SIGNTYPEDESC
                                    FROM   inserted

         set @sUsr_name = dbo.o7gtsusr()

         open c_inserted
         FETCH NEXT
         FROM c_inserted
         INTO @sEls_code, @sEls_entcode, @sEls_org, @sEls_user, @dEls_date, @sEls_entity, @sEls_signtype, @sEls_status,
            @sEls_parent, @sEls_certifynum, @sEls_certifytype, @dEls_externaldate, @sUserdesc, @sSigntypedesc

         while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
               if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
                  begin
                     execute @nReturn = dbo.o7esign_getexternaldate @sEls_externaldate OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                           close c_inserted
                           deallocate c_inserted
                           rollback transaction
                           return
                        end
                     set @dEls_externaldate = convert(datetime, @sEls_externaldate, 121)
                  end

               INSERT INTO r5elecsign (els_code, els_entcode, els_org, els_user, els_date, els_entity, els_signtype, els_status,
                  els_parent, els_certifynum, els_certifytype, els_externaldate, els_userdesc, els_signtypedesc, els_entcode2 )
               VALUES  (@sEls_code, @sEls_entcode, @sEls_org, @sEls_user, @dEls_date, @sEls_entity, @sEls_signtype, @sEls_status,
                  @sEls_parent, @sEls_certifynum, @sEls_certifytype, @dEls_externaldate, @sUserdesc, @sSigntypedesc,
                  CASE @sEls_entity WHEN N'OBJ' THEN @sEls_entcode ELSE NULL END )

               FETCH NEXT
               FROM c_inserted
               INTO @sEls_code, @sEls_entcode, @sEls_org, @sEls_user, @dEls_date, @sEls_entity, @sEls_signtype, @sEls_status,
                  @sEls_parent, @sEls_certifynum, @sEls_certifytype, @dEls_externaldate, @sUserdesc, @sSigntypedesc

            end
         close c_inserted
         deallocate c_inserted
      end

				end

create trigger PREINS_EOB
on R5EVENTOBJECTS
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObrType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObject		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sRollup		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDowntime		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sObject_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount	int
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select EOB_EVENT, EOB_OBTYPE, EOB_OBRTYPE, EOB_OBJECT, EOB_LEVEL, 
														EOB_ROLLUP, EOB_DOWNTIME, EOB_OBJECT_ORG, EOB_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted 
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent, @sObType, @sObrType, @sObject, @nLevel, 
											@sRollup, @sDowntime, @sObject_org, @nUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrType OUTPUT, @sObType OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_EOB', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
							
					insert into R5EVENTOBJECTS ( EOB_EVENT, EOB_OBTYPE, EOB_OBRTYPE, EOB_OBJECT, EOB_LEVEL, 
													EOB_ROLLUP, EOB_DOWNTIME, EOB_OBJECT_ORG, EOB_UPDATECOUNT )
							VALUES ( @sEvent, @sObType, @sObrType, @sObject, @nLevel, 
											@sRollup, @sDowntime, @sObject_org, @nUpdatecount )

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent, @sObType, @sObrType, @sObject, @nLevel, 
													@sRollup, @sDowntime, @sObject_org, @nUpdatecount
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

              AND    esp_org 		= 	@sEsporg

              SET 	@dDateexpired = ISNULL( @dDateexpired, dbo.TO_DATE( N'12-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) );

              INSERT INTO r5entitysalesprices(	  esp_pk,esp_rentity,esp_code,esp_org,esp_salesprice,esp_dateeffective,esp_dateexpired,esp_store
												  ,esp_udfchar01,esp_udfchar02,esp_udfchar03,esp_udfchar04,

												  esp_udfchkbox01, esp_udfchkbox02, esp_udfchkbox03, esp_udfchkbox04, esp_udfchkbox05)
              VALUES( 
                        @sEsppk, @sRentity, @sEspcode, @sEsporg, @nSalesprice, @dDateeffective, @dDateexpired, @sStore, 
	                    @sUdfchar01, @sUdfchar02,  @sUdfchar03, @sUdfchar04, @sUdfchar05, 
						@sUdfchar06, @sUdfchar07, @sUdfchar08, @sUdfchar09, @sUdfchar10,
						@sUdfchar11, @sUdfchar12, @sUdfchar13, @sUdfchar14, @sUdfchar15, 
						@sUdfchar16, @sUdfchar17, @sUdfchar18, @sUdfchar19, @sUdfchar20, 
						@sUdfchar21, @sUdfchar22, @sUdfchar23, @sUdfchar24, @sUdfchar25, 
						@sUdfchar26, @sUdfchar27, @sUdfchar28, @sUdfchar29, @sUdfchar30, 
						@sUdfnum01, @sUdfnum02,  @sUdfnum03,  @sUdfnum04,  @sUdfnum05, 
						@sUdfdate01, @sUdfdate02, @sUdfdate03, @sUdfdate04, @sUdfdate05, 
						@sUdfchkbox01, @sUdfchkbox02, @sUdfchkbox03, @sUdfchkbox04, @sUdfchkbox05 )

			SELECT @dMaxfromdate = MAX( esp_dateeffective )
            FROM   r5entitysalesprices
			WHERE  esp_rentity    =	@sRentity
            AND    esp_org 		= 	@sEsporg
            AND    esp_code		= 	@sEspcode
            AND    ISNULL(esp_store,'') =	ISNULL(@sStore,'')
            AND    esp_dateeffective   < @dDateeffective
            IF @dMaxfromdate IS NOT NULL
                UPDATE r5entitysalesprices
                SET    esp_dateexpired  =	@dDateeffective - 1
                WHERE  esp_rentity    	=	@sRentity
              	AND    esp_org 			= 	@sEsporg
              	AND    esp_code		    = 	@sEspcode
              	AND    ISNULL(esp_store,'')	= ISNULL(@sStore,'')

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sEsppk, @sRentity, @sEspcode, @sEsporg, @nSalesprice, @dDateeffective, @dDateexpired, @sStore, 
	                    @sUdfchar01, @sUdfchar02,  @sUdfchar03, @sUdfchar04, @sUdfchar05,

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_ESS
  ON r5energystarsetup
  INSTEAD OF INSERT
  NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS

  DECLARE @sSysUser           NVARCHAR(  38 )
  DECLARE @sCustomerid        NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @sBuildingid        NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @sMeterid           NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @sObject            NVARCHAR(  30 )
  DECLARE @sObject_org        NVARCHAR(  15 )
  DECLARE @sUom               NVARCHAR(  30 )
  DECLARE @sBuildingname      NVARCHAR(  60 )
  DECLARE @sBuildingaddress   NVARCHAR(  60 )
  DECLARE @sBuildingcity      NVARCHAR(  25 )
  DECLARE @sBuildingstate     NVARCHAR(   2 )
  DECLARE @sBuildingzip       NVARCHAR(   5 )
  DECLARE @nBuildingyearbuilt NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sMetername         NVARCHAR(  60 )
  DECLARE @sEnergytype        NVARCHAR(  30 )
  DECLARE @sMeterunit         NVARCHAR(  30 )
  DECLARE @sConfirmed         NVARCHAR(   1 )
  DECLARE @nUpdatecount       NUMERIC

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
      SELECT ess_customerid, ess_buildingid, ess_meterid, ess_object, ess_object_org, ess_uom, ess_buildingname,
             ess_buildingaddress, ess_buildingcity, ess_buildingstate, ess_buildingzip, ess_buildingyearbuilt,
             ess_metername, ess_energytype, ess_meterunit, ess_confirmed, ess_updatecount
      FROM   inserted
      SET @sSysUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sCustomerid, @sBuildingid, @sMeterid, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sUom,
            @sBuildingname,  @sBuildingaddress, @sBuildingcity, @sBuildingstate, @sBuildingzip, @nBuildingyearbuilt,
            @sMetername, @sEnergytype, @sMeterunit, @sConfirmed, @nUpdatecount
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO r5uoms( uom_code, uom_desc, uom_notused )
              SELECT @sMeterunit, @sMeterunit, N'-'
              WHERE  @sMeterunit IS NOT NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x' 
                               FROM   r5uoms 
                               WHERE  uom_code = @sMeterunit )

              INSERT INTO r5energystarsetup( ess_customerid, ess_buildingid, ess_meterid, ess_object, ess_object_org, 
                     ess_uom, ess_buildingname, ess_buildingaddress, ess_buildingcity, ess_buildingstate, ess_buildingzip, 
                     ess_buildingyearbuilt, ess_metername, ess_energytype, ess_meterunit, ess_confirmed, ess_updatecount )
              VALUES( @sCustomerid, @sBuildingid, @sMeterid, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sUom, @sBuildingname,  
                      @sBuildingaddress, @sBuildingcity, @sBuildingstate, @sBuildingzip, @nBuildingyearbuilt,
                      @sMetername, @sEnergytype, @sMeterunit, @sConfirmed, @nUpdatecount )

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sCustomerid, @sBuildingid, @sMeterid, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sUom,
                @sBuildingname,  @sBuildingaddress, @sBuildingcity, @sBuildingstate, @sBuildingzip, @nBuildingyearbuilt,
                @sMetername, @sEnergytype, @sMeterunit, @sConfirmed, @nUpdatecount
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
        END
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_EXC
ON R5EXCEPTIONS
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
  DECLARE @sSysUser     NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @dDate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @nTime        NUMERIC        
  DECLARE @sPerson      NVARCHAR(15)        
  DECLARE @nHours       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )        
  DECLARE @sComment     NVARCHAR(70)        
  DECLARE @nUpdatecount NUMERIC(38,0)       
  DECLARE @nReturn      INTEGER
  DECLARE @sChk         NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @nCount		int
  DECLARE @sFlag        nvarchar(1)
  DECLARE @sTempMsgid   nvarchar(256)
  DECLARE @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
              SELECT exc_date, exc_time, exc_person, exc_hours, exc_comment, exc_updatecount
              FROM   inserted
      SET @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      OPEN c_inserted
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @dDate, @nTime, @sPerson, @nHours, @sComment, @nUpdatecount
                      
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
              IF @nTime IS NULL
                SET @nTime = 0
            END 
           
          INSERT INTO r5exceptions(  
                 exc_date, exc_time, exc_person, exc_hours,  exc_comment, exc_updatecount )
          VALUES( @dDate, @nTime, @sPerson, @nHours, @sComment, @nUpdatecount )
 
 
 	-- UPDATE EAM-801 START
	select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@EMPEXCP'
                                    if @nCount > 0
                                        select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@EMPEXCP'
                                    else
                                        set @sFlag = N'N'
										if @sFlag = N'Y'										
                                        begin
	                                    select @sOrg = PER_ORG from  R5PERSONNEL WHERE PER_CODE = @sPerson
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end					
									
                                            INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
												  XTS_TABLE,
												  XTS_KEYFLD1,
												  XTS_KEYFLD2,
												  XTS_KEYFLDDATE1,
												  XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
												  XTS_ORG
											  )
											  VALUES(
												 N'EMPEXCPN',
												 N'R5EXCEPTIONS',
												 @sPerson,
												 CAST(@nTime as varchar(80)),
												 @dDate,
												 @sTempMsgid,
												 @sOrg
												 )
									end
	-- UPDATE EAM-801 END
 
 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @dDate, @nTime, @sPerson, @nHours, @sComment, @nUpdatecount
           
        END
      CLOSE c_inserted
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

create trigger PREINS_FAC
on R5FACILITIES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select FAC_CODE, FAC_Org, FAC_DESC, FAC_CLASS, FAC_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

								If @sClass is not null
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'FAC', N'COMM', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit >= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0 
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FAC', N'TRIG', 3, @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
										
									end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'FAC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_FCA
on R5FAILURECLASSES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sGen			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFailure		nvarchar(8)  -- r5failures.fal_gen%TYPE;
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select FCA_CLASS, FCA_CLASS_ORG, FCA_FAILURE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sFailure
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* W43201 - Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'OBJ' ) */
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit >= 0
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FCA', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							SELECT @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5failures 
							WHERE  fal_code = @sFailure


							/* W43202 - Failure Code can't be general (r5failures) */
							if @nCount <= 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FCA', N'TRIG', N'999', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							else
								begin
									SELECT @sGen = fal_gen
									FROM   r5failures 
									WHERE  fal_code = @sFailure
									
									if @sGen = N'+'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FCA', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sFailure
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

													  	FND_UPDATECOUNT,	FND_CREATED,	FND_UPDATED,	FND_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sGen,	@sClass_org,
														@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'FIND', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0

											rollback transaction

create trigger PREINS_FUN
on R5FUNCTIONS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPerType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(6)
	declare @sAuto			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDisplayft		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSubType		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select fun_class, fun_class_org, fun_pertype, fun_desc, fun_code, fun_auto, fun_displayft, fun_subtype from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sPerType, @sDesc, @sCode, @sAuto, @sDisplayft, @sSubType
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'FUNC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'DET', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit <= 0
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FUN', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sChk, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @sPerType is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'PRTP', @sPerType, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FUN', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'FUNC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if ( @sAuto = N'I' and @sDisplayft = N'+' ) or ( @sAuto in ( N'D', N'N', N'M', N'L' ) and @sDisplayft = N'-' )
								update r5functions
								set fun_displayft = case when fun_auto = N'I' then N'-' when fun_auto in ( N'D', N'N', N'M', N'L' ) then N'+' end
								where fun_code = @sCode
							-- r5urlparameters handling
							IF @sClass = N'WEB' AND @sSubType <> N'C'
								BEGIN
									UPDATE r5functions SET fun_nodesign = N'+' WHERE fun_code = @sCode
									INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_parametername, url_system) VALUES (@sCode, N'eamid', '+')
									INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_parametername, url_system) VALUES (@sCode, N'internal_eamid', '+')
									INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (url_userfunction, url_parametername, url_system) VALUES (@sCode, N'tenant', '+')
								END
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sPerType, @sDesc, @sCode, @sAuto, @sDisplayft, @sSubType
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_IND
on R5INDICATORS
for insert NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sUom        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nMin        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMax        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer  
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	           

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	IND_CODE,	IND_DESC,	IND_CLASS,	IND_UOM,	IND_MIN,
													  	IND_MAX,	IND_CLASS_ORG,	IND_UPDATECOUNT,	IND_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sUom,	@nMin,
														@nMax,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'IND', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_IND', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'IND', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inseted
									deallocate c_inseted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inseted
									deallocate c_inseted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sUom,	@nMin,
																@nMax,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ISS

as
	declare @sUsr_name			nvarchar(38)

	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @ninsiss_pk           integer       
	declare @sinsiss_event        nvarchar(30)        
	declare @ninsiss_act          numeric(8,0)       
	declare @sinsiss_store        nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sinsiss_part         nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sinsiss_part_org     nvarchar(15)        
	declare @ninsiss_qty          numeric(24,6)       
	declare @ninsiss_price        numeric(24,6)       
	declare @dinsiss_date         datetime            
	declare @dinsiss_fifodate     datetime            
	declare @ninsiss_updatecount  numeric(38,0)       
	declare @iinsiss_sqlidentity  INTEGER  


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for SELECT	ISS_PK, ISS_EVENT, ISS_ACT, ISS_STORE, ISS_PART, ISS_PART_ORG, ISS_QTY, ISS_PRICE,
														ISS_DATE, ISS_FIFODATE, ISS_UPDATECOUNT, ISS_SQLIDENTITY
										        FROM   inserted

			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sX = null

			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			open c_inserted
			FETCH NEXT
			FROM c_inserted
			INTO @ninsiss_pk, @sinsiss_event, @ninsiss_act, @sinsiss_store, @sinsiss_part, @sinsiss_part_org, @ninsiss_qty, @ninsiss_price,
				 @dinsiss_date, @dinsiss_fifodate, @ninsiss_updatecount, @iinsiss_sqlidentity

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @ninsiss_pk OUTPUT, N'FIFO', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						

						end
					INSERT INTO R5ISSUES (ISS_PK, ISS_EVENT, ISS_ACT, ISS_STORE, ISS_PART, ISS_PART_ORG, ISS_QTY, ISS_PRICE, ISS_DATE, ISS_FIFODATE, ISS_UPDATECOUNT)
					VALUES  (@ninsiss_pk, @sinsiss_event, @ninsiss_act, @sinsiss_store, @sinsiss_part, @sinsiss_part_org, @ninsiss_qty, @ninsiss_price, @dinsiss_date, @dinsiss_fifodate, @ninsiss_updatecount )

					FETCH NEXT
					FROM c_inserted
					INTO @ninsiss_pk, @sinsiss_event, @ninsiss_act, @sinsiss_store, @sinsiss_part, @sinsiss_part_org, @ninsiss_qty, @ninsiss_price,
						 @dinsiss_date, @dinsiss_fifodate, @ninsiss_updatecount, @iinsiss_sqlidentity


				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_JPVLINE
ON R5JOBPARAMVALUE
INSTEAD OF INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser nvarchar(38)
	declare	@sJpvCode nvarchar(30)
	declare	@nJpvLine integer
	declare	@sJpvKey nvarchar(20)
	declare	@sJpvValue nvarchar(1025)
	declare	@sJpvUpdcnt nvarchar(1025)
	declare	@nIncrLino integer
	declare	@nRecCount integer


if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	JPV_CODE, JPV_LINE, JPV_KEY, JPV_VALUE, JPV_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sJpvCode,	@nJpvLine,	@sJpvKey,	@sJpvValue,	@sJpvUpdcnt

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							select @nRecCount = count(*) from r5jobparamvalue where jpv_code = @sJpvCode;

							if @nRecCount > 0
							begin
							
								select @nIncrLino = convert(numeric,INS_DESC) from r5install where ins_code='INCRLINO';
							
								select @nJpvLine = max(jpv_line) + @nIncrLino from r5jobparamvalue where jpv_code = @sJpvCode;
							end
							else
							begin
								select @nJpvLine = isnull(max(jpv_line),0) from r5jobparamvalue where jpv_code = @sJpvCode;
							end
						end
					insert into R5JOBPARAMVALUE(JPV_CODE, JPV_LINE, JPV_KEY, JPV_VALUE, JPV_UPDATECOUNT)
									VALUES(@sJpvCode,	@nJpvLine,	@sJpvKey,	@sJpvValue,	@sJpvUpdcnt)


					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sJpvCode,	@nJpvLine,	@sJpvKey,	@sJpvValue,	@sJpvUpdcnt

				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_MET
on R5METERS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select MET_CLASS, MET_CLASS_ORG, MET_DESC, MET_ORG, MET_CODE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0
							if @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'MET', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit > 0
										set @sX = NULL
									else
										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'PREINS_MET', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
								end
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'MET', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sCode
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_MFG
on R5MANUFACTURERS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(24)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sFlag          nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTempMsgid     nvarchar(256)
	declare @sCount			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select MFG_CLASS, MFG_CLASS_ORG, MFG_DESC, MFG_ORG, MFG_CODE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
						
						/*  OUTBOUND MANUFACTURER BEGIN  EAM-5224 */
									select @sCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@MANUFAC'
                                    if @sCount > 0
                                        select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@MANUFAC'
                                    else
                                        set @sFlag = N'N'

										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end					
									
                                    if @sFlag = N'Y'
                                        begin
                                            INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus(
												xts_trantype,
												xts_table,
												xts_keyfld1,
												xts_keyfld2,
												xts_orig_messageid,
												xts_org  )
												VALUES(
												 N'MANUFACTURER',
												 N'R5MANUFACTURERS',
												 @sCode,
												 @sOrg,
												 @sTempMsgid,
												 @sOrg )
                                        end
									/*  OUTBOUND MANUFACTURER EAM-5224 END */
						
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							if @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'MANU', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_MFG', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_MNE
ON r5mobilenotebookemails
INSTEAD OF INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @code           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @mobilenotebook NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @person         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @emailaddress   NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @mobilecreated  DATETIME
  DECLARE @sent           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @mailevent      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT mne_code, mne_mobilenotebook, mne_person, mne_emailaddress, mne_mobile_created, mne_sent
        FROM   inserted 
      OPEN c_ins 
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @code, @mobilenotebook, @person, @emailaddress, @mobilecreated, @sent
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5mobilenotebooks
          SET    mnb_emailaddress = @emailaddress,
                 mnb_mnecode      = @code
          WHERE  mnb_code = @mobilenotebook

          SELECT @mailevent = MAX( mae_code ) 
          FROM   r5mailevents
          WHERE  mae_template IN ( SELECT mat_code
                                   FROM   r5mailtemplate
                                   WHERE  mat_notebookemails = '+' )
          AND    mae_param1 = @code

          UPDATE r5mobilenotebooks
          SET    mnb_emailaddress = NULL,
                 mnb_mnecode      = NULL
          WHERE  mnb_code = @mobilenotebook
          
          INSERT INTO r5mobilenotebookemails( mne_code, mne_mobilenotebook, mne_person, mne_emailaddress, mne_mailevent, mne_mobile_created, mne_sent )
          VALUES( @code, @mobilenotebook, @person, @emailaddress, @mailevent, @mobilecreated, @sent )

          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins INTO @code, @mobilenotebook, @person, @emailaddress, @mobilecreated, @sent
        END
      CLOSE c_ins
      DEALLOCATE c_ins
    END
END

													  	MST_UPDUSER,	MST_UPDATECOUNT,	MST_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nRevision,

									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREMST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSINS portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'MSTD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted

									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return

							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							INSERT INTO r5entappheader ( eah_rentity, eah_code, eah_revision,
														  eah_user, eah_date )
							VALUES( N'MSTD', @sCode, @nRevision, @sUserid, @dGtTime )

																@sSmutsuom,	@sNotused,	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,
																@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity

				end
			deallocate c_inserted

create trigger PREINS_MTH
on R5METHODS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select MTH_CODE, MTH_DESC, MTH_CLASS, MTH_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = null
			set @nCountit = 0

			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'METH', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_MTH', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'METH', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_MTL
on R5MATLISTS
instead of insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)

	declare @sCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @nRevision		numeric(4)
	declare @sRevrstatus	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRevstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount	int
	declare @sEntity		nvarchar(10)
	declare @sPlan_record	nvarchar(20)

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(8)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sUstat			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRstat			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select MTL_CODE, MTL_DESC, MTL_CLASS, MTL_EVENT, MTL_ACT, MTL_REVISION,
														MTL_REVRSTATUS, MTL_REVSTATUS, MTL_ORG, MTL_CLASS_ORG, MTL_UPDATECOUNT, MTL_ENTITY, MTL_PLAN_RECORD
												  from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted 
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sEvent, @nAct, @nRevision, 
											@sRevrstatus, @sRevstatus, @sOrg, @sClass_org, @nUpdatecount, @sEntity, @sPlan_record
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sX = null

							if @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'MATL', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit > 0
										set @sX = null
									else
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREIND_MTL', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											else
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_MTL', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									end

									if @sRevrstatus is null or @sRevstatus is null
										begin
											execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sX OUTPUT, N'PMRVCTRL', @sChk OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											set @sX = UPPER( @sX )
											if isnull( @sX, N'-' ) in ( N'+', N'ON', N'YES', N'Y' )
												set @sRstat = N'U'
											else
												set @sRstat = N'A'

											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstat OUTPUT, @sRstat, N'RCST', @sChk OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											set @sRevrstatus = @sRstat
											set @sRevstatus = @sUstat
										end

									if @nRevision is null begin
										select @nRevision = isnull( max(MTL_REVISION), -1) + 1
										FROM   r5matlists
										WHERE  mtl_code = @sCode
									end
								
						end

					insert into r5matlists ( MTL_CODE, MTL_DESC, MTL_CLASS, MTL_EVENT, MTL_ACT, MTL_REVISION,
												MTL_REVRSTATUS, MTL_REVSTATUS, MTL_ORG, MTL_CLASS_ORG, MTL_UPDATECOUNT, MTL_ENTITY, MTL_PLAN_RECORD )
							values ( @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sEvent, @nAct, @nRevision, 
										@sRevrstatus, @sRevstatus, @sOrg, @sClass_org, @nUpdatecount, @sEntity, @sPlan_record )

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sEvent, @nAct, @nRevision, 
													@sRevrstatus, @sRevstatus, @sOrg, @sClass_org, @nUpdatecount, @sEntity, @sPlan_record
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_OAC
on R5OBJACTUALCONSUMPTION
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
  declare @sSysUser           nvarchar(38)
  declare @sObject            nvarchar(30)
  declare @sObjectOrg         nvarchar(15)
  declare @sCommodity         nvarchar(15)
  declare @dDate              datetime
  declare @nUsage             numeric(24,6)
  declare @nActualConsumption numeric(24,6)
  declare @dUpdated           datetime
  declare @nUpdatecount       numeric(38,0)
  declare @nSqlidentity       integer             
  declare @sDesignUsageUOM    nvarchar(30)
  declare @nLoadFactor        integer

  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    begin
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare c_inserted cursor local for 
        select OAC_OBJECT, OAC_OBJECT_ORG, OAC_COMMODITY, OAC_DATE, OAC_USAGE, 
               OAC_ACTUALCONSUMPTION, OAC_UPDATED, OAC_UPDATECOUNT, OAC_SQLIDENTITY,
               OAC_DESIGNUSAGEUOM, OAC_LOADFACTOR
        from inserted
      set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      open c_inserted
      fetch next from c_inserted into
         @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dDate, @nUsage, @nActualConsumption,
         @dUpdated, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlidentity, @sDesignUsageUOM, @nLoadFactor
      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
          if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
            begin
              set @dUpdated = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GetDate(), N'DD' )
              
              select @sDesignUsageUOM = odc_designusageuom
              from   r5objdesignconsumption
              where  odc_object     = @sObject
              and    odc_object_org = @sObjectOrg
              and    odc_commodity  = @sCommodity
              and    @dDate BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate

            end
          insert into R5OBJACTUALCONSUMPTION( OAC_OBJECT, OAC_OBJECT_ORG, OAC_COMMODITY, OAC_DATE,
                  OAC_USAGE, OAC_ACTUALCONSUMPTION, OAC_UPDATED, OAC_UPDATECOUNT, OAC_DESIGNUSAGEUOM,
                  OAC_LOADFACTOR )
          values(  @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dDate, @nUsage, @nActualConsumption,
                   @dUpdated, @nUpdatecount, @sDesignUsageUOM, @nLoadFactor )

          UPDATE r5utilityrates
          SET    utr_indexed    = N'-'
          WHERE  utr_date       = @dDate
          AND    utr_object     = @sObject
          AND    utr_object_org = @sObjectOrg
          AND    utr_commodity  = @sCommodity
          AND    utr_calculatedaverage = N'+'

          fetch next from c_inserted into 
            @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dDate, @nUsage, @nActualConsumption,
            @dUpdated, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlidentity, @sDesignUsageUOM, @nLoadFactor                 
        end
      close c_inserted
      deallocate c_inserted
    end
