create trigger PREINS_OCQ
on R5OPCALCQUEUE
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nId         	integer
	declare @nStatus     	integer
	declare @sAudituser  	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sFacility   	nvarchar(60)        
	declare @sVlist      	nvarchar(4000)      
	declare @dDatestart  	datetime            
	declare @dDateend    	datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer      
		      
	declare @nReturn	integer
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)        

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	OCQ_ID,	OCQ_STATUS,	OCQ_AUDITUSER,	OCQ_FACILITY,	OCQ_VLIST,
													  	OCQ_DATESTART,	OCQ_DATEEND,	OCQ_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nId,	@nStatus,	@sAudituser,	@sFacility,	@sVlist,
												@dDatestart,	@dDateend,	@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sChk = null
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nId OUTPUT, N'OCQ', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					insert into R5OPCALCQUEUE(	OCQ_ID,	OCQ_STATUS,	OCQ_AUDITUSER,	OCQ_FACILITY,	OCQ_VLIST,
								              	OCQ_DATESTART,	OCQ_DATEEND)
								values (	@nId,	@nStatus,	@sAudituser,	@sFacility,	@sVlist,
									    	@dDatestart,	@dDateend
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nId,	@nStatus,	@sAudituser,	@sFacility,	@sVlist,
														@dDatestart,	@dDateend,	@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_ODP
ON R5OBJDEPRECIATION
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
  DECLARE @sysuser      NVARCHAR(38)
  DECLARE @object       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @objectorg    NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @deptype      NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @mode         NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @period       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @startdate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @enddate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @expense      NUMERIC(38,12)
  DECLARE @bookvalue    NUMERIC(38,12)
  DECLARE @parent       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @acd          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @glflag       NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @gltransfer   DATETIME
  DECLARE @sqlidentity  INTEGER
  DECLARE @return       INTEGER
  DECLARE @chk          NVARCHAR(4)

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      SET @sysuser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      IF @sysUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
            SELECT odp_object, odp_object_org, odp_deptype, odp_mode, odp_period, odp_startdate, odp_enddate, 
                   odp_expense, odp_bookvalue, odp_parent, odp_acd, odp_gltransferflag, odp_gltransfer, odp_sqlidentity
            FROM   inserted
          OPEN c_inserted
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @object, @objectorg, @deptype, @mode, @period, @startdate, @enddate, 
                                          @expense, @bookvalue, @parent, @acd, @glflag, @gltransfer, @sqlidentity
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @acd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @return <> 0
                  BEGIN
                    CLOSE c_inserted
                    DEALLOCATE c_inserted
                    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                    RETURN
                  END

              INSERT INTO r5objdepreciation( odp_object, odp_object_org, odp_deptype, odp_mode, odp_period, odp_startdate, odp_enddate, 
                     odp_expense, odp_bookvalue, odp_parent, odp_acd, odp_gltransferflag, odp_gltransfer )
              VALUES( @object, @objectorg, @deptype, @mode, @period, @startdate, @enddate, 
                      @expense, @bookvalue, @parent, @acd, @glflag, @gltransfer )

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @object, @objectorg, @deptype, @mode, @period, @startdate, @enddate, 
                                              @expense, @bookvalue, @parent, @acd, @glflag, @gltransfer, @sqlidentity
            END
          CLOSE c_inserted
          DEALLOCATE c_inserted
        END
    END

				end

		end

								values (	@nBlockid,	@sSynctable,	@nStartval
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nBlockid,	@sSynctable,	@nStartval,	@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end
